title: One Piece
synopsis:
Barely surviving in a barrel after passing through a terrible whirlpool at sea, carefree Monkey D. Luffy ends up aboard a ship under attack by fearsome pirates. Despite being a naive-looking teenager, he is not to be underestimated. Unmatched in battle, Luffy is a pirate himself who resolutely pursues the coveted One Piece treasure and the King of the Pirates title that comes with it.

The late King of the Pirates, Gol D. Roger, stirred up the world before his death by disclosing the whereabouts of his hoard of riches and daring everyone to obtain it. Ever since then, countless powerful pirates have sailed dangerous seas for the prized One Piece only to never return. Although Luffy lacks a crew and a proper ship, he is endowed with a superhuman ability and an unbreakable spirit that make him not only a formidable adversary but also an inspiration to many.

As he faces numerous challenges with a big smile on his face, Luffy gathers one-of-a-kind companions to join him in his ambitious endeavor, together embracing perils and wonders on their once-in-a-lifetime adventure.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

episodes_data.title: I'm Luffy! The Man Who's Gonna Be King of the Pirates!
episodes_data.description: Countless souls have been lured along the Grand Line in pursuit of the legendary One Piece! Luffy D. Monkey is a young pirate with a dream: to prove the legend true and be king of them all!

episodes_data.title: Enter the Great Swordsman! Pirate Hunter Roronoa Zoro!
episodes_data.description: Luffy and his new companion Coby set sail in search of the infamous pirate hunter Zoro, rumored to be held captive at the Marine Base.

episodes_data.title: Morgan vs. Luffy! Who's the Mysterious Pretty Girl?
episodes_data.description: Luffy is in the line of fire after saving Zoro, and now tyrannical Captain Morgan is out for their heads! Zoro must decide if he will join forces with Luffy or die in captivity.

episodes_data.title: Luffy's Past! Enter Red-Haired Shanks!
episodes_data.description: Luffy recalls a time when Captain Red-Haired Shanks taught him a valuable lesson in friendship and set him on his quest to be King of the Pirates.

episodes_data.title: A Terrifying Mysterious Power! Captain Buggy, the Clown Pirate!
episodes_data.description: Luffy crosses paths with the clever thief Nami. A navigator on a quest to collect one hundred million berries, she’s perfect for Luffy’s new crew – except for the fact that Nami hates pirates.

episodes_data.title: Desperate Situation! Beast Tamer Mohji vs. Luffy!
episodes_data.description: Having delivered a deadly blow to Captain Buggy’s pirates, Luffy and his companions need a place to recuperate. But the three are not in hiding very long before the Beast Tamer Mohji seeks them out.

episodes_data.title: Epic Showdown! Swordsman Zoro vs. Acrobat Cabaji!
episodes_data.description: In the ongoing fight with Captain Buggy`s pirates, Zoro must face off with the Acrobat Cabaji while Luffy continues to do battle with the Pirate Clown himself.

episodes_data.title: Who Is the Victor? Devil Fruit Power Showdown!
episodes_data.description: Luffy and the gang are on the run after the battle with Captain Buggy! With no place to go and nothing else to do, Nami finally agrees to join Luffy on his quest.

episodes_data.title: The Honorable Liar? Captain Usopp!
episodes_data.description: Luffy, Zoro, and Nami arrive at an island hoping to obtain a ship and crew, but the three are quickly confronted with the blustering Captain Usopp - who has a connection to Luffy`s past.

episodes_data.title: The Weirdest Guy Ever! Jango the Hypnotist!
episodes_data.description: Luffy follows Usopp to the mansion and encounters the brutal pirate Captain Kuro. The scoundrel plans to claim Kaya`s fortune and live the stolen life of luxury.

episodes_data.title: Expose the Plot! Pirate Butler, Captain Kuro!
episodes_data.description: Usopp spreads word of Kuro`s evil plot and the impending pirate attack, but no one believes his warnings. The Straw Hat Pirates decide to help Usopp put a stop to the dastardly scheme.

episodes_data.title: Clash with the Black Cat Pirates! The Great Battle on the Slope!
episodes_data.description: Luffy and crew seek to best Captain Kuro, but they`ve prepared their defense on the wrong side of the island! All looks grim now that Usopp must face off against the Black Cat Pirates alone.

episodes_data.title: The Terrifying Duo! Meowban Brothers vs. Zoro!
episodes_data.description: In an effort to save Usopp`s village, the Straw Hat Pirates seek to block the marauders` path from the sea. With Luffy out of the battle, Zoro must face the fearsome Meowban Brothers!

episodes_data.title: Luffy Back in Action! Miss Kaya's Desperate Resistance!
episodes_data.description: Nami manages to rescue Zoro`s missing swords and attempts to revive Luffy. With one of the Meowban brothers down, the other rages on even more fiercely than before!

episodes_data.title: Beat Kuro! Usopp the Man's Tearful Resolve!
episodes_data.description: Usopp`s friends run away with the heiress Kaya. Jango races off after them, but not before sending Butchie into a berserk rage. As Zoro continues his battle, Luffy takes on Captain Kuro.

episodes_data.title: Protect Kaya! The Usopp Pirates' Great Efforts!
episodes_data.description: Luffy battles with Kuro on the beach, while the Veggies (with Kaya in tow) flee Jango the Hypnotist.

episodes_data.title: Anger Explosion! Kuro vs. Luffy! How It Ends!
episodes_data.description: Kaya rewards the Straw Hat Pirates` efforts to save her with a ship to call their own - the Going Merry!

episodes_data.title: You're the Weird Creature! Gaimon and His Strange Friends!
episodes_data.description: On the legendary Treasure Island, Luffy and crew encounter strange animals and an even stranger man named Gaimon.

episodes_data.title: The Three-Sword Style's Past! Zoro and Kuina's Vow!
episodes_data.description: In the past, young Zoro sparred constantly with a girl named Kuina, but he could never claim victory. They vowed that one of them would someday be the world`s greatest swordsman - but tragedy intervened.

episodes_data.title: Famous Cook! Sanji of the Sea Restaurant!
episodes_data.description: The Straw Hats need a cook among their crew, so they head to a nearby restaurant and meet a passionate Sous Chef named Sanji.

episodes_data.title: Unwelcome Customer! Sanji's Food and Ghin's Debt!
episodes_data.description: Luffy witnesses the fighting prowess and compassionate nature of the Sous Chef Sanji. The good news: The Going Merry`s found a cook! The bad news: He has no intention of joining the crew!

episodes_data.title: The Strongest Pirate Fleet! Commodore Don Krieg!
episodes_data.description: The staff and patrons of the Baratie panic when Don Krieg arrives! The starving pirate begs for nourishment, only to find himself denied. Unable to see a wretch starve, Sanji steps in once again.

episodes_data.title: Protect Baratie! The Great Pirate, Red Foot Zeff!
episodes_data.description: Don Krieg promises further malice as he returns to his ship, but the threat to the Baratie proves short-lived as an even bigger threat arrives!

episodes_data.title: Hawk-Eye Mihawk! The Great Swordsman Zoro Falls at Sea!
episodes_data.description: The Going Merry`s been stolen by Nami, and the showdown for possession of the Baratie is delayed. But the action`s not dead in the water - Zoro challenges Hawk-Eye Mihawk to a duel!

episodes_data.title: The Deadly Foot Technique Bursts Forth! Sanji vs. the Invincible Pearl!
episodes_data.description: The battle begins for possession of the Baratie, with Zeff leading the cooks against Krieg`s pirates. Luffy and crew join the fray, but things aren`t looking too good!

episodes_data.title: Zeff and Sanji's Dream! The Illusory All Blue!
episodes_data.description: Sanji recalls his childhood as an apprentice chef aboard a ship attacked by Red Foot Zeff! When the young Sanji found himself overboard, it was the fearsome captain himself who jumped to the rescue.

episodes_data.title: Cool-Headed, Cold-Hearted Demon! Pirate Fleet Chief Commander Ghin!
episodes_data.description: As the battle for Baratie rages on, Luffy is forced to take a drastic course of action and Ghin debates where his loyalties lie.

episodes_data.title: I Won't Die! Fierce Battle, Luffy vs. Krieg!
episodes_data.description: The scoundrel Don Krieg appears to have the upper hand in his fight with Luffy. To avoid walking the plank, the rubber man must try a different strategy.

episodes_data.title: The Conclusion of the Deadly Battle! A Spear of Blind Determination!
episodes_data.description: The standoff between Luffy and Don Krieg takes a turn in favor of the Straw Hats when their captain focuses his onslaught on his opponent`s weaponry.

episodes_data.title: Set Sail! The Seafaring Cook Sets Off with Luffy!
episodes_data.description: With Don Krieg defeated, Luffy tries to convince Sanji to join up with the Straw Hats. The skilled cook is interested, but he has something to prove before moving on.

episodes_data.title: The Worst Man in the Eastern Seas! Fishman Pirate Arlong!
episodes_data.description: With their culinary concerns in good hands, the Straw Hats set off in search of Nami - who`s on a collision course with a deadly foe!

episodes_data.title: Witch of Cocoyashi Village! Arlong's Female Leader!
episodes_data.description: Zoro is captured by Fishman Arlong and learns a shocking secret about Nami. Unable to believe his ears, he puts the navigator to the ultimate test.

episodes_data.title: Usopp Dead?! When Is Luffy Going to Make Landfall?!
episodes_data.description: Luffy and his crew make their way towards Arlong Park and a showdown with its fishy proprietor. Along the way, they discover a treasure map that raises more questions about Nami.

episodes_data.title: Everyone's Gathered! Usopp Speaks the Truth About Nami!
episodes_data.description: A fierce argument over where Nami`s loyalties lie divides the Straw Hat Pirates and only one thing`s for sure - no one is willing to risk their life for a traitor.

episodes_data.title: Untold Past! Female Warrior Bellemere!
episodes_data.description: Nami`s adopted sister, Nojiko arrives to fill in some details about the skilled mapmaker`s younger days.

episodes_data.title: Survive! Mother Bellemere and Nami's Bond!
episodes_data.description: Nojiko continues the story of Nami`s younger days. Back in the present, Nami gets agonizingly close to a long time goal, but betrayal looms on the horizon.

episodes_data.title: Luffy Rises! Result of the Broken Promise!
episodes_data.description: Nezumi comes to confiscate Nami`s treasure, but who`s he working for? More importantly, who`s Nami working for, and what`s she gonna do with her booty?

episodes_data.title: Luffy in Big Trouble! Fishmen vs. the Luffy Pirates!
episodes_data.description: The Straw Hats` faith in Nami is restored, and now it`s time for a battle royal! Luffy and the gang are determined to make Arlong pay for mistreating their friend.

episodes_data.title: Luffy Submerged! Zoro vs. Hatchan the Octopus!
episodes_data.description: The Straw Hats and Arlong`s fishmen are locked in a swashbuckling slugfest, but things take a bad turn when Luffy gets trapped beneath the waves.

episodes_data.title: Proud Warriors! Sanji and Usopp's Fierce Battles!
episodes_data.description: While his friends work to free the captain of the Straw Hats, cowardly Usopp finds himself in a position to shed his yellow streak and make his father proud.

episodes_data.title: Luffy at Full Power! Nami's Determination and the Straw Hat!
episodes_data.description: Nami must decide between letting Arlong maintain his hold over her, or joining the Straw Hats and leading the oppressed villagers against the tyrant fishman.

episodes_data.title: Explosion! Fishman Arlong's Fierce Assault from the Sea!
episodes_data.description: Arlong better watch his back-fins, because Captain Luffy knows about all the horrible things he did to Nami - and it makes his blood boil?

episodes_data.title: End of the Fishman Empire! Nami's My Friend!
episodes_data.description: Something about Nami`s former prison gives Luffy an added burst of strength. He`s so moved by her terrible past that he vows to destroy all of Arlong Park!

episodes_data.title: Setting Out with a Smile! Farewell, Hometown Cocoyashi Village!
episodes_data.description: After a grueling fight, Luffy defeats Arlong and succeeds in destroying his headquarters. The merry marauders enjoy the fruits of victory while Nami makes peace with her turbulent past.

episodes_data.title: Bounty! Straw Hat Luffy Becomes Known to the World!
episodes_data.description: Finally, the day has arrived where Luffy`s face is on an authentic wanted poster! Now there are enemies in hot pursuit as the crew makes waves for Logue Town - final resting place of Gold Roger!

episodes_data.title: Chase Straw Hat! Little Buggy's Big Adventure!
episodes_data.description: Buggy gets marooned on an island inhabited by unusual creatures and tangles with the island`s caretaker, Gaimon. If he is to finally destroy Luffy, Buggy must cast his lot with a mysterious woman.

episodes_data.title: The Wait Is Over! The Return of Captain Buggy!
episodes_data.description: The Buggy Pirates fight each other for the right to take their lost captain`s place. While they`re busy beating each other`s brains out, a cannibalistic tribe makes plans to have something special for dinner.

episodes_data.title: The Town of the Beginning and the End! Landfall at Logue Town!
episodes_data.description: The Straw Hats arrive at Logue Town, and each crewmember embarks upon a mission of a more personal nature. While his crew shops, Luffy goes in search of sacred ground.

episodes_data.title: Kitetsu III and Yubashiri! Zoro's New Swords and the Woman Sergeant Major!
episodes_data.description: Luffy has a run-in with Captain Smoker, and his failure to keep a low profile helps Buggy draw a bead on him. Elsewhere, Zoro takes a chance that his skill can overcome a dangerous curse.

episodes_data.title: Usopp vs. Daddy the Parent! Showdown at High!
episodes_data.description: Usopp finds an amazing pair of sharpshooter`s goggles, but they lead to a run in with Daddy the Parent - the greatest gunslinger ever! Now, the Straw Hat marksman is headed for the deadliest of all duels.

episodes_data.title: Fiery Cooking Battle? Sanji vs. the Beautiful Chef!
episodes_data.description: A cooking competition with the fiery chef Carmen rekindles Sanji`s dreams of the legendary All Blue.

episodes_data.title: Buggy's Revenge! The Man Who Smiles on the Execution Platform!
episodes_data.description: Buggy and his mysterious female ally trap Luffy on the same platform where Gold Roger was executed. He is to be killed for his offenses against Buggy, but Zoro and Sanji attempt a daring rescue mission.

episodes_data.title: The Legend Has Started! Head for the Grand Line!
episodes_data.description: As a storm batters Logue Town, Buggy, Alvida, and Captain Smoker close in on Luffy for a stirring final showdown!

episodes_data.title: Precursor to a New Adventure! Apis, a Mysterious Girl!
episodes_data.description: The discovery of a small girl adrift in an abandoned life boat interrupts Luffy and his crew`s voyage to the Grand Line.

episodes_data.title: Miraculous Creature! Apis' Secret and the Legendary Island!
episodes_data.description: After escaping the clutches of the Marine fleet, the Straw Hats soon find themselves in an equally dangerous predicament - stranded in the Calm Belt!

episodes_data.title: Eric Attacks! Great Escape from Warship Island!
episodes_data.description: The Straw Hats want to return Apis`s dragon to his nest, but the Marines have them surrounded. Looks like it`s time for another daring escape!

episodes_data.title: A Solitary Island in the Distant Sea! The Legendary Lost Island!
episodes_data.description: Even for Nami, finding the dragon`s lost island proves to be tougher than looking for a needle in a haystack - or at the bottom of the ocean.

episodes_data.title: Showdown in the Ruins! Tense Zoro vs. Eric!
episodes_data.description: Nami discovers a map to the true location of the dragon`s nest, and Zorro puts his steel to the test against Eric the Whirlwind.

episodes_data.title: Luffy, Completely Surrounded! Commodore Nelson's Secret Strategy!
episodes_data.description: The Straw Hats sail headfirst into Commodore Nelson and his Marine armada. While Luffy, Sanji, and Zoro dodge cannon balls, Eric the Whirlwind prepares a sneak attack!

episodes_data.title: Through the Sky They Soar! The 1000 Year Legend Lives Again!
episodes_data.description: With their rescue mission taking on water, the Straw Hats get some surprising help from the great blue yonder.

episodes_data.title: An Angry Showdown! Cross the Red Line!
episodes_data.description: After unlocking the secrets of the dragon`s nest, Luffy does battle with Eric the Whirlwind to ensure the safety of the island. Don`t mess with the rubberman!

episodes_data.title: The First Line of Defense? The Giant Whale Laboon Appears!
episodes_data.description: The Straw Hat crew takes a wild ride up and down a mountain only to end up in the belly of a giant whale that`s on the lookout for pirates!

episodes_data.title: A Promise Between Men! Luffy and the Whale Vow to Meet Again!
episodes_data.description: Luffy trades blows with Laboon the whale, and Nami is distressed to learn that navigating the Grand Line is no easy feat.

episodes_data.title: A Town That Welcomes Pirates? Setting Foot on Whisky Peak!
episodes_data.description: A violent snow storm batters the crew of the Going Merry, but once the Straw Hats arrive at Whisky Peak, the locals invite them to a raucous celebration.

episodes_data.title: Explosion! The Three Swords Style! Zoro vs. Baroque Works!
episodes_data.description: There are bounty hunters on the prowl, and most of the Straw Hats are dead drunk. Only Zoro is still sober enough to hoist a sword.

episodes_data.title: All-out Battle! Luffy vs. Zoro, Mysterious Grand Duel!
episodes_data.description: There`s a mysterious princess that needs protection from a nose-picking assassin, but Luffy and Zoro are too busy duking it out to worry about explosive boogers.

episodes_data.title: Deliver Princess Vivi! The Luffy Pirates Set Sail!
episodes_data.description: The Straw Hats depart Whisky Peak on a mission to return the Princess of Alabasta to her kingdom while protecting her from an army of vicious assassins.

episodes_data.title: Try Hard, Coby! Coby and Helmeppo's Struggles in the Marines
episodes_data.description: While the crew heads for Little Garden with the princess, Luffy and Zorro`s old nemesis, Axe-Hand Morgan, escapes from a Marine prison ship.

episodes_data.title: Coby and Helmeppo's Resolve! Vice-Admiral Garp's Parental Affection!
episodes_data.description: Colby and Helmeppo train day and night to prove they`re tough enough to be Marines. A violent showdown with Vice-Admiral Garp will determine if they`re worth their salt.

episodes_data.title: An Ancient Island! The Shadow Hiding in Little Garden!
episodes_data.description: Luffy`s gang is running low on supplies, so they stop at Little Garden to find something to eat. Unfortunately for them, it might end up the other way around.

episodes_data.title: Huge Duel! The Giants Dorry and Broggy!
episodes_data.description: Not only are there dinosaurs running wild on the island of Little Garden, but the Straw Hats soon find themselves in the middle of a gargantuan grudge match.

episodes_data.title: Luffy Gets Angry! A Dirty Trick Violates the Sacred Duel!
episodes_data.description: Usopp and Luffy are fascinated by the endless battle waged between Dorry and Broggy; however, fascination turns to outrage when Monkey catches a whiff of treachery.

episodes_data.title: Broggy's Bitter Tears of Victory! The Conclusion of Elbaf!
episodes_data.description: Luffy`s blood boils for revenge against the assassins who sabotaged Dorry and Broggy`s battle, but he`s currently trapped between a rock and a hard place.

episodes_data.title: The Devilish Candle! Tears of Regret and Tears of Anger!
episodes_data.description: While Luffy struggles to free himself, his friends fall into the hands of Baroque Works. Though the odds are against them, the Straw Hats will never give up!

episodes_data.title: A Hex on Luffy! Colors Trap!
episodes_data.description: Nami, Zorro, and the Princess are in danger of becoming exhibits in a fiendish artist`s collection, and only Luffy can save them. But he`s busy having a cup of tea.

episodes_data.title: Time to Fight Back! Usopp's Quick Thinking and Fire Star!
episodes_data.description: With his friends about to be permanently entombed in wax, Usopp is provided with the perfect opportunity to be brave and make his father proud.

episodes_data.title: Farewell Giant Island! Head for Alabasta!
episodes_data.description: After narrowly avoiding death, Luffy`s crew and the Princess set sail for Alabasta, but something large and dangerous looms in their path.

episodes_data.title: Nami's Sick? Beyond the Snow Falling on the Stars!
episodes_data.description: Nami comes down with a terrible fever and the Straw Hats don`t know what to do. Looks like the Grand Line might claim another victim.

episodes_data.title: A Raid! The Tin Tyrant and Tin Plate Wapol!
episodes_data.description: The Straw Hats continue their quest to find a doctor for Nami. Along the way, they deal with a ravenous invader and get a chilly reception from local islanders.

episodes_data.title: An Island Without Doctors? Adventure in a Nameless Land!
episodes_data.description: Luffy and Sanji make a bold trek up a snow-covered mountain in search of a witch who might hold the key to curing Nami.

episodes_data.title: Are You Happy? The Doctor Called Witch!
episodes_data.description: Ferocious, giant, snow rabbits slow Luffy and Sanji`s progress up the mountain. Meanwhile, the former king Wapol returns to the town he abandoned.

episodes_data.title: Dalton's Resolve! Wapol's Corps Land on the Island!
episodes_data.description: Nami hovers near death while Luffy and Sanji fend off the abominable rabbits. Back at the village, Dalton leads a revolt against the dastardly Wapol.

episodes_data.title: The Island Where Snow Lives! Climb the Drum Rockies!
episodes_data.description: An unlikely source acts as a roadblock to give Luffy some climbing room, and Zorro emerges from a snow bank cold, cranky, and ready to rumble!

episodes_data.title: Blue-Nosed Reindeer! Chopper's Secret!
episodes_data.description: After a long journey up the mountain, Nami finally receives much-needed medical attention, but Sanji and Luffy are more interested in eating the doctor!

episodes_data.title: An Outcast's Dream! Hiriluk the Quack!
episodes_data.description: Luffy recruits Tony Tony Chopper to join the Straw Hat crew as the ship`s doctor.

episodes_data.title: Hiriluk's Cherry Blossoms and the Will That Gets Carried On!
episodes_data.description: Chopper`s first friend was a quack doctor who couldn`t cure a cold, but the old man still managed to teach the little reindeer how to care for people.

episodes_data.title: Fight Wapol's Crew! The Power of the Munch Munch Fruit!
episodes_data.description: Luffy unleashes the full force of his Gum Gum furry on Wapol, and Chopper is amazed by the rubberman`s fierce devotion to the pirate flag.

episodes_data.title: Zoan-Type Devil Fruit! Chopper's Seven-Form Transformation!
episodes_data.description: When Wapol orders his goons to attack the Straw Hats, Chopper shows off a little something he calls the Rumble Ball!

episodes_data.title: When the Kingdom's Rule Ends! The Flag of Faith Flies Forever!
episodes_data.description: Wapol attacks Nami in her weakened condition, but Monkey D. Luffy is quick to step in and even the odds.

episodes_data.title: Hiriluk's Cherry Blossoms! Miracle in the Drum Rockies!
episodes_data.description: After an explosive battle with Wapol, Luffy begins the tiring process of convincing Chopper to join his pirate gang.

episodes_data.title: Goodbye Drum Island! I'm Going Out to Sea!
episodes_data.description: Chopper sets sail for Alabasta with his new friends, and Dalton thinks back to his first meeting with Princess Vivi.

episodes_data.title: Alabasta's Hero and a Ballerina on the Ship!
episodes_data.description: The Straw Hats rescue a man of many faces as they approach Alabasta. Sure, he`s good for a laugh, but they may regret pulling him out of the drink.

episodes_data.title: Off to the Desert Kingdom! The Rain-Summoning Powder and the Rebel Army!
episodes_data.description: The Straw Hats arrive in Alabasta with precious little time to stop the rebellion. Sanji and Chopper are sent to gather supplies for a dangerous trip across the desert.

episodes_data.title: The Heroes' Reunion! His Name Is Fire Fist Ace!
episodes_data.description: Captain Smoker has Luffy in his grasp until a fiery stranger creates a diversion, giving the Straw Hats a chance to make a break for it.

episodes_data.title: Ace and Luffy! Hot Emotions and Brotherly Bonds!
episodes_data.description: Ace and Luffy`s happy reunion is crudely interrupted by the Billions of Baroque Works. They may be outnumbered, but these brothers are no ordinary pirates!

episodes_data.title: Erumalu, the City of Green and the Kung Fu Dugongs!
episodes_data.description: Before they can start their trek across the desert, Luffy and the Straw Hats are stopped at the shore by the cute - but formidable - Kung Fu Dugongs.

episodes_data.title: Adventure in the Country of Sand! The Monsters That Live in the Scorching Land!
episodes_data.description: Luffy`s crew encounters treacherous birds and man-eating foliage on its desert odyssey, and just when they think the coast is clear, a great disturbance emerges from beneath the sand!

episodes_data.title: Enter the Desert Pirates! The Men Who Live Freely!
episodes_data.description: The Straw Hats cross paths with the Barbar Sand Pirates, and Ace runs into big trouble when he gets separated from the group.

episodes_data.title: False Fortitude! Camu, Rebel Soldier at Heart!
episodes_data.description: Princess Vivi devises a plan to test the hearts of a gang of so-called rebels. They talk a good game, but will their bite measure up to their bark?

episodes_data.title: Rebel Warrior Koza! The Dream Vowed to Vivi!
episodes_data.description: The Straw Hats continue their journey to Yuba, where a bittersweet reunion with a childhood friend awaits Princess Vivi.

episodes_data.title: Showdown in a Heat Haze! Ace vs. the Gallant Scorpion!
episodes_data.description: Fire Fist Ace is hired by two young boys to hunt down and capture a lethal bounty hunter known only as the Scorpion.

episodes_data.title: Ruins and Lost Ways! Vivi, Her Friends, and the Country's Form!
episodes_data.description: Chopper, Zoro, and Luffy get separate from the others. When the heat makes Luffy act even stranger than usual, his friends wonder if they joined the right pirate gang.

episodes_data.title: Spiders Cafe at 8 o'Clock! The Enemy Leaders Gather!
episodes_data.description: The assassins of Baroque Works gather at Spider`s Cafe, and the Straw Hats arrive at Yuba only to find it buried in sand.

episodes_data.title: Luffy vs. Vivi! The Tearful Vow to Put Friends on the Line
episodes_data.description: Crocodile reveals himself to the Baroque Works assassins and discloses his dastardly plan for Alabasta. After departing Yuba, Luffy takes a stand that forces Vivi to rethink her mission.

episodes_data.title: The Battlefront of Alabasta! Rainbase, the City of Dreams
episodes_data.description: Vivi takes Luffy`s advice, and the Straw Hats head towards Rainbase for a confrontation with Crocodile. Karoo finally reaches the palace with Vivi`s warning for King Cobra.

episodes_data.title: The Trap of Certain Defeat! Storming Raindinners!
episodes_data.description: Luffy leads a daring - but foolish - raid on Crocodile`s casino. His poor planning lands him behind bars with Captain Smoker - and more importantly, leaves Vivi unprotected.

episodes_data.title: Operation Utopia Commences! The Swell of Rebellion Stirs!
episodes_data.description: While the Straw Hats are stuck in the clink, King Cobra addresses the starving people of Nanohana. Will his unbelievable revelation drive his subjects past the brink of rebellion?

episodes_data.title: The Terrifying Banana Gators and Mr. Prince!
episodes_data.description: A royal impostor has the rebel army hell-bent on bringing Cobra`s reign to a violent end. Meanwhile, Luffy and his mates find themselves in deep trouble and even deeper water.

episodes_data.title: The Key to a Great Comeback Escape! The Wax-Wax Ball!
episodes_data.description: Sanji shows up in the nick of time to make the crocs cough up the key to Luffy`s freedom, but the ravenous reptiles spit up something else instead.

episodes_data.title: Merciless Mortal Combat! Luffy vs. Crocodile
episodes_data.description: Crocodile snatches Vivi off the back of a giant crab, but Luffy`s not having it. The rubber-man goes toe-to-toe with the sandman in a battle that will end in bloodshed.

episodes_data.title: Dash for a Miracle! Alabasta Animal Land
episodes_data.description: Crocodile puts Luffy down for a never-ending dirt nap, and the Straw Hats get a lift from a crabby ally in their race to stop the looming rebellion.

episodes_data.title: Rebel Army vs. Royal Army! Showdown at Alubarna
episodes_data.description: Vivi arrives in Alubarna with just enough time to stop the rebellion, but the agents of Baroque Works lurk in every corner, waiting to sabotage her plans for peace.

episodes_data.title: Alubarna Grieves! The Fierce Captain Karoo
episodes_data.description: Sanji buys Vivi some time by mixing it up with a foe of many faces. Outside Alubarna`s walls, Chopper and Usopp tangle with Miss Merry Christmas and her slugging sidekick.

episodes_data.title: Sworn on a Friend's Dream! The Battle of Molehill, Block 4
episodes_data.description: Usopp finally shows some courage by using a five-ton hammer to play whack-a-mole with Miss Merry Christmas. He may be bluffing, but the distraction lets Chopper zero in on the enemy`s weakness.

episodes_data.title: Big Opening Day Today! The Copy-Copy Montage
episodes_data.description: Chopper`s Rumble Ball could be the difference between life and death in the mole ballgame. Elsewhere, Sanji has trouble kicking a pretty enemy, and Vivi proposes something unthinkable.

episodes_data.title: Transformed into Nami! Bon Clay's Rapid-Fire Ballet Kenpo!
episodes_data.description: Vivi continues preparations to blow up the palace; Zorro puts his steel to the test against a lethal blade-man; and Sanji tries to overcome his inability to kick a foxy lady!

episodes_data.title: Nami's Cyclone Advisory! Clima Tact Burst!
episodes_data.description: Things don`t look good for the prettiest Straw Hat. Nami`s about to tangle with a thorny adversary, and the weapon Usopp built her is only good for party tricks!

episodes_data.title: Secret Passed Down in the Royal Family! The Ancient Weapon Pluton!
episodes_data.description: Crocodile reveals his sinister motives for attacking Alabasta, and Nami tries to end her duel with Miss Doublefinger by unleashing the Clima Tact`s ultimate weapon: a devastatingly lethal tornado!

episodes_data.title: Secret of Powerful Swordplay! Ability to Cut Steel and the Rhythm Things Have!
episodes_data.description: Zoro hopes to attain a new level of strength when he fights a foe with a body made of blades. The Straw Hat sword-slinger is determined to become a man who can cut steel - or die trying.

episodes_data.title: The Battle Is Over! Koza Raises the White Flag!
episodes_data.description: Koza - the leader of the rebel army - finally discovers the evil mastermind behind Alabasta`s drought, but is he too late to prevent further bloodshed?

episodes_data.title: Where Vivi's Voice Gets Heard! The Hero Descends!
episodes_data.description: When Koza is mysteriously shot, the rebellion is reborn, but Vivi`s cries for a cease fire fall on deaf ears until a long-overdue hero swoops to the rescue!

episodes_data.title: Sand Croc and Water Luffy! The Second Round of the Duel!
episodes_data.description: Luffy finally discovers the secret to knocking out a sandman, but it won`t matter unless Vivi and the rest of the Straw Hats can locate the Baroque Works bomber.

episodes_data.title: That Looks Croc-ish! Luffy, Run to the Royal Tomb!
episodes_data.description: While his mates search for a bomb, Luffy narrowly survives his second scrape with Crocodile. Across town, Nico Robin strong-arms Cobra into revealing his country`s greatest secret.

episodes_data.title: The Nightmare Draws Near! This Is the Sand-Sand Clan's Secret Base
episodes_data.description: With the walls crumbling down around them, Crocodile attacks Luffy with a poisoned pirate hook. Meanwhile, Vivi draws a bead on the bombers, but can she stop them in time?

episodes_data.title: Magnificent Wings! My Name Is Pell, Guardian Deity of the Country
episodes_data.description: The Straw Hats team up to give Vivi one last shot at disarming the bomb that threatens to destroy her city. She succeeds in cutting the fuse, but Crocodile has a backup plan.

episodes_data.title: I Will Surpass You! Rain Falls in Arabasta!
episodes_data.description: Pell`s sacrifice spares his beloved city, but only an act of god can stop the rebellion. With Crocodile`s poison coursing through his body, Luffy musters a final attack against Alabasta`s oppressor.

episodes_data.title: A Farewell to Arms! Pirates and Different Ideas of Justice!
episodes_data.description: Crocodile is defeated, the rain has returned to Alabasta, and Vivi`s people are eager to rebuild their kingdom. As for the Straw Hats, they have a fleet of marines breathing down their necks.

episodes_data.title: The Pirates' Banquet and Operation Escape from Alabasta!
episodes_data.description: Now that the rebellion is over, Vivi must make an important decision about her future. The Straw Hats are ready to hoist the anchor, but an ambiguous villain has stolen the Going Merry!

episodes_data.title: It All Started on That Day...! Vivi Tells the Story of Her Adventure!
episodes_data.description: Mr. 2 is a man of many faces, but he finally shows his true colors when the marines attack the Straw Hats. Elsewhere, Vivi has a scheme up her sleeve, and it involves Igaram wearing a dress.

episodes_data.title: Scent of Danger! The Seventh Member Is Nico Robin!
episodes_data.description: Luffy and his crew watch Alabasta fade into the distance, but there`s no time for reminiscing. The marines are in hot pursuit, and there`s a stowaway aboard the Going Merry!

episodes_data.title: The First Patient! The Untold Story of the Rumble Ball!
episodes_data.description: Fresh off their adventure Alabasta, the Straw Hats discover an isolated island where they can restock their food supply. Chopper is left to guard the ship, but he and Nico spend the afternoon exploring instead!

episodes_data.title: Uprising of the Navigator! For the Unyielding Dream!
episodes_data.description: When a mail-order salesman gets lost at sea, Nami finds the paper she needs to start making maps. If the Straw Hat crew can somehow manage to survive a deadly cyclone, she might actually get some use out of it!

episodes_data.title: A Recipe Handed Down! Sanji, the Iron Man of Curry
episodes_data.description: Heavy fog leads to a close encounter of the culinary kind when Nico fishes a marine out of the drink. The aspiring chef is concerned about the quality of his curry, and Sanji is just the guy to refine his recipe!

episodes_data.title: I Will Make It Bloom! Usopp the Man and the Eight-Foot Shell!
episodes_data.description: A break in the rain provides the perfect opportunity for Usopp to help a young girl fulfill her dream of launching the world`s largest firework.

episodes_data.title: The Fabled Pirate Hunter! Zoro, The Wandering Swordsman
episodes_data.description: Money troubles force Zoro to tangle with Dick the Bandit and his treacherous gang of thugs. These gun-toting outlaws are terrorizing a peaceful village, and the Straw Hat swordsman aims to stop their reign of terror!

episodes_data.title: Zenny of the Island of Goats and the Pirate Ship in the Mountains!
episodes_data.description: A barrage of Marine cannon balls forces the Straw Hats to seek refuge on an uncharted island. Once ashore, the crew encounters a strange old man living amongst a herd of goats.

episodes_data.title: How's Tricks? The Designs of Zenny the Moneylender!
episodes_data.description: Old man Zenny made a fortune lending money to scallywags, but he always dreamed of becoming a pirate himself. When the marines set out to trap the Straw Hats, the wily hermit may finally get his wish!

episodes_data.title: Whereabouts of the Island Treasure! Attack of the Zenny Pirates!
episodes_data.description: Zenny gets more than he bargained for when he embarks on his maiden pirate voyage. The Straw Hats may have made a friend for life, but what are they gonna do about those pesky marines?

episodes_data.title: Legend of the Rainbow Mist! Old Man Henzo of Luluka Island
episodes_data.description: The Straw Hats stop for supplies at a harbor town plagued by a mayor who taxes anything and everything. Over lunch, Luffy and Nico befriend a kooky scientist who`s obsessed with the Rainbow Mist.

episodes_data.title: Residents of the Land of Eternity! The Pumpkin Pirates
episodes_data.description: Luffy, Usopp, Nico, and Zoro get trapped in the Rainbow Mist along with Henzo. The aging scientist is looking for answers, the Straw Hats want treasure, and the ghosts who haunt the mist want them all to leave!

episodes_data.title: Thoughts of Home! The Pirate Graveyard of No Escape!
episodes_data.description: Luffy and his crew search for a way out of Ape`s Concert, but the Rainbow Mist is an inescapable maze of madness. Back on shore, Nami, Chopper, and Sanji face a lifetime of hard labor for failing to pay their taxes!

episodes_data.title: An Inevitable Melee! Wetton's Schemes and the Rainbow Tower
episodes_data.description: Nami enters the mist on a mission to save her mates - and maybe hunt for treasure while she`s at it. The local mayor wants her dead, but the Straw Hats are being protected by a mysterious marine.

episodes_data.title: And So, the Legend Begins! To the Other Side of the Rainbow
episodes_data.description: The showdown with Mayor Wetton builds towards an explosive finale as the Straw Hats scramble to escape the Rainbow Mist - or be trapped inside forever.

episodes_data.title: Caught Log! The King of Salvagers, Masira!
episodes_data.description: The Straw Hats are nearly crushed by the falling wreckage of a ship that`s over 200 years old. Could rumors of a floating island in the sky be true? Luffy, Zoro, and Sanji go scuba diving to find out!

episodes_data.title: Monsters Appear! Don't Mess with the White Beard Pirates!
episodes_data.description: Still searching for a route to the island in the sky, the Straw Hats chart a course for Jaya. Meanwhile, Fire-Fist Ace crashes a party aboard a vessel helmed by Buggy the Pirate!

episodes_data.title: Quit Dreaming! Mock Town, the Town of Ridicule!
episodes_data.description: The Straw Hats drop anchor at a town overrun by scallywags, so Nami makes the boys swear to stay out of trouble. But when the Bellamy Pirates come looking for a fight, Luffy may have to break his promise!

episodes_data.title: Distinguished Pirates! A Man Who Talks of Dreams and the King of Undersea Search!
episodes_data.description: Nico`s handy work unearths a solitary dreamer who may know the way to Sky Island. All Luffy and his crew have to do is survive the sonic onslaught of simian salvagers seeking to sink the Going Merry!

episodes_data.title: Legendary Family! Noland, the Liar!
episodes_data.description: Luffy and his mates reach the home of Mont Blanc Cricket: the man with the key to reaching Sky Island. There`s just one tiny problem - he comes from a long line of legendary liars.

episodes_data.title: Steer for the Clouds! Capture the South Bird!
episodes_data.description: Montblanc Cricket agrees to help the Straw Hats reach Sky Island, but first they must venture deep into the darkest depths of a spider-infested forest to capture a mysterious bird with a keen sense of direction.

episodes_data.title: Dreams Don't Come True?! Bellamy vs. the Saruyama Alliance!
episodes_data.description: While the Straw Hats battle creepy-crawly forest creatures on their quest to capture a South Bird, Mont Blanc and his monkey minions are brutally attacked by the Bellamy Pirates!

episodes_data.title: 100 Million Man! World's Greatest Power and Pirate Black Beard!
episodes_data.description: Luffy turned the other cheek during his first encounter with Bellamy, but now he`s out to settle the score for old man Mont Blanc. Meanwhile, a fearsome pirate crew takes aim at the Straw Hats, eager to earn a bad reputation!

episodes_data.title: Take to the Sky! Ride the Knockup Stream!
episodes_data.description: Thanks to some modifications to the Going Merry, the Straw Hats are on their way to that island in the sky! But with the Blackbeard Pirates in hot pursuit, navigating the vertical currents will be anything but easy.

episodes_data.title: Sail the White Sea! The Sky Knight and the Gate in the Clouds!
episodes_data.description: Reaching the sea of clouds proves easier than surviving in it when giant sea creatures attack the Going Merry, Usopp nearly drowns in a cloud, and a strange sky knight issues the Straw Hats a warning!

episodes_data.title: Godland, Skypiea! Angels on a Beach of Clouds!
episodes_data.description: After hitching a ride on a speedy shrimp, the Straw Hats reach the land of Skypiea! The intrepid pirates have much to learn about their new surroundings, but a beautiful angel makes a perfect tour guide.

episodes_data.title: The Forbidden Sacred Ground! The Island Where God Lives and Heaven's Judgment!
episodes_data.description: Nami`s eagerness to explore the forbidden realm of Upper Yard brings her face to face with the wrath of god, and the Straw Hats incur Heaven`s Judgment for failing to pay their immigration fees!

episodes_data.title: Already Criminals?! Skypiea's Upholder of the Law!
episodes_data.description: The Straw Hats are no strangers to living on the wrong side of the law, but unpaid immigration fees and Nami`s assault of a White Beret earns Luffy`s crew a sentence of death by cloud drifting!

episodes_data.title: Is Escape Possible?! God's Challenge Is Set in Motion!
episodes_data.description: Nami, Zoro, Chopper, and Robin are trapped aboard the Going Merry when it`s commandeered by a monstrous lobster! To rescue his crew, Luffy must venture onto the sacred grounds of Upper Yard!

episodes_data.title: A Trap on Lovely Street! The Almighty Eneru!
episodes_data.description: Conis helps Luffy and his mates launch their rescue mission, but the rubber-man senses something amiss. When he presses her for answers, a vengeful god takes a shot at the Straw Hats!

episodes_data.title: Onward, Crow! To the Sacrificial Altar!
episodes_data.description: Zoro dukes it out with a hungry Skyshark in the shadow of the Sacrificial Alter. On the other side of Upper Yard, Luffy, Sanji, and Usopp try to survive their visit to an island that wants them dead!

episodes_data.title: 10% Survival Rate! Satori, the Mantra Master!
episodes_data.description: Luffy, Sanji, and Usopp tangle with Satori and his exploding, snake-filled Surprise Clouds. The sky priest may look like a dancing dango, but the impact of his mantra leaves the pirates bloodied and boatless.

episodes_data.title: The Ordeal of Spheres! Desperate Struggle in the Lost Forest!
episodes_data.description: Usopp and Sanji try to regain control of the Crow, and Luffy stirs up a brutal barrage of bursting balls when he attacks Satori. Meanwhile, Chopper whistles for the Sky Knight to avoid becoming a sacrificial reindeer!

episodes_data.title: Chopper in Danger! Former God vs. Priest Shura!
episodes_data.description: Chopper fights bravely to stop Shura from incinerating the Going Merry, but the little reindeer is no match for a sky priest. Gan Fall is on his way, but will the dispossessed deity arrive in time?

episodes_data.title: Profound Mystery! Ordeal of String and Ordeal of Love?
episodes_data.description: When Gan Fall is badly burned during his battle with Shura, Chopper musters the courage for a death-defying leap of faith. Elsewhere, Luffy may have finally discovered a way to defeat Satori!

episodes_data.title: Light the Fire of Shandora! Wyper, the Warrior!
episodes_data.description: The Shandorians prepare for an all-out attack on their priestly adversaries, Chopper meets the mysterious creatures that saved his life, and Nami makes an astonishing discovery about the origins of Upper Yard.

episodes_data.title: Jaya, City of Gold in the Sky! Head for God's Shrine!
episodes_data.description: While the Shandorians continue their battle for control of Upper Yard, the Straw Hats celebrate their happy reunion by swapping stories over a campfire and feasting on barbequed Skyshark!

episodes_data.title: Festival on the Night Before Gold-Hunting! Feelings for Vearth!
episodes_data.description: Laki`s pursuit of precious Vearth causes one of her Shandorian comrades to be injured during the battle with Ohm. As night falls on Upper Yard, the Straw Hats dream of gold while dancing with wolves!

episodes_data.title: Enter God Eneru! Farewell to the Survivors!
episodes_data.description: The electrifying deity of Skypiea, God Eneru, grants his priests unlimited power in their hunt for the Straw Hats. Usopp has a plan to get the mysteriously-repaired Going Merry back in the water, but it involves using Chopper as bait!

episodes_data.title: A Giant Snake Bares Its Fangs! The Survival Game Begins!
episodes_data.description: The Straw Hats scatter when their search for gold uncovers a giant python, and Gan Fall reveals the tragic story of Jaya`s arrival in the sky. Meanwhile, Wyper readies the Shandorians for a raid on Eneru`s shrine!

episodes_data.title: The Deadly Reject! War Demon Wyper's Resolve!
episodes_data.description: As the heartless god of Upper Yard eagerly anticipates the dawning of Sky Warefare, the Shandorian forces are savagely snared by the Ordeal of String, and Luffy wanders into the fight of his life!

episodes_data.title: Fierce Midair Battle! Pirate Zoro vs. Warrior Braham!
episodes_data.description: Zoro rushes to perfect a deadly technique known as the Flying Blade Attack. The move proves difficult to master, but it could be the key to the swordsman surviving a battle with the Shandorian warrior, Braham.

episodes_data.title: The Roaring Burn Bazooka! Luffy vs. War Demon Wyper!
episodes_data.description: Sanji and Usopp are driven to their knees by the electrifying presence of god, Luffy is nearly incinerated by Wyper`s Burn Bazooka, and Nami joins Gan Fall in a fight against two killer clones!

episodes_data.title: The Ordeal of the Swamp! Chopper vs. Sky Punk Gedatsu!
episodes_data.description: Chopper unleashes the fury of his Rumble Ball during a sticky slugfest with a swap cloud spewing priest of Upper Yard. Can the little reindeer discover his opponent`s lone weakness before it`s too late?

episodes_data.title: Unbeatable Powers! Eneru's True Form Is Revealed!
episodes_data.description: Nami and the Knight of the Sky team up to obliterate two bumbling, balloon-shaped bad guys, and God Eneru relies on his astounding invincibility to torment a noble Shandorian warrior.

episodes_data.title: A Mystical City! The Grand Ruins of Shandora!
episodes_data.description: Robin`s search for a mystical city of gold is interrupted by Yama, one of Eneru`s faithful servants. When the rampaging warrior destroys some ancient ruins, he provokes the wrath of Robin`s many fists of fury!

episodes_data.title: 0% Survival Rate! Chopper vs. Ohm, the Sword Wielding Priest!
episodes_data.description: Priest Ohm silences Chopper with an attack from which few - if any - ever recover. Meanwhile, Luffy begins to notice something strange about his cave-like prison, and four fearsome warriors prepare for battle!

episodes_data.title: Climb Giant Jack! Deadly Combat in the Upper Ruins!
episodes_data.description: Zoro, Gan Fall, Wyper, Ohm and a prizefighting pooch gather for a ferocious free-for-all at the site of the Upper Ruins. While the battle rages, Luffy tries to punch his way out of the belly of a poisonous python!

episodes_data.title: The Ordeal of Iron! White Barbed Death Match!
episodes_data.description: Zoro and Wyper are out to beat down the same bad guys, but will they realize it soon enough to survive a white-barbed death match of doom? Deep in the belly of the python, Nami and Luffy enjoy what could be a short-lived reunion!

episodes_data.title: Bursting Slash! Zoro vs. Ohm!
episodes_data.description: Eager to end their battle, Zoro aims the awesome destructive power of his 108 Caliber Phoenix at the sinister Priest Ohm! Elsewhere, god demands that Robin help him search for a legendary golden bell.

episodes_data.title: Collapsing Upper Ruins! The Quintet for the Finale!
episodes_data.description: God Eneru begins a deadly rampage aimed at exterminating the heavenly beings of Skypiea, and the ruins of Shandora become the scene of bloody contest where survival is the name of the game.

episodes_data.title: Showdown in the Ancient Ruins! Sky God Eneru's Goal!
episodes_data.description: Gan Fall, Wyper, Zoro, and Robin join forces for an attack on God Eneru. Despite their furious onslaught, the four warriors prove powerless to harm the thunderous deity until Wyper utilizes the power of a mystical stone!

episodes_data.title: Ambition Toward the Endless Vearth! The Ark Maxim!
episodes_data.description: God Eneru makes a shocking recovery from wounds that should have ended his reign of terror. Zoro and Wyper muster the strength for one final stand, and Nami must choose between her friends - and survival.

episodes_data.title: They Finally Clash! Pirate Luffy vs. God Eneru!
episodes_data.description: Luffy emerges from his serpentine tomb with one thing on his mind: revenge! As the rubber-man sets out to settle the score with God Eneru, Conis rushes to warn her people of their impending doom!

episodes_data.title: Maxim Surfaces! Deathpiea Is Activated!
episodes_data.description: As the citizens of the sky run for their lives, Eneru issues in the dawn of Deathpiea! Luffy is determined to stop the madman, but first he must discover a way to lay hands on the heinous holy man!

episodes_data.title: Luffy Falls! Eneru's Judgment and Nami's Wish!
episodes_data.description: A handful of gold sends Luffy hurtling towards his death, Sanji and Usopp mount a midair rescue mission, and Nami prepares for an electrifying showdown with God Eneru!

episodes_data.title: The Two Awaken! On the Front Lines of the Burning Love Rescue!
episodes_data.description: Usopp arrives just in time to save Nami from a lethal thunderbolt, but even their combined powers are no match for Eneru. While they scramble for an escape route, Sanji stealthily searches for a way to sabotage god`s ark!

episodes_data.title: Capriccio for Despair! The Impending Doom of Sky Island!
episodes_data.description: Despite being slowed by an arm encased in gold, Luffy races up a giant beanstalk on a mission to settle the score with Eneru! Elsewhere, the people of Skypiea feel the jolt of god`s wrath!

episodes_data.title: Led by a Bell's Sound! Tale of the Great Warrior and the Explorer!
episodes_data.description: A flashback offers a glimpse at that lives of two legendary figures in Skypiea`s history: Montblanc Noland and the ferocious warrior Kalgara!

episodes_data.title: Free from the Spell! The Great Warrior Sheds Tears!
episodes_data.description: The look back at the legend of Montblanc Noland and Kalgara the warrior continues with the story of how these two very different men suddenly found friendship - and then lost it just as quickly!

episodes_data.title: Eternal Friends! The Vowed Bell Echoes Across the Mighty Seas!
episodes_data.description: Montblanc Noland and the warrior Kalgara succeed in settling their difference before parting ways, but the laws of nature and man conspire to keep them apart - permanently!

episodes_data.title: Angel Island Obliterated! The Horror of the Raigo's Advent!
episodes_data.description: Eneru strikes Angel Island with a devastating lightning bolt, and Luffy continues his heroic climb up the giant beanstalk. The rubber-man refuses to stop until he rings the golden bell - no matter what the cost!

episodes_data.title: Knock Over Giant Jack! Last Hope for Escape!
episodes_data.description: While Eneru continues his thunderous barrage, Nami hatches a plan to give Luffy one more shot at a grudge match with god. Zoro`s at the center of the scheme, but he might not survive his mission!

episodes_data.title: Miracle on Skypiea! The Love Song Heard in the Clouds!
episodes_data.description: Nami`s quick thinking gets Luffy closer to god, and the Straw Hat captain launches himself into the center of a sinister storm! Can he find a way to destroy Eneru`s looming cloud of death?

episodes_data.title: The Battle Ends! Proud Fantasia Echoes Far!
episodes_data.description: In the aftermath of Luffy`s epic battle with Eneru, sunny skies chase away the storms, and the cloud-dwelling citizens of Angel Island turn their attention to rebuilding their homeland.

episodes_data.title: I Made It Here! The Yarn the Poneglyphs Spin!
episodes_data.description: Robin attempts to decipher the riddle of a mysterious poneglyph, Usopp barters with the locals, and Luffy raids the priceless treasures of the legendary city of gold!

episodes_data.title: Off to the Blue Sea! A Heartfelt Finale!
episodes_data.description: With a little help from their new friends - and a giant octopus - the Straw Hats bid farewell to Skypiea and begin their decent back to the deep blue sea. Where they`ll land is anyone`s guess!

episodes_data.title: A State of Emergency Is Issued! A Notorious Pirate Ship Has Infiltrated!
episodes_data.description: After a frightening fall from the clouds, the Straw Hats find themselves trapped inside an impenetrable Marine stronghold. The crew gets separated, the Going Merry is impounded, and rumors of ghosts run rampant!

episodes_data.title: Sanji the Cook! Proving His Merit at the Marine Dining Hall!
episodes_data.description: While Nami searches for the Going Merry, Luffy and Sanji pose as famous chefs, only to end up competing in a cooking contest with a beautiful mistress of the galley!

episodes_data.title: Captured Zoro! Chopper's Emergency Operations!
episodes_data.description: Zoro is imprisoned and interrogated, and Chopper`s ill-chosen hiding spot lands him in the operating room along with a doctor who can`t stand the sight of blood!

episodes_data.title: The Marine's Dragnet Closes In! The Second Member Captured!
episodes_data.description: Luffy`s insatiable appetite betrays his true identity, and yet another member of his crew ends up in the brig when two Straw Hats try to fool Commander Jonathan with the same disguise!

episodes_data.title: Luffy and Sanji's Daring Rescue Mission!
episodes_data.description: Commander Jonathan sets a Straw Hat trap, but Luffy and Sanji are willing to risk it all to help spring their mates. Will a souvenir from the sky save the day - or will their escape plan be scuttled by foul play?

episodes_data.title: Enter the Hot-Blooded Special Forces! Battle on the Bridge!
episodes_data.description: Luffy and his gang make a break for the docks, and Commander Jonathan deploys armed guards in an attempt to slow down the Straw Hats. Only one thing is certain: somebody is going down for the count!

episodes_data.title: Breaking Through the Siege! The Going Merry Is Recovered!
episodes_data.description: The Straw Hats are surrounded, outnumbered, blasted with tear gas. Taking a pretty, young doctor hostage may be their only hope for surviving long enough for a Merry reunion!

episodes_data.title: The Pirate Ship Disappears! Fortress Battle, Round #2!
episodes_data.description: Luffy and his crew were almost in the clear when Nami made a horrifying discovery: the Marines stole their gold! Now, the Straw Hats must sail straight into the thick of the fight to reclaim their lost riches!

episodes_data.title: The Gold and Waver Recovery Operations!
episodes_data.description: Usopp hatches a plan for a moonlit raid on the Marine vault, but Commander Jonathan is has a nasty surprise waiting for the pirates! Meanwhile, Sanji and Nami attempt to recover the waver.

episodes_data.title: The One Fell Swoop Plan! Jonathan's Surefire Secret Tactic!
episodes_data.description: The extreme arrogance of a Marine special investigator clears a path for Luffy and company to make their escape! Unfortunately, the Straw Hats still have to find their gold before returning to the high seas!

episodes_data.title: Farewell, Marine Fortress! The Last Battle for Escape!
episodes_data.description: The Straw Hats may think they`re in the clear, but Commander Jonathan has one final trap waiting to ground the Going Merry! If Luffy`s crew is to escape, they`ll need a helping hand - or eight!

episodes_data.title: Great Adventure at Long Ring Long Land!
episodes_data.description: Luffy and his mates survive and near-death encounter with some mischievous sea monkeys only to land on a mysterious island where everything is much longer than it should be!

episodes_data.title: A Davy Back with the Foxy Pirates!
episodes_data.description: After a loyal horse and his recently-returned master are assaulted by thugs, Luffy is drawn into a Davy Back Fight with the Foxy Pirates. The Straw Hat captain never backs down from a challenge, but this contest could cost him his crew!

episodes_data.title: Round 1! One Lap of the Donut Race
episodes_data.description: The Davy Back Fight begins with a treacherous Donut Race around Ling Ring Long Land! The Straw Hats square off against the Foxy Pirates in a battle to see who loses a crew member!

episodes_data.title: Silver Fox Foxy! The Merciless Interference!
episodes_data.description: Nami uses her considerable skill as a navigator to put the Straw Hats on the verge of victory, but the captain of the Foxy Pirates has more than a few dirty tricks up his sleeve!

episodes_data.title: Round 2! Shoot It into the Groggy Ring!
episodes_data.description: Thanks to some foxy sabotage, Chopper has been lost to the enemy. The only hope for getting him back lies with Zoro and Sanji, but can they learn to work together in time to save the little reindeer?

episodes_data.title: A Barrage of Red Cards in Groggy Ring!
episodes_data.description: Sanji and Zoro take a beating at the hands of the Groggy Monsters, but they won`t give up the fight. With a little luck – and some teamwork - they`ll emerge victorious from round two of the Davy Back Fight!

episodes_data.title: Round 3! The Round-and-Round Roller Race!
episodes_data.description: Round three of the Davy Back Fight is a rip roaring roller derby! Chopper`s fate still hangs in the balance, and the Straw Hats have a huge problem: Luffy doesn`t know how to skate!

episodes_data.title: A Seriously Heated Race! Into the Final Round!
episodes_data.description: As the Davy Back Fight sprints toward a sensational finish, the Straw Hats find themselves on the brink of defeat! Luffy`s finally managed to stay on his skates, but the Foxy Pirates are notorious cheaters!

episodes_data.title: Screaming-Hot Bombardment! Pirate Dodgeball!
episodes_data.description: The Straw Hats somehow manage to defeat the Foxy Pirates and win back Chopper, but Luffy eagerly accepts the challenge of a rematch! What is the captain thinking? And will his crew mutiny?

episodes_data.title: Showdown on the Cliff! Red Light, Green Light!
episodes_data.description: A devious game of dodge ball costs the Straw Hats their archaeologist. Now, they`ll have to win an unusual uphill race to reclaim Robin and avoid losing another crew member!

episodes_data.title: The Captains Square Off! The Final Combat Round!
episodes_data.description: Robin and Chopper have both been lost to the Foxy Pirates, and there`s only one match remaining in the Davy Back Fight! Luffy`s got a plan to get his mates back, but failure would mean the end of the Straw Hats forever!

episodes_data.title: Full-Blast Slow-Slow Onslaught vs. Invulnerable Luffy!
episodes_data.description: Luffy and Captain Foxy go toe-to-toe in a brutal battle waged aboard a booby trapped boat. Luffy is fighting for his crew, but Captain Foxy`s dirty tricks have him on the ropes!

episodes_data.title: Epic, Heated Combat! The Fateful Final Conclusion!
episodes_data.description: Luffy`s epic battle with Captain Foxy reaches its riveting end, and a very old man with a very tall horse reunites with a face from very long ago.

episodes_data.title: Was It Lost? Stolen? Who Are You?
episodes_data.description: When Luffy and his mates lose their memory, Robin is the only Straw Hat who can remember their adventures together. Can she can she recover their recollections before the crew splits up?

episodes_data.title: A Mysterious Boy with a Horn and Robin's Deduction!
episodes_data.description: Robin tries to hold the crew together while unraveling the mystery of the missing memories. Meanwhile, Nami and Zoro flashback to painful moments from their pasts.

episodes_data.title: Now, Let's Get Back Our Memories! The Pirate Crew Lands on the Island
episodes_data.description: The Straw Hats finally discover the culprit behind their memory loss, but they`ve got bigger problems. The mysterious thief is determined to pit Zoro and Luffy against each other!

episodes_data.title: Zoro Bares His Fangs! A Savage Animal Stands in the Way!
episodes_data.description: Zoro and Luffy fight to the death, Nami attempts to orchestrate an uprising, and Sanji discovers he`s willing to kick a kid in order to get his memories back!

episodes_data.title: The Last Counterattack by the Memory Thief Who Reveals His True Colors!
episodes_data.description: The Straw Hats finally regain their memories, but a much larger challenge looms on the horizon. The mysterious thief is about to transform into something even more powerful!

episodes_data.title: Proud Man! Silver Fox Foxy!
episodes_data.description: A terrible storm leads to another run in with the devious Captain Foxy! When Luffy makes the dangerous decision to help his old foe, it could spell disaster for the Straw Hats!

episodes_data.title: The Guy Who's the Closest to Invincible? And the Most Dangerous Man!
episodes_data.description: Luffy and his mates must survive another outrageous battle aboard the Captain Foxy`s booby-trapped boat, and even if they survive, something far worse is awaits them!

episodes_data.title: Navy Headquarters Admiral Aokiji! The Ferocity of an Ultimate Powerhouse!
episodes_data.description: The Straw Hats take time out to help a group of hungry castaways, but trouble looms on the horizon. An icy marine adversary is out to track down Robin!

episodes_data.title: Duel Between Rubber and Ice! Luffy vs. Aokiji!
episodes_data.description: Chopper and Usopp work feverishly to save Robin from her icy tomb, and Luffy looks to settle the score with Admiral Aokiji in a man-to-man fight to the finish!

episodes_data.title: The Dashing Sea Train and the City of Water: Water Seven!
episodes_data.description: An encounter with a giant swimming frog leads to a close call with a seafaring train! Next up for the Straw Hats: drop anchor at a town full of water and seek out a shipwright!

episodes_data.title: Adventure in the City on the Water! Head to the Mammoth Shipbuilding Plant!
episodes_data.description: Luffy, Usopp, and Nami take a wild ride through Water Seven in search of a shipwright. Meanwhile, Chopper and Robin get separate during their quest to find a bookstore!

episodes_data.title: The Franky Family and Iceberg!
episodes_data.description: Zoro is attacked by thugs who want to cash in on his bounty, Sanji gets lost on a grocery shopping expedition, and three suitcases full of cash mysteriously go missing!

episodes_data.title: Galley-La Company! A Grand Sight: Dock #1!
episodes_data.description: A carpenter and his talking pigeon help recover the Straw Hats` missing money, but the Franky Family won`t give up so easily. Luffy and Nami receive very bad news about their beloved boat!

episodes_data.title: Pirate Abduction Incident! A Pirate Ship That Can Only Await Her End!
episodes_data.description: Luffy and Nami refuse to believe that the Going Merry`s seaworthy days are finished, but for now, bigger problems loom on the horizon! Their money is missing again, along with Usopp!

episodes_data.title: Rescuing Our Friend! Raid on the Franky House!
episodes_data.description: Usopp bravely tries to recover the stolen money, but the Franky Family has him badly outnumbered. Zoro, Sanji, and Chopper set out on a rescue mission, but they`ll need Luffy to even the odds!

episodes_data.title: Big Fight Under the Moon! The Pirate Flag Flutters with Sorrow!
episodes_data.description: Usopp regains consciousness after his vicious beating, but he`s not at all happy to hear Luffy`s plans for the Going Merry. Temper flares and challenges are issued as the Straw Hats face their most uncertain hour.

episodes_data.title: Luffy vs. Usopp! Collision of Two Men's Pride!
episodes_data.description: Luffy and Usopp battle to a brutal standstill in a heartbreaking duel between men who once called each other family. Can the Straw Hats find the strength to carry on without their sniper?

episodes_data.title: Severe Shock Hits the City of Water! Iceberg Targeted!
episodes_data.description: The Straw Hat split is overshadowed by an assassination attempt on the mayor of Water Seven! Luffy is eager to investigate, but the leader of the Franky Family is about to reappear!

episodes_data.title: Gum-Gum Human vs. Fire-Breathing Cyborg!
episodes_data.description: Luffy`s grudge match with Franky gets serious when his opponent turns out to be a cyborg! Iceberg awakes from his slumber only to hurl heinous accusations at the Straw Hats!

episodes_data.title: The Straw Hat Pirates Are the Culprits? The Protectors of the City of Water!
episodes_data.description: Luffy is branded an assassin and attacked by Iceberg`s strongest men! Meanwhile, Sanji and Chopper attempt to warn Usopp about an impending natural disaster!

episodes_data.title: Eternal Farewell? Nico Robin: The Woman Who Draws Darkness!
episodes_data.description: The citizens of Water Seven search for the Straw Hats, and a devastating storm threatens to sink the city. Chopper and Sanji pick up Robin`s trail, but they aren`t prepared for what they`ll find.

episodes_data.title: Capture Robin! The Determination of the Straw Hats!
episodes_data.description: Usopp prepares to ride out the storm aboard the Going Merry, Franky hatches a plan to force Luffy into a rematch, and the Straw Hats set out to uncover Robin`s dark secret.

episodes_data.title: Cannon Fire Is the Signal! CP9 Goes Into Action!
episodes_data.description: Robin and her CP9 brethren seek to settle unfinished business with Iceberg. The Straw Hats have a plan to clear their names, but the assassins are one step ahead of them.

episodes_data.title: CP9 Takes Off Their Masks! Their Shocking True Faces!
episodes_data.description: Luffy makes his long awaited entrance, Iceberg has a shocking surprise in store for Robin, and the true identities of the masked assassins of CP9 are finally revealed!

episodes_data.title: Secret Bond! Iceberg and Franky!
episodes_data.description: CP9 listens to Iceberg`s blood to learn to the location of the blueprints, Usopp has another run in with Franky, and the remaining Straw Hats – plus a new friend – race to the rescue!

episodes_data.title: Come Back, Robin! Showdown with CP9!
episodes_data.description: Luffy and the gang come face to face with Robin and her CP9 comrades. The rubberman is prepared to fight for his friend, but he`s never faced foes like this!

episodes_data.title: The Straw Hat Pirates Annihilated? The Menace of the Leopard Model!
episodes_data.description: Luffy, Zoro, and Nami are sent hurtling toward their deaths by the villains of CP9! Meanwhile, Usopp forges an unlikely friendship with Franky while waiting out a storm.

episodes_data.title: The Man Who Is Loved Even by His Ship! Usopp's Tears!
episodes_data.description: Franky tries to convince Usopp that there`s no hope for the Going Merry, but the sniper - inspired by a mysterious moment from the past - remains loyal to his beloved boat

episodes_data.title: Franky's Past! The Day the Sea Train First Ran!
episodes_data.description: A look back at Franky`s past reveals the amazing origins of the sea train – and paints a vivid picture of his younger days, spent alongside Iceberg and the legendary shipwright Tom!

episodes_data.title: Spandam's Scheme! The Day the Sea Train Shook!
episodes_data.description: Franky`s backstory continues! The sea train is a success, and it looks like Tom`s life is spared! Unfortunately, a government spy is searching for a reason to investigate Tom, and Franky provides the ammunition!

episodes_data.title: The End of the Legendary Man! The Day the Sea Train Cried!
episodes_data.description: Tom does the unthinkable in an attempt to protect his apprentices, but young Franky is unable to control his rage, leading to a showdown with a spy - and a train!

episodes_data.title: The Truth Behind Her Betrayal! Robin's Sorrowful Decision!
episodes_data.description: Chopper`s heroism may mean the difference between life and death for Iceberg and Paulie, Nami learns the agonizing truth about Robin, and Sanji prepares to make his move!

episodes_data.title: The Steam Whistle Forces Friends Apart! The Sea Train Starts to Run!
episodes_data.description: Nami makes a frantic dash for the Sea Train station, Chopper searches desperately for Zoro and Luffy, and Sanji plays it cool while waiting for the right time to spring into action.

episodes_data.title: Sanji Barges In! Sea Train Battle in the Storm!
episodes_data.description: Nami arrives at the train station a minute too late, Sanji makes his presence aboard the sea train known, and the search for Luffy and Zoro continues!

episodes_data.title: Nami's Soul Cries Out! Straw Hat Luffy Makes a Comeback!
episodes_data.description: Chopper and Nami risk their own lives in a desperate attempt to save Luffy and Zoro from a monstrous wall of water! Meanwhile, Sanji moves ever closer to a reunion with Robin.

episodes_data.title: Another Sea Train? Rocketman Charges Forth!
episodes_data.description: Luffy and Nami ask to borrow a ship so they can chase down the sea train, but the weather is too severe to set sail. Lucky for them, Iceberg and his friends are full of surprises!

episodes_data.title: Rescue Our Friends! A Bond Among Foes Sworn with Fists!
episodes_data.description: Luffy, Zoro, Chopper, and Nami rocket toward a rendezvous with the assassins of CP 9, but they`ll need to forge an alliance with some new friends to have any chance at survival!

episodes_data.title: Smash the Wave! Luffy and Zoro Use the Strongest Combo!
episodes_data.description: Zoro and Luffy go head-to-head with Mother Nature, and Sanji`s rescue mission is bolstered by Franky`s allegiance – and the arrival of the mysterious Sniper King!

episodes_data.title: A Mysterious Man Appears?! His Name Is Sogeking!
episodes_data.description: Sniper King, a mysterious warrior from the island of snipers, lends a hand as Franky and Sanji try to fight their way to Robin.

episodes_data.title: Showdown Between Cooks! Sanji vs. Ramen Kenpo
episodes_data.description: Sanji mixes it up with a deranged cook, Franky dukes it out with the newest member of CP9, and the Sniper King gets creative in his attempt to reach Robin!

episodes_data.title: Rooftop Duel! Franky vs. Nero!
episodes_data.description: Franky and Sanji continue to battle the thugs of CP9. Meanwhile, Luffy and the rest of the gang find themselves headed for a collision that could spell doom for everyone!

episodes_data.title: Clash! Demon-Slasher Zoro vs. Ship-Slasher T-Bone!
episodes_data.description: Zoro faces a fellow master of the blade, Sanji looks to end his fight with against a rampaging ramen master, and Franky finally lands a big blow against his CP9 foe!

episodes_data.title: Scramble Over Robin! A Cunning Plan by Sogeking!
episodes_data.description: The Sniper King hatches a daring escape plan, but the assassins of CP9 are more powerful than our heroes ever imagined. Meanwhile, Luffy and the gang run into a very familiar frog!

episodes_data.title: The Judicial Island! Full View of Enies Lobby!
episodes_data.description: As their train approaches Enies Lobby, Franky`s kind words cut through Robin`s cold exterior. Luffy`s train is thrown off course, but the group gains a powerful new ally!

episodes_data.title: Landing Operations Start! Charge in, Straw Hats!
episodes_data.description: The Straw Hats hatch a plan to rescue Robin, but as usual, Luffy can`t wait to find a fight. Will his impulsive attack derail their mission?

episodes_data.title: Luffy Cuts Through! Big Showdown on the Judicial Island!
episodes_data.description: Luffy manages to reach the main island, but the Franky Family`s assault is stopped short by a couple of angry giants!

episodes_data.title: Battle Against Giants! Open the Second Gate!
episodes_data.description: Luffy makes short work of a few hundred marines, the Franky Family takes down a giant, and the assassins of CP9 report back to Spandam!

episodes_data.title: Find a Way Out! Rocketman Takes Flight!
episodes_data.description: Zoro`s quick thinking - and a little help from a giant frog - sends the sea train soaring into the sky on a collision course with armed guards and their canine companions!

episodes_data.title: Catch Up with Luffy! The Straw Hats' All-Out Battle
episodes_data.description: Nami electrocutes the enemy with a Clima Tact attack, but the bad guys have the Straw Hats surrounded until the Franky Family shows up with a couple of sea monsters!

episodes_data.title: Robin Betrayed! The Motive of the World Government!
episodes_data.description: Zoro, Sanji, Nami, and Chopper try to catch up with their captain, Soge King is nowhere to be found, and Luffy runs head first into a battle with Blueno!

episodes_data.title: Give Robin Back! Luffy vs. Blueno!
episodes_data.description: Luffy shows off his new strength in a brawl with Blueno, Soge King befriends a giant, and a hulking sea beast makes the ultimate sacrifice.

episodes_data.title: Don't Stop! Hoist the Counterattack Signal!
episodes_data.description: While Luffy continues his battle with Blueno, Soge King`s giant companions make their presence felt, and the assassins of CP9 experiment with Devil Fruits!

episodes_data.title: Almost to Luffy! Gather at the Courthouse Plaza!
episodes_data.description: A blind Kingbull fights with his last breath to get the Straw Hats one step closer to their captain. Luffy kick his body into second gear to protect his friends from dangerous foes!

episodes_data.title: Everything Is to Protect My Friends! Second Gear Activated!
episodes_data.description: Luffy batters a baffled Blueno with his powerful new fighting style, and the cowardly Spandam begins to panic at the sound of the Straw Hats approaching!

episodes_data.title: Give Us Your Answer, Robin! The Straw Hats' Outcry!
episodes_data.description: Luffy and his crew are finally reunited and ready to rescue Robin, but the raven-haired beauty remains reluctant to rejoin her former mates despite Franky`s urging.

episodes_data.title: Robin's Past! The Girl Who Was Called a Devil!
episodes_data.description: Flash back to Robin`s days as a young girl, her dangerous pursuit of forbidden knowledge, and her encounter with a friendly giant.

episodes_data.title: Fated Mother and Daughter! The Mother's Name Is Olvia!
episodes_data.description: Robin`s flashback continues with the heartbreaking arrival of her mother - and the government`s cruel and brutal invasion of a peaceful island!

episodes_data.title: The Tragedy of Ohara! The Terror of the Buster Call!
episodes_data.description: Professor Clover reveals a startling and sinister theory about the World Government, Robin reunites with her mother, and a giant joins the fight!

episodes_data.title: Say You Want to Live! We Are Your Friends!
episodes_data.description: The painful story of Ohara - and Robin`s younger years - draws to a tragic close. Luffy declares war on the World Government, and Robin finally changes her tune!

episodes_data.title: Jump Towards the Falls! Luffy's Feelings!
episodes_data.description: The Straw Hats are ready to begin the fight for Robin, but first, Luffy flashes back to memories of his childhood - and the man who made him want to become a pirate!

episodes_data.title: The Ways of Men! Zoro's Techniques, Usopp's Dream
episodes_data.description: Zoro remembers the first time he met Luffy, and Usopp recalls the events that led him to join the Straw Hats!

episodes_data.title: A Bond of Friendship Woven by Tears! Nami's World Map
episodes_data.description: Nami`s heartbreaking past - and Luffy`s epic battle with Arlong - are recalled in this flashback to the early days of the Straw Hats!

episodes_data.title: Parting Builds a Man's Character! Sanji and Chopper
episodes_data.description: A flashback sheds light on how Sanji came to join the crew, and Chopper`s backstory is revealed through memories of a visit to a snow-covered island!

episodes_data.title: Everything Is for Her Friends! Robin in the Darkness!
episodes_data.description: A flashback reveals Robin`s motives for cooperating with CP9, Nami`s shocking discovery about the archaeologist`s past, and Luffy`s determination to save his friend!

episodes_data.title: I'm Not Gonna Hand Over the Blueprints! Franky's Decision!
episodes_data.description: Franky stands up to Spandam by destroying what the madman desires most, and the sound of the sea train spurs the Straw Hats to make a daring leap of faith!

episodes_data.title: Obtain the Five Keys! The Straw Hat Pirates vs. CP9!
episodes_data.description: Luffy races to rescue Robin while the rest of the Straw Hats set off in search of the five keys needed to unlock the archaeologist!

episodes_data.title: Devil Fruit Powers! Kaku and Jabra Transform
episodes_data.description: While Usopp and Zoro go head-to-head with a couple of animal assassins, Sanji teaches the most beautiful member of CP9 the secrets of making good tea!

episodes_data.title: I Won't Kick Even If It Costs Me My Life! Sanji's Chivalry!
episodes_data.description: Luffy runs into trouble trying to sail his way to Robin, Usopp and Zoro end up handcuffed together, and Sanji`s inability to kick a women may lead to serious injury!

episodes_data.title: Fukurou's Miscalculation! My Cola Is the Water of Life!
episodes_data.description: Chimney and Gombe show Luffy the secret passage that leads to Robin, and Franky puts on a display of raw punching power thanks to a few bottles of cola!

episodes_data.title: Zoro Bursts Out a New Technique! The Sword's Name Is Sniper King?
