episodes_data.description: While Franky`s brawl spills into the ocean, Sogeking and Zoro attempt to overcome their handcuffs by outsmarting their opponents!

episodes_data.title: Uncontrollable! Chopper's Forbidden Rumble
episodes_data.description: Determined not to be defeated by the heinous hair of a devious lion, Chopper risks life and limb by summoning the power of his Rumble Ball for a third time!

episodes_data.title: Boss Luffy Returns! Is It a Dream or Reality? Lottery Ruckus
episodes_data.description: Travel back to ancient Japan for a madcap adventure starring the Straw Hats, some old friends and enemies, and a camel that eats lottery tickets!

episodes_data.title: A Big Rice Cake Tossing Race at the Castle! Red Nose's Plot
episodes_data.description: The madcap throwback continues as Luffy and the gang - along with a crowd of characters from the Alabasta arc - competes for a priceless treasure hidden inside a tasty snack!

episodes_data.title: Bubble Master Kalifa! The Soap Trap Closes In on Nami
episodes_data.description: Nami battles a bathing beauty and her lethal bubbles, Chopper unleashes his inner beast, and Luffy inches ever closer to catching up with Robin!

episodes_data.title: Resounding Bad News! Buster Call Invoked!
episodes_data.description: Franky has a painful encounter with monster Chopper, and Nami gets scrubbed too clean to fight! Meanwhile, Spandam accidentally invokes the deadly Buster Call!

episodes_data.title: Five Namis? Nami Strikes Back with Mirages!
episodes_data.description: Zoro uses Usopp as a decoy in his battle with the beasts, and Nami discovers the secret that could be the key to survival in her brawl with the bathing beauty!

episodes_data.title: Nami's Decision! Fire at the Out-of-Control Chopper!
episodes_data.description: Franky and Nami come up with a plan to stop Chopper`s rampage, but it could prove deadly to the not-so-little reindeer. Usopp and Zoro are thrilled to finally be free of each other!

episodes_data.title: Hunter Sanji Makes an Entrance? Elegy for a Lying Wolf
episodes_data.description: Usopp`s ill-advised attempt at bravery threatens to get him killed, but a familiar foot spares the sniper`s life. Luffy struggles to even strike a formidable foe, and Franky races to deliver some very important keys!

episodes_data.title: Fiery Kicks! Sanji's Full Course of Foot Techniques
episodes_data.description: Sanji evens the playing field in his CP9 slugfest by introducing his wolfish opponent to the burning power of the devil`s leg!

episodes_data.title: Fierce Sword Attacks! Zoro vs. Kaku, Powerful Sword Fighting Showdown
episodes_data.description: Zoro finally lands a blow against the killer giraffe, but Luffy still can`t find a way to break through against Lucci! Can Frank reach Robin before it`s too late!?

episodes_data.title: Demon God Zoro! An Incarnation of Asura Born from Fighting Spirit
episodes_data.description: Zoro unleashes a demonic nine sword fighting style on his giraffe opponent, Luffy buys time for Franky by ascending to second gear, and Robin refuses to give up hope of being rescued!

episodes_data.title: Spandam Frightened! The Hero on the Tower of Law
episodes_data.description: Spandam cruely drags Robin ever closer to the gates of justice, but the battle takes a turn for the better when the Sniper King makes a surprise appearance!

episodes_data.title: Robin Freed! Luffy vs. Lucci, Showdown Between Leaders
episodes_data.description: Luffy`s battle with Lucci reveals the powerful secrets of the rubber man`s second gear, and the Spandam`s thoughtless Buster Call begins with a brutal barrage of cannon balls.

episodes_data.title: Boss Luffy Is the Culprit? Track Down the Missing Great Cherry Tree
episodes_data.description: When an ancient tree is stolen by a madman with the power to freeze time, Luffy, Usopp, and Sanji track down the culprit in an attempt to save a village`s annual festival!

episodes_data.title: I Can't Protect Anyone Unless I Win! Third Gear Activated!
episodes_data.description: Nami, Sanji, Usopp, Zoro, and company find themselves trapped in to tunnel filled with rapidly rising water. Meanwhile, Luffy musters the strength for one last stand in his battle with Lucci.

episodes_data.title: Shivering Past! Dark Justice and Rob Lucci
episodes_data.description: Flashback to the dark past of Rob Lucci as the young boy learns to dispense a cold, cruel, and brutal brand of justice. Back in real time, Luffy`s battle with Lucci threatens to destroy the navy fleet.

episodes_data.title: A Mysterious Mermaid Appears? As Consciousness Fades Away...
episodes_data.description: Luffy`s gigantic attack on Lucci takes a devastating toll on his body, Robin rejoins the fight, and the rest of the Straw Hats struggle to survive underwater!

episodes_data.title: Cannon Fire Sinks the Island! Franky's Lamentation
episodes_data.description: Thanks to a little help from what appears to be a mermaid, the Straw Hats find themselves reunited aboard an escape vessel, but the fate of Luffy and the Franky Family is yet to be determined!

episodes_data.title: Wait for Luffy! Mortal Combat on the Bridge of Hesitation!
episodes_data.description: Luffy pushes his body to the breaking point in his battle with Lucci, and the rest of the Straw Hats try to fight off a fleet of Marines until their captain returns - if he ever does.

episodes_data.title: Fists Full of Emotion! Luffy Unleashes Gatling with All His Might
episodes_data.description: Luffy lies battered and badly beaten, but Usopp`s desperate pleas inspire the rubber-man to mount one final, furious attack on Rob Lucci!

episodes_data.title: From the Sea, A Friend Arrives! The Straw Hats Share the Strongest Bond
episodes_data.description: With their leader crippled by exhaustion and their escape ship destroyed, the Straw Hats find themselves with only one treacherous option: throwing themselves into the sea!

episodes_data.title: Everyone Makes a Great Escape! The Road to Victory Is for the Pirates
episodes_data.description: The Straw Hats are rescued by the unexpected arrival of a dear old friend, but they`ll have to avoid a barrage of deadly cannonballs in order to survive!

episodes_data.title: Thank You, Merry! Snow Falls over the Parting Sea
episodes_data.description: The Straw Hats bid a tearful farewell to the brave little ship that was their home for so very many adventures. Rest in peace, Merry!

episodes_data.title: Peace Interrupted! A Navy Vice Admiral with a Fist of Love
episodes_data.description: The Straw Hats get some much needed rest and relaxation, Franky makes a big announcement, and Vice Admiral Garp tracks down his grandson!

episodes_data.title: The Strongest Family? Luffy's Father Revealed!
episodes_data.description: Luffy`s friends are shocked to learn that his grandpa is a marine hero, but that`s nothing compared to how surprised they`ll be by his father`s true identity!

episodes_data.title: Its Name Is the New World! The Fate of the Grand Line
episodes_data.description: Luffy gets the chance to catch up with his old friend Coby, Nami does some serious snooping, and Robin is paid a chilling visit from a terrifying face from her past.

episodes_data.title: Shanks Makes a Move! The Linchpin to the Reckless Era
episodes_data.description: Shanks visits Whitebeard with a serious request, Franky and Iceberg begin construction on a ship for the Straw Hats, and news spreads of the events at Enies Lobby.

episodes_data.title: A Girl in Search of Her Yagara! Great Search in the City of Water!
episodes_data.description: Luffy and Chopper risk their lives to help a heartbroken young girl track down her long lost pet!

episodes_data.title: Mothers Are Strong! Zoro's Hectic Household Chores
episodes_data.description: Zoro`s day takes a turn for the crazy when his search for a new sword is derailed by a couple of meddling orphans!

episodes_data.title: Sanji's Shock! Mysterious Old Man and His Super Yummy Cooking
episodes_data.description: Sanji spends the day with a very old chef who teaches him the secret of packing amazing flavor into each and every dish!

episodes_data.title: Everyone Finally Has a Bounty! A Pirate Group Worth Over 600 Million!
episodes_data.description: Franky and Iceberg stay up all night on a mission to finish a new ship for the Straw Hats, but the first light of day brings troubling news!

episodes_data.title: The King of Animals That Overlooks the Sea! The Dream Ship Magnificently Completed!
episodes_data.description: With their new ship completed, Luffy and the gang get ready to set sail, but first they`ll have to steal some underpants in order to secure the services of a shipwright!

episodes_data.title: Goodbye, My Dear Underlings! Franky Departs
episodes_data.description: A series of flashbacks to his younger days - and some painful persuasion by Robin - help Franky make the difficult decision to leave his friends and go to sea with the Straw Hats!

episodes_data.title: Departing the City of Water! Usopp Mans Up and Brings Closure to the Duel
episodes_data.description: Luffy and the Straw Hats are ready for their next adventure, but before they can move on they must await the return of Usopp - and avoid a barrage of cannon balls courtesy of Garp!

episodes_data.title: Wanted Posters Make It Around the World! Celebration in Their Hometowns As the Ship Moves Forward!
episodes_data.description: The Straw Hats` new ship gets a name, and Franky shows off some of its special features as the gang goes sky high to avoid being sunk by the marines!

episodes_data.title: The Most Heinous Power! Blackbeard's Darkness Attacks Ace
episodes_data.description: Ace and Blackbeard go toe-to-toe in an epic clash of Devil Fruit powers that pits fire against darkness - and threatens to destroy an entire island!

episodes_data.title: The Mysterious Band of Pirates! Sunny and the Dangerous Trap
episodes_data.description: Luffy and his mates cross paths with a ragged gang of sailors. The Straw Hats are quick to offer assistance, but their new friends may be up to no good!

episodes_data.title: Sunny's in a Pinch! Roar, Secret Super-Speed Mecha
episodes_data.description: The Straw Hats discover that their fishermen friends are actually pirates, but Chopper refuses to abandon a very sick patient.

episodes_data.title: The Dream Sinking in the New World! The Disillusioned Pirate, Puzzle
episodes_data.description: The captain of the Phoenix Pirates loses his will to fight, and the Straw Hats get trapped in a field of icebergs by some figure skating bounty hunters!

episodes_data.title: The Assassins Attack! The Great Battle on Ice Begins
episodes_data.description: Nami and Franky take a spin in the shark sub, Usopp and Sanji have a run in with a flock of deadly penguins, and Puzzle can no longer hide the fact that he`s alive!

episodes_data.title: The Staw Hat's Hard Battles! A Pirate Soul Risking It All for the Flag
episodes_data.description: Robin is shocked by her encounter with an adorable bounty hunter, Franky and Nami get trapped in a frozen shark, and Luffy`s quest to recapture his flag sends him sinking toward the bottom of the sea!

episodes_data.title: Stifling to the Max! The Twins' Magnetic Power Looms
episodes_data.description: Luffy battles a set of magnetic twins, Sanji and Usopp fall victim to a pair of figure skating lovebirds, and Zoro has a drink with the man who stole the Straw Hat flag!

episodes_data.title: A Mansion in Chaos! An Enraged Don and an Imprisoned Crew
episodes_data.description: Robin`s cola care package helps spring her friends from an icy prison, and Luffy`s bold words inspire a battered and beaten pirate to keep fighting!

episodes_data.title: The Phoenix Returns! The Dream Sworn to Friends on a Jolly Roger
episodes_data.description: While Luffy continues his battle with the magnetic twins, Chopper uses a rumble ball in his battle with a hockey player - and Robin tries to recover the Straw Hat flag!

episodes_data.title: The Super Hot-Hot Final Battle! Luffy vs. the Scorching Hot Don
episodes_data.description: Luffy battles an opponent who`s too hot to handle, Robin gets attacked by a jungle, and Chopper makes a heroic dash for the Straw Hat flag!

episodes_data.title: We'll Be Waiting in the New World! Parting with the Courageous Pirates
episodes_data.description: Luffy`s red-hot battle with Papa threatens to destroy the entire icy island, and the rest of the Straw Hats need a little help from a former enemy to recover their flag!

episodes_data.title: Go, Chopper Man! Protect the TV Station on the Beach
episodes_data.description: The most adorable hero the world has ever known - Chopperman - must battle a hideously evil villain to regain control of his favorite television station!

episodes_data.title: Plunging into the Devil's Sea! The Mysterious Skeleton Floating in the Fog!
episodes_data.description: While sailing through haunted waters, the Straw Hats encounter a ghost ship that`s home to a walking, talking skeleton!

episodes_data.title: The Joy of Seeing People! The Gentleman Skeleton's True Identity!
episodes_data.description: The Straw Hats attempt to unravel the mystery of their new comrade, but the skeleton`s sad story is interrupted by a ghastly landing at the haunted island of Thriller Bark!

episodes_data.title: One Unnatural Phenomenon After the Next! Disembarking on Thriller Bark!
episodes_data.description: After getting stranded at Thriller Bark, Chopper, Nami, and Usopp are chased by a three headed beast. Back on the boat, Luffy and the rest of the Straw Hats are terrorized by an unseen enemy!

episodes_data.title: The Man Called a Genius! Hogback Makes His Appearance!
episodes_data.description: Chopper, Nami, and Usopp get scared out of their minds when they encounter a graveyard full of zombies! Meanwhile, the rest of the crew gets trapped in super creepy sea web!

episodes_data.title: Nami's in a Major Pinch! The Zombie Mansion and the Invisible Man!
episodes_data.description: An invisible man turns Nami`s bath time into a harrowing experience, and Usopp battles a hall full of haunted paintings with a handful of burning candles!

episodes_data.title: The Zombie's Secret! Hogback's Nightmarish Laboratory!
episodes_data.description: While Usopp, Nami, and Chopper seek to unravel the secrets of the haunted mansion, Luffy and the gang do battle with an army of the undead!

episodes_data.title: His Name Is Moria! The Great Shadow-Seizing Pirate's Trap!
episodes_data.description: Luffy sets his sights on the shadowing-stealing monster known as Gecko Moria, and the zombie army prepares for a night attack led by their perverted, invisible leader!

episodes_data.title: Feast of the Zombie Song! The Night Raid's Bell Is the Sound of Darkness!
episodes_data.description: Usopp, Chopper, and Nami get trapped in a coffin after being slashed by a zombie samurai. Meanwhile, Luffy and the rest of the Straw Hats make short work of some haunted paintings!

episodes_data.title: A Bunch of Animals? Perona's Wonder Garden!
episodes_data.description: After escaping from their coffin prison, Usopp, Chopper, and Nami do battle with a garden full of adorably dead zombie animals!

episodes_data.title: The Vanishing Straw Hat Crew! A Mysterious Swordsman Appears!
episodes_data.description: An undead warthog sets her sights on Nami, Zorro and Sanji vanish without a trace, Franky and Robin battle an unbeatable army, and Luffy gets captured!

episodes_data.title: Chivalry Remains! The Traitorous Zombie Protects Nami!
episodes_data.description: A penguin zombie starts acting an awful lot like Sanji, Nami continues running for her life, and Robin and Franky buy some time by blowing up a bridge!

episodes_data.title: Appearing from the Sky! That Man Is the Humming Swordsman!
episodes_data.description: Nami gives love advice to a zombie, Luffy finds himself face-to-face with Gecko Moria, and Robin gets caught in spooky spider web. Things look bleak for the Straw Hats until their skeleton friend lends a hand!

episodes_data.title: Luffy's Emergency Situation! The Ultimate Shadow's Destination!
episodes_data.description: Brook strikes the final blow in his battle with the spider monkey, Gecko Moria`s devious plan is revealed, and Luffy`s escape attempt leads to the loss of something he can`t live without!

episodes_data.title: The Warrior Known As the 'Devil'!! The Moment of Oars' Revival!
episodes_data.description: Brook tells Franky and Robin the secret to slaying zombies, and Gecko Moria reveals the terrifying monster that will be the recipient of Luffy`s shadow!

episodes_data.title: Awakening After 500 Years!! Oars Opens His Eyes!!
episodes_data.description: Luffy`s shadow is forced into the body of a monster, Usopp and Chopper get incinerated, and Nami is kidnapped by a zombie who wants to make her his wife!

episodes_data.title: A Belief Worth Begging to Live For!! Brook Defends His Afro!
episodes_data.description: Gecko Moria`s minions struggle with the burden of feeding a giant zombie brought to life by Luffy`s shadow. Meanwhile, Brook flashes back to a battle that almost cost him his beloved afro!

episodes_data.title: A Man's Promise Never Dies!! To the Friend Waiting Under the Distant Sky!
episodes_data.description: The freshly-revived trio of Luffy, Zoro, and Sanji discover that their shadows are missing, and Franky relates Brook`s story about a promise he made to a very special whale!

episodes_data.title: I Swear to Go See Him!! Brook and the Cape of Promise!
episodes_data.description: Luffy and the Straw Hats flash back to the heartbreaking story of Laboon the abandoned whale, and Brook`s battle with the zombie samurai reveals the reason behind his intense afro love!

episodes_data.title: Food, Nami, and Shadows!! Luffy's Enraged Counterattack!
episodes_data.description: Luffy sets out to regain his shadow and convince Brook to join the crew. Meanwhile, Sanji races to stop Nami`s zombie wedding before it`s too late!

episodes_data.title: Usopp's the Strongest? Leave Anything Negative to Him!
episodes_data.description: Usopp`s naturally negative personality makes him the only Straw Hat who stands a chance against Perona`s depressing army of ghosts, and Chopper prepares to do battle against his hero, Dr. Hogback!

episodes_data.title: The General Zombies Are Down in a Flash!! Oars Feels Like an Adventure!!
episodes_data.description: When Brook is overmatched by the zombie samurai, Zoro steps in to help the skeleton get his shadow back. Meanwhile, Luffy prepares for a battle with Gecko Moria, and Sanji interrupts an undead wedding!

episodes_data.title: Blazing Knight Sanji!! Kick Down the Fake Wedding!
episodes_data.description: Despite his furious attempts, Luffy struggles to land a blow against Gecko Moria, but Sanji fares much better in his passionate attempt to defeat Nami`s beastly abductor!

episodes_data.title: A Clear-Clear History? Sanji's Stolen Dream
episodes_data.description: Sanji takes a beating when his opponent suddenly turns invisible, Luffy finally manages to land a blow in his battle with Gecko Moria, and Usopp uses fire to ward off a zombie bear!

episodes_data.title: Save Me, Hero!! My Enemy Is the Immortal Princess!
episodes_data.description: After getting the stuffing beat out of him by a zombie teddy bear, Usopp summons his sharp-shooting alter ego to help him discover the secret to defeating Perona!

episodes_data.title: Perona Is Terrified!! Usopp and Untruthful Share the Same 'U'!
episodes_data.description: Usopp reaches deep into his devious bag of tricks to even the odds in his battle with Perona. Meanwhile, Luffy can`t lay a finger on Gecko Moria, and a zombie is less than gentlemanly in his battle with Robin!

episodes_data.title: Slashes Dancing on the Rooftop!! Showdown: Zoro vs. Ryuma!
episodes_data.description: While Franky and Brook watch in awe, Zorro and the zombie samurai wage a sword-slinging battle the likes of which the world has never seen before!

episodes_data.title: Chopper Is Furious!! Hogback's Evil Medical Practices!
episodes_data.description: Chopper can no longer contain his fury over Dr. Hogback`s evil treatment of his zombie slaves. Meanwhile, Luffy prepares to face the zombie who`s wearing his shadow!

episodes_data.title: Oars Roars! Come Out, Straw Hat Crew!
episodes_data.description: Moria`s mansion is reduced to ruins as the zombie with Luffy`s shadow stalks the Straw Hats! As the walls come tumbling down, Chopper puts the hurt on Hogback, and Nami vanishes right before Sanji`s eyes!

episodes_data.title: Luffy Is the Enemy! The Ultimate Zombie vs. the Straw Hat Crew!
episodes_data.description: One by one, the Straw Hats attack Oars, but the monstrous zombie appears too powerful to be defeated. Luffy`s got his sights set on Moria, but he`d better hurry if he wants to save his crew!

episodes_data.title: You're Going Down, Absalom!! Nami's Lightning Attack of Friendship!!
episodes_data.description: Nami wakes up just in time to find out she’s about to marry a zombie, but the special occasion is interrupted by a very jealous warthog!

episodes_data.title: Knock Him Down!! Special Attack: Straw Hat Docking?
episodes_data.description: Nami attempts to track down some missing treasure, Brook searches the kitchen for a mystery ingredient, and a heroic team effort topples Oars!

episodes_data.title: The Silent Assault!! The Mysterious Visitor, 'Tyrant' Kuma!
episodes_data.description: Nami has a horrifying run in with Bartholomew Kuma, Perona becomes the latest lady to vanish, and Chopper, Franky, and Usopp team up to strike a blow against Oars!

episodes_data.title: Oars + Moria! The Most Heinous Combination of Brains and Brawn!
episodes_data.description: Kuma has an upsetting message for Moria, Luffy loses track of his intended target, and Zoro attempts to harness the power of a new sword during his battle with Oars!

episodes_data.title: The Secret Plan to Turn the Tables! Nightmare Luffy Makes His Appearance!
episodes_data.description: Brook arrives with the salt needed to stop Oars, but the monster shows off some special new abilities. Deep in the forest, Luffy makes some new friends who help him power up!

episodes_data.title: The Straw Hat Crew Gets Wiped Out! The Shadow-Shadow's Powers in Full Swing!
episodes_data.description: Brook joins the fight as the Straw Hats valiantly try to hold off Oars and Moria until Luffy returns. Unfortunately, even their combined powers are no match for these evil enemies!

episodes_data.title: The Incredible Battle Starts! Luffy vs. Luffy!
episodes_data.description: Oars and Moria ruthlessly pummel the badly beaten Straw Hats. The situation looks bleak until the shocking arrival of Nightmare Luffy!

episodes_data.title: The End of the Battle Is Nigh! Pound in the Finishing Move!
episodes_data.description: After Luffy’s shadow power disappears, he’ll need help from rest of the Straw Hats to land a devastating finishing blow in his battle against Oars.

episodes_data.title: Our Bodies Vanish! The Morning Sun Shines on the Nightmarish Island!
episodes_data.description: Moria gobbles up every shadow in sight to power up for a final showdown with Luffy. Can the Straw Hats save the day before the dawn reduces them all to ashes!?

episodes_data.title: Not Out of Danger Yet! Orders to Annihilate the Straw Hat Crew!
episodes_data.description: The battle between Luffy and Moria reaches its epic end, and the gargantuan shadow of the towering brute known as Kuma causes a panic on the island!

episodes_data.title: It Repels Everything! Kuma's Paw-Paw Power!
episodes_data.description: Kuma is ordered by the World Government to obliterate every living being on the island, but the Straw Hats – battered as they may be – refuse to go down without a fight!

episodes_data.title: The Pain of My Crewmates Is My Pain! Zoro's Desperate Fight!
episodes_data.description: Zoro slashes against the Pacifista Kuma is meet with resistance harder than steel.  Unable to win with his swords he bets everything on a trade.

episodes_data.title: A Promise from a Distant Day! The Pirates' Song and a Small Whale!
episodes_data.description: As the story of Kuma and Zoro is discussed, Brooks remembers back to when he was alive.

episodes_data.title: Brook's Past! A Sad Farewell with His Cheerful Comrade!
episodes_data.description: The continued story of Brooks the pirate and his friend Laboon.

episodes_data.title: Bink's Booze! The Song That Connects the Past with the Present!
episodes_data.description: Brooks shares the story of the final days of the Rumbar pirates and their final song.

episodes_data.title: A New Crewmate! The Musician, Humming Brook!
episodes_data.description: With a new official crewmate, the Straw Hat Pirates are ready to set sail.  Lola shares with Nami a unique item only available in the New World!

episodes_data.title: The Slow-Slow Menace! 'Silver Fox' Foxy Returns!
episodes_data.description: While resting at a floating resort, Spa Island. The Straw Hat crew runs into a familiar old face and big trouble.

episodes_data.title: The Great Scramble for Treasure! Collapse! Spa Island!
episodes_data.description: After Sayo is kidnapped, Luffy agrees to help Rina get her back.  His foolproof idea sends shockwaves through Spa Island.

episodes_data.title: Brook's Great Struggle! Is the Path to Becoming a True Comrade Rigorous?
episodes_data.description: Brook’s eagerness to become a trust comrade is backfiring immensely. What is causing his new anxiety and the crew survive much longer?

episodes_data.title: Halfway Across the Grand Line! Arrival at the Red Line!
episodes_data.description: The Straw Hats have finally reached the red line with each member thinking back on the adventure.  Straws are picked to decided who will take the submarine to investigate the way to Fish-man Isle.

episodes_data.title: Hatred for the Straw Hats! Iron Mask Duval Appears!
episodes_data.description: After indirectly rescuing a unique pair, they beg the straw heats to help rescue a friend that has been kidnapped by Iron Mask Duval.

episodes_data.title: The Fated Reunion! Save the Imprisoned Fishman!
episodes_data.description: Arriving at Duval’s base, it is obvious a trap, but when Camie’s friend is recognized as Hatchan, a former Arlong Pirate.  Luffy refuses to help so Camie and Pappgu attempt the rescue by themselves.

episodes_data.title: Tragedy! The Truth Hidden Behind Duval's Mask!
episodes_data.description: The flying fish riders attack on the Straw Hats take place in the air and sea. Luffy is memorized by the flying fish as Zoro attempts to free Hatchan.

episodes_data.title: Unleash the Sunny's Super Secret Weapon, the Gaon Cannon!
episodes_data.description: The secret of Duval is revealed!

episodes_data.title: Landing on the Way to Fishman Island! The Sabaody Archipelago!
episodes_data.description: Enjoying takoyaki from a grateful Hatchan, he explains to the crew how to get to Fish-man Island.

episodes_data.title: Tyranny! The Rulers of Sabaody, the Celestial Dragons
episodes_data.description: Luffy and his crew stop at an island overflowing with bubbles to get their ship modified for underwater travel. But it`s not long before they stumble upon an outrageous explosion and attract unwanted attention.

episodes_data.title: New Rivals Gather! The 11 Supernovas
episodes_data.description: Shakky explains why Sabaody Archipelago seems to be crawling with bounty hunters – eleven of the Grand Line`s most wanted pirates are currently ashore and two of them are in Luffy`s crew!

episodes_data.title: The Target Is Camie! The Looming Clutches of a Professional Kidnapper
episodes_data.description: A mysterious stranger keeps Zoro from tangling with a powerful Celestial Dragon, and Chopper goes bonkers when Camie disappears from the amusement park.

episodes_data.title: Rescue Caimie: The Archipelago's Lingering Dark History
episodes_data.description: Camie was abducted by a dastardly gang of kidnappers, and her next stop is the auction house unless the Straw Hats can rescue her. To make it in time, they’ll have to hitch a ride on some flying fish!

episodes_data.title: Time Limit: The Human Auction Begins
episodes_data.description: With a little help from their fishy mates, the Straw Hats make it to the auction house in time to save Camie, but explosive elements prevent them from taking her back by force. Luckily, Nami’s concocted a very generous plan!

episodes_data.title: The Fist Explodes! Destroy the Auction
episodes_data.description: Nami’s plan to save Camie goes belly up when a snot-nosed celestial dragon outbids the Straw Hats. Luffy and Zoro make an explosive arrival at the auction house and promptly open up a deadly can of worms.

episodes_data.title: Major Panic! Desperate Struggle at the Auction House
episodes_data.description: Luffy turns a mermaid auction into a pirate-style brawl when he knocks the snot out of a celestial dragon. With a fleet of marines out to get them, the Straw Hats will have to fight their way off the island!

episodes_data.title: Admiral Kizaru Takes Action! Sabaody Archipelago Thrown into Chaos
episodes_data.description: They saved Cami from the auction block, but now the Straw Hats are surrounded by a fleet of marines. Lucky for Luffy, Eustass Captain Kid and Trafalgar Law are ready to join the fight!

episodes_data.title: Break Through the Siege! The Navy vs. the Three Captains
episodes_data.description: The Straw Hats join forces with Kid’s crew and Trafalgar’s mates to make short work of the marines, but they’re in for a surprise when they encounter a Warlord of the Sea!

episodes_data.title: Roger and Rayleigh: The King of the Pirates and His Right Hand Man
episodes_data.description: Luffy and his crew duck the marines by hiding out at Rayleigh’s house. While Chopper tends to Hachi, Rayleigh entertains the Straw Hats with tales of his days as first mate on Gold Roger’s ship.

episodes_data.title: No Escape!? Admiral Kizaru's Light Speed Kick!!
episodes_data.description: Admiral Kizaru has arrived to lead the marines on a mission to wipe out all pirates. Meanwhile, Luffy and his crew prepare for a deadly battle with one of the Warlords of the Sea!

episodes_data.title: Overwhelming! The Navy's Fighting Weapons, the Pacifistas
episodes_data.description: A groovy pirate belts out a tune that leaves Kizaru in pieces, but the admiral pulls himself together in time for a crushing Light Speed Kick. Luffy and Sanji try to protect the injured Zoro from a warlord lookalike.

episodes_data.title: An Even Stronger Enemy Appears! The Battle Axe-Carrying Sentomaru
episodes_data.description: Luffy and the Straw Hats narrowly defeat a robot that resembles one of the Seven Warlords of the Sea. But before the dust settles on the field of battle, a far more deadly foe comes looking for a fight.

episodes_data.title: Admiral Kizaru's Fierce Assault: The Straw Hats Face Certain Death!
episodes_data.description: Zoro’s barely breathing, and Admiral Kizaru is ready to stomp him into oblivion. The battered and beaten Straw Hats could certainly use a powerful friend right about now.

episodes_data.title: Eliminated Friends: The Final Day of the Straw Hat Crew
episodes_data.description: One by one, the mighty paw-print of Bartholomew Kuma makes the Straw Hats disappear until only Luffy remains. To where did his mates vanish? And will he ever see them again?

episodes_data.title: Feudal Era Side Story: Boss Luffy Appears Again
episodes_data.description: Yesterday, the Straw Hats valiantly battled a warlord of the sea. Today, Boss Luffy and his friends at the Pinwheel Diner prepare to compete in the Great Portable Shrine Race!

episodes_data.title: Feudal Era Side Story: Defeat Thriller Company's Trap
episodes_data.description: Thriller Company sabotages the race for a sacred treasure, and the displaced Straw Hats must pull an all-nighter to rebuild their shrine and score some ancient gold!

episodes_data.title: Landing! The All-Female Island, Amazon Lily
episodes_data.description: Luffy finds himself stranded and starving on a strange island. The rubber-man’s amazing appetite puts his manhood in danger when he devours an array of exotic mushrooms!

episodes_data.title: Hurry Back to Your Friends! The Maiden Island Adventure
episodes_data.description: An army of scantily-clad Amazonian warriors want to investigate Luffy’s family jewels, but the captain of the Straw Hats is more interested in reuniting with his lost mates.

episodes_data.title: Everyone Falls in Love! Pirate Empress Hancock
episodes_data.description: The Amazonians chasing Luffy are loyal subjects of Boa Hancock, the curvaceous Warlord of the Sea. This stone-cold beauty is deadly, and she’s about to pick a fight with an entire fleet of marines!

episodes_data.title: The Secret Hidden on the Backs: Luffy and the Snake Princess Meet
episodes_data.description: Luffy’s search for a seaworthy vessel leads to a “drop-in” on the Snake Princess during the royal bathing hour. The view is world-class, but it might turn the rubber-man to stone!

episodes_data.title: Heartless Judgment! Margaret Is Turned to Stone!!
episodes_data.description: Boa Hancock makes Luffy fighting mad when she turns Margaret into a statue. The Snake Princess may have bitten off more than she can chew by challenging captain Straw Hat!

episodes_data.title: A Difficult Fight for Luffy! The Snake Sisters' Haki Power!!
episodes_data.description: The Snake Princess pits Luffy’s Gum Gum abilities against the incredible Haki Power of her serpentine sisters in a fight to the death. Will Luffy survive long enough to save his statuesque friends?

episodes_data.title: All-Out Special Power Battle!! Gum-Gum vs. Snake-Snake
episodes_data.description: Luffy kicks his attack mode into second gear to save a precious statue, and the snake sisters start to feel the Straw Hat heat. At the battle’s climax, Luffy makes an impression on his opponents.

episodes_data.title: Hancock's Confession: The Sisters' Abhorrent Past
episodes_data.description: News of Luffy’s run-in with the Celestial Dragons impresses the Snake Princess, so she tells him the story of her tortured past. Will his honorable nature speed Luffy toward a reunion with his crew?

episodes_data.title: Saving Ace! The Next Stop: The Great Prison!
episodes_data.description: Luffy is mobbed by a hoard of pretty amazons eager to touch a real live man. Granny Nyon offers him safe haven, but what she has to say might sink his plans for a Straw Hat reunion.

episodes_data.title: Love Is a Hurricane! Love-Love Hancock!
episodes_data.description: Boa Hancock`s illness threatens to sabotage Luffy`s rescue mission; however, the Snake Princess just can`t say "no" to the rubberman, so a plan to save Ace is quickly hatched.

episodes_data.title: The Friends' Whereabouts: The Science of Weather and the Mechanical Island
episodes_data.description: While Luffy races to save Ace, Nami tries to survive life on Sky Island, and Franky dances up a snowstorm before making the switch from cola to tea!

episodes_data.title: The Friends' Whereabouts: An Island of Giant Birds and a Pink Paradise!
episodes_data.description: Chopper narrowly avoids being served for dinner in a land inhabited by giant birds, and Sanji`s refined tastes land him a role as a leading lady on the island of "girlish hearts".

episodes_data.title: The Friends' Whereabouts: Bridging the Islands and Vicious Vegetations!
episodes_data.description: Nico Robin finds herself trapped on the island of Tequila Wolf: a miserable land where children are forced to work as slaves. Elsewhere, Usopp tries to survive a run-in with a man-eating plant!

episodes_data.title: The Friends' Whereabouts: A Negative Princess and the King of Demons
episodes_data.description: Zoro is held against his will by the pink-haired princess of bad vibes, Brook gets mistaken for the king of darkness, and Luffy continues to eat his way toward a reunion with Fire-Fist Ace!

episodes_data.title: A Deadly Infiltration! The Underwater Prison Impel Down
episodes_data.description: Luffy and Boa arrive at Impel Down, but only thirty-three hours remain until Ace`s execution. To save him, the Snake Princess must find a way to hide Luffy during her full-body search!

episodes_data.title: A Reunion in Hell?! The Man Who Ate the Chop-Chop Fruit!
episodes_data.description: Time is running out on Ace, so Luffy teams up with a scoundrel who`s going to pieces trying to escape Impel Down. There`s no love lost between Buggy the Clown and the Straw Hat captain, but they`d better work together if they want to survive.

episodes_data.title: Break Through the Crimson Hell! Buggy's Chaos-Inducing Plan
episodes_data.description: Luffy must part ways with a priceless treasure map before Buggy the Clown agrees to lead him through the bloody tangle of Blade Trees and Spike Needle Grass that make up Impel Down`s Crimson Hell!

episodes_data.title: The Strongest Man in the Prison! Poison Man Magellan Appears!
episodes_data.description: Luffy and Buggy the Clown could end up as hippo food if they aren`t careful in Impel Down`s Wild Beast Hell. Of course, the rubberman might find that a better fate than dealing with the prison`s putrid warden!

episodes_data.title: A Special Presentation Related to the Movie! A Gold Lion's Ambition on the Move!
episodes_data.description: Luffy and his crew stumble upon a most peculiar village when they hitch a ride on a fire-breathing beetle. The natives are petrified of pirates, but they welcome the Straw Hats with open arms!

episodes_data.title: A Special Presentation Related to the Movie! Little East Blue in Danger!
episodes_data.description: The citizens of Little East Blue throw a feast in honor of the Straw Hats, but when the Amigo Pirates try to capture Boss the beetle, Luffy and his crew will have to defend their new friends.

episodes_data.title: A Special Presentation Related to the Movie! The Fierce Onslaught of the Amigo Pirates!
episodes_data.description: Luffy, Zoro, and Sanji prepare to do battle on behalf of Boss the beetle, but Captain Largo of the Amigo Pirates counters with a deadly arsenal of nets to put the Straw Hat brawlers on lock down!

episodes_data.title: A Special Presentation Related to the Movie! Luffy vs. Largo: The Battle Is On!
episodes_data.description: Luffy kicks into second gear for his rematch with Largo, and Nami leads the islanders as they lay waste to the Amigo Pirates. Boss the Beetle may be safe for now, but someone sinister lurks behind the scenes.

episodes_data.title: A Warlord in Prison! Jimbei, the Honorable Pirate!
episodes_data.description: Luffy struggles to stay a step ahead of a prison patrol made up of hungry lions and poisonous scorpions! Meanwhile, Ace spends what could be his final hours swapping stories with a pirate who hates pirates.

episodes_data.title: Chief Guard Saldeath's Trap! Level 3: Starvation Hell!
episodes_data.description: While the guards struggle to squelch a violent prison uprising, Luffy and his fellow fugitives try to keep their cool in a level of Impel Down known as Starvation Hell!

episodes_data.title: The Unleashed Swan! A Reunion with Bon Clay!
episodes_data.description: Boa Hancock uses her ample assets to buy some private time for a clandestine chat with Ace. Meanwhile, Luffy needs help from a graceful friend to escape the jaws of a hungry Sphinx!

episodes_data.title: Warden Magellan's Strategy! Straw Hat Entrapment Completed
episodes_data.description: Luffy and Bon are on the verge of reaching Level 4, but they didn`t count on fighting a demonic, lightning-fast, devastatingly powerful Minotaur! To defeat this beast, they`ll need help from a human candle and a deranged clown!

episodes_data.title: All Forces Have Gathered! The Battle on Level 4, the Burning Heat Hell!
episodes_data.description: Luffy narrowly avoids a deadly dip in a boiling pool of blood, only to find himself face to face with Warden Magellan. Meanwhile, outside the prison walls, the marine fleet prepares for Whitebeard`s onslaught!

episodes_data.title: Mighty Magellan! Bon Clay Bugs Out
episodes_data.description: Warden Magellan is a monster of a man with a penchant for poisoning prisoners. To rescue Ace, Luffy must go toe to toe with this toxic terror, but how do you defeat a foe who`s deadly to the touch?

episodes_data.title: The Showdown Has Come! Luffy's Desperate Last Attack!
episodes_data.description: Luffy`s daring assault on the venomous warden of Impel Down leaves him struggling to stand up, but despite the lethal poison breaking down his body, the rubber-man kicks his rescue mission into second gear!

episodes_data.title: For His Friend! Bon Clay Goes to the Deadly Rescue!
episodes_data.description: Luffy is at the end of the line - the only thing that can save him now is true friendship. But in a place like Impel Down can true friendship be found?

episodes_data.title: A Paradise in Hell! Impel Down Level 5.5!
episodes_data.description: No existing antidote can save Luffy from the poison coursing through his veins, yet Bon Clay refuses to give up. His final, fleeting hope is a mysterious miracle-worker rumored to have vanished into the Gates of Hell!

episodes_data.title: Luffy's Treatment Begins! Ivan-san's Miraculous Power!
episodes_data.description: Bon is overjoyed to hear that Luffy is still alive, but his happiness quickly turns to shock when he learns that Ivan`s agonizingly painful "Healing Hormones" will cost the rubber-man ten years of his life!

episodes_data.title: Believe in Miracles! Bon Clay's Cries from the Heart
episodes_data.description: Ace is scheduled to be executed in a matter of hours, and Luffy`s still hovering on the verge of death. It will take a miracle to save them both, but Bon would rather die than give up on his friend!

episodes_data.title: Luffy's Back! Ivan-san Begins the Breakout Plan!!
episodes_data.description: Luffy miraculously survived his brush with death, but he`s far too weak to finish rescuing Ace. Ivan is reluctant to lend a hormonal hand to the doomed rescue mission - until he learns of Luffy`s lineage!

episodes_data.title: Ace's Convoy Begins! Battle on the Lowest Floor, Level 6!
episodes_data.description: The quest to rescue Ace tuckers out thanks to a blast of sleeping gas! Ivan`s scissor-handed sidekick puts an end to nap time, but Luffy will have to join forces with a scar-faced foe from the past if he wants to complete his mission!

episodes_data.title: The Ultimate Team Has Formed! Shaking Impel Down!
episodes_data.description: Luffy`s desperate attempt to rescue Ace is bolstered by two powerful new allies: the murderous Crocodile and the honorable fishman Jinbei. Meanwhile, Ivan sparks a prison riot to create a diversion for the rubber-man.

episodes_data.title: Even More Chaos! Here Comes Blackbeard Teech!
episodes_data.description: Luffy and his gang of outlaws cause a commotion on Level Four, Blackbeard`s arrival leads to the release of the prison`s most feared inmate, and Ace gazes upon the great blue sky for what could be the very last time!

episodes_data.title: The Dangerous Encounter! Blackbeard and Shiryu of the Rain!
episodes_data.description: Ivan undergoes a curvaceous transformation to better battle sadistic Sadie, the commander of the Demon Guards. Meanwhile, Blackbeard and Shiryu head for a showdown on Level 1!

episodes_data.title: No Price Too High! Serious Hannyabal!
episodes_data.description: Luffy`s bone-crushing battle with the Vice Warden of Impel Down is interrupted by the sudden appearance of Blackbeard. When the rubber-man hears what the warlord has to say - heads will roll!

episodes_data.title: Jet Pistol of Anger! Luffy vs. Blackbeard!
episodes_data.description: Even in Second Gear, Luffy is no match for Blackbeard`s vortex, but the rubber-man rebounds by knocking out a Demon Guard with one ferocious pistol-punch. Elsewhere, Warden Magellan vows to finish Luffy once and for all!

episodes_data.title: Stop Magellan! Ivan-san's Esoteric Technique Explodes
episodes_data.description: Ace is to be executed in a matter of hours, and Magellan`s toxic breath is singeing the back of Luffy`s neck. Ivan uses a devastating Death Wink to buy some time, but the warden`s Poison Hydra may be more than he can handle!

episodes_data.title: Magellan's Tricky Move! A Foiled Escape Plan
episodes_data.description: Luffy dons a suit of waxy armor in preparation for his rematch with Warden Magellan. Outside the prison walls, Jimbei turns a door into a boat, so Crocodile and Buggy can commandeer an escape vessel!

episodes_data.title: The Escapee Team in Trouble! The Forbidden Move: Venom Demon!
episodes_data.description: Magellan takes his toxic attack to the next level by unleashing the hideous and deadly Venom Demon! If Jimbei and Crocodile don`t return with a rescue ship soon, Luffy won`t survive long enough to save Ace!

episodes_data.title: Come, Final Miracle! Break Through the Gate of Justice!
episodes_data.description: Luffy and his merry band of escapees are safely onboard the rescue ship, but they`re not out hot water just yet. A fleet of marines is bombarding them with cannon balls, and an impenetrable gate looms on the horizon!

episodes_data.title: To the Navy Headquarters! Off to Rescue Ace!
episodes_data.description: Luffy and Ivan mourn the loss of Bon Clay, and Captain Buggy`s reputation gets a boost when a phone call from the Marines reveals the secrets of his past.

episodes_data.title: The Friends' Whereabouts! The Weatheria Report and the Cyborg Animals!
episodes_data.description: While Luffy continues his rescue mission, Nami learns a lesson about how to turn rain into cash, and Franky wakes up in a freezing forest full of ferocious cyborg animals!

episodes_data.title: The Friends' Whereabouts! The Chick of a Giant Bird and a Pink Showdown!
episodes_data.description: Sanji tries to fight his way off a most peculiar island, but his frilly battle costume threatens to awaken his inner maiden. Elsewhere, Chopper tries to avoid being served in a hot pot!

episodes_data.title: The Friends' Whereabouts! Revolutionaries and the Gorging Forest's Trap!
episodes_data.description: Nico Robin lends her many hands to an overmatched gang of revolutionaries in a frigid land of eternal suffering, and Usopp bulks up to avoid becoming a snack for a hungry, hungry island!

episodes_data.title: The Friends' Whereabouts! A Huge Tomb and the Panty Debt!
episodes_data.description: Zoro`s attempt to reunite with his friends leads him a massive tomb and a host of shadowy swordsmen. Elsewhere, Brook uses his status as Satan to get an eyeful of undergarments!

episodes_data.title: A Special Retrospective Before Marineford! The Vow of Brotherhood!
episodes_data.description: While the marines prepare for Ace`s execution, Luffy looks back on all the good times he shared with his brother, and Jimbei reveals the shocking details of the day Fire Fist Ace went down in defeat!

episodes_data.title: A Special Retrospective Before Marineford! The Three Navy Admirals Come Together!
episodes_data.description: Luffy and his gang continue on their way to Marineford, but once he arrives, the rubber-man must defeat both Navy Admirals and Warlords of the Sea before he can save Ace!

episodes_data.title: Ticking Down to the Time of Battle! The Navy's Strongest Lineup in Position!
episodes_data.description: Citizens and soldiers alike prepare for all-out war as Ace is led to the site of his execution. While the world watches, the true identity of the condemned man`s father is shockingly revealed!

episodes_data.title: A Vast Fleet Appears! Here Come the Whitebeard Pirates!
episodes_data.description: Flashbacks reveal the agonizing sacrifice made by Ace`s mother in order save his life - and the secret behind his connection to Luffy. Back in the present, Whitebeard makes a unexpected entrance!

episodes_data.title: The Beginning of the War! Ace and Whitebeard's Past!
episodes_data.description: As a massive seaquake rocks Marineford, Ace recalls the ups and downs of his life as a pirate, including his first encounter with Whitebeard - and the unthinkable betrayal that led to his capture!

episodes_data.title: The Force That Could Destroy the World! The Power of the Tremor-Tremor Fruit!
episodes_data.description: Whitebeard begins his attack with a tsunami-spawning sea quake, but the marines counter with a blast of frigid air that turns the tidal wave into an iceberg! Will Luffy and his crew arrive in time to join the battle?

episodes_data.title: An All-Consuming Inferno!! Admiral Akainu's Power!
episodes_data.description: Fire meets ice as mythical warriors, erupting admirals, legendary pirates, and a giant giant go head to head in the biggest, baddest battle of all time! There`s only one thing missing: Monkey D. Luffy!

episodes_data.title: A Descendent of the Beast! Little Oars Jr.: Full Speed Ahead!
episodes_data.description: A towering giant of a giant known as Little Oars Jr. carves a path of death and destruction as he fights to save Ace. The monstrous mauler is within arm`s reach of his friend when he`s intercepted by the seven warlords of the sea!

episodes_data.title: Justice for the Winners! Sengoku's Strategy in Action!
episodes_data.description: In the wake of Little Oars Junior`s tragic defeat, Admiral Sengoku hatches a devious plan to speed up the countdown to Ace`s execution. The situation looks beyond bleak until a hero enters the fray from on high!

episodes_data.title: Straw Hat Team Arrives! Tension Grows at the Battlefield
episodes_data.description: Luffy appears on the field of battle with a ferocious sense of urgency. Ace could be executed at any minute, and the rubber-man`s refusal to back down impresses even the most feared men in all the world!

episodes_data.title: Even If It Means Death! Luffy vs. the Navy: The Battle Starts!
episodes_data.description: Luffy leaps into action, attacking the Naval forces with a frantic display of brutality. Meanwhile, Ace watches in horror as an army of zombies rises up to attack his brother!

episodes_data.title: Hard Battles, One After Another! Devil Fruit Eaters vs. Devil Fruit Eaters!
episodes_data.description: Supernatural powers take center stage in the battle to save Ace as Luffy and his uniquely talented allies throw down with the Navy`s own arsenal of Devil Fruit Eaters!

episodes_data.title: Kuma's Transformation! Ivan-san's Blow of Anger!
episodes_data.description: A gift from Boa Hancock and Ivan-san`s Galaxy Wink get Luffy closer to Ace than ever, but a sword-wielding foe from the past threatens to derail the rescue mission!

episodes_data.title: The Great Swordsman Mihawk! Luffy Comes Under the Attack of the Black Sword!
episodes_data.description: Luffy runs into a lethal roadblock in the form of Hawk-Eye Mihawk. The legendary swordsman is determined to halt Luffy`s onslaught, but Ivan-san, Boa Hancock, and Jimbei aren`t ready to give up the fight!

episodes_data.title: The Extermination Strategy in Action! The Power of the Pacifistas!
episodes_data.description: Luffy and his pirate brethren have their hands full with an ominous army of unbeatable Kumas! While the inhuman minions march onward, Whitebeard encounters a former ally!

episodes_data.title: Akainu's Plot! Whitebeard Entrapped!
episodes_data.description: Whitebeard is betrayed - and brutally stabbed - by one of his own men! In the wake of this unthinkable act of treason, allegations about the legendary pirate bring the battle to a halt!

episodes_data.title: The Encircling Walls Activated! The Whitebeard Pirates Backed into a Corner!
episodes_data.description: Whitebeard shrugs off his injuries and leads a ferocious charge into the heart of the enemy`s defenses, but three deadly Admirals join forces to silence his shock wave attack as the pirates find themselves surrounded by impenetrable walls!

episodes_data.title: Execution Order Issued! Break Through the Encircling Walls!
episodes_data.description: With the ice melting beneath his feet, Luffy begins a desperate final charge towards his soon-to-be-executed brother. Should his rescue attempt fail, death will surely embrace them both!

episodes_data.title: Moving into the Final Phase! Whitebeard's Trump Card for Recovery!
episodes_data.description: Crocodile`s unexpected assistance creates an opening for Luffy to advance, and Whitebeard has a surprise lurking beneath the ice that might swing the momentum in favor of the pirates!

episodes_data.title: Luffy at the End of His Tether! An All-Out Battle at the Oris Plaza!
episodes_data.description: The battle rages on and the bodies pile up as Whitebeard squares off against an Admiral, Luffy gets knocked cold, and the legendary Vice-Admiral Garp finally enters the fray!

episodes_data.title: The Power That Will Shorten One's Life! Energy Hormone, Redux!
episodes_data.description: While awaiting his execution, Ace flashes back to a trouble youth spent seeking the truth about his father. Meanwhile, Luffy begs Ivan for a potentially-deadly treatment that will allow him to continue fighting!

episodes_data.title: To Live Up to a Promise! Luffy and Coby Collide!
episodes_data.description: Luffy makes short work of face from his past, and Whitebeard struggles to withstand the full force of the Marine onslaught. With the executioner`s swords hovering above Ace`s head, Straw Hat Luffy discovers a new ability!

episodes_data.title: The Scaffold at Last! The Way to Ace Has Opened!
episodes_data.description: Whitebeard orders his men to help Luffy clear a path to the execution scaffold, but someone close to the Rubber-man rises up to derail the rescue mission at the last second!

episodes_data.title: Each on Different Paths! Luffy vs. Garp!
episodes_data.description: Luffy must defeat the man who taught him how to fight - his own grandfather - in order to save Ace. Battling his own flesh and blood won`t be easy, but a waxy ally is there to provide back up!

episodes_data.title: Ace Rescued! Whitebeard's Final Order!
episodes_data.description: Ace is finally free from the execution scaffold! Luffy and his brother make a fearsome team as they blaze a path toward salvation. Ravaged by the war, Whitebeard wistfully commands his men to make the journey to the New World without him!

episodes_data.title: The Power That Can Burn Even Fire! Akainu's Ruthless Pursuit!
episodes_data.description: Despite Whitebeard`s order to retreat, Ace is drawn back to the battlefield by the cruel taunts of a Marine adversary. Luffy watches in horror as his brother makes what could be his last stand!

episodes_data.title: Looking for the Answer! Fire Fist Ace Dies on the Battlefield!
episodes_data.description: An eerie silence falls over the battlefield as Luffy and Ace share a heartbreaking final moment together. With his dying breath, Ace begs his brother to convey a message to his fellow pirates.

episodes_data.title: The Navy Headquarters Falls! Whitebeard's Unspeakable Wrath!
episodes_data.description: Anguished cries echo across the battlefield in the wake of Ace`s tragic death. Luffy - paralyzed by grief - must be carried to safety, but Whitebeard summons the strength for one last ferocious attack!

episodes_data.title: Ending the Matter! Whitebeard vs. the Blackbeard Pirates!
episodes_data.description: Whitebeard’s children watch in horror as the old man faces off the villainous Blackbeard pirates. Though his injuries are mounting and the odds are stacked against him, Whitebeard never, ever runs away from a fight!

episodes_data.title: The Show Begins! Blackbeard's Plot Is Revealed!
episodes_data.description: The world reacts to Whitebeard`s death with shock and awe. Meanwhile, Jimbei risks his life to save Luffy and Blackbeard reveals the depraved depths of his nefarious nature!

episodes_data.title: The Insatiable Akainu! Lava Fists Pummel Luffy!
episodes_data.description: While Blackbeard and his men seek to sink Marineford, Jimbei and Luffy`s desperate attempt to flee is thwarted by Akainu`s fiery fists. The situation appears dire until a former enemy lends a sandy hand!

episodes_data.title: The Desperate Scream! Courageous Moments That Will Change the Future
episodes_data.description: Trafalgar Law and the Heart Pirates offer Luffy a submarine escape route, Blackbeard continues his reckless rampage, and a puny pink-hair marine changes the world with a scream!

episodes_data.title: Here Comes Shanks! The War of the Best Is Finally Over!
episodes_data.description: The Heart Pirates head for the bottom of the ocean as Trafalgar Law prepares to operate on Luffy and Jimbei. Meanwhile, the arrival of Shanks brings the bloodshed to a sudden halt!

episodes_data.title: Mighty Leaders Face Each Other Down! Heralding the 'New Era'!
episodes_data.description: The world rejoices in the wake of Whitebeard`s death, and a host of powerful pirates vie for his position. Meanwhile, Luffy`s friends fear that Ace`s death may be more than the rubber-man can handle - if he ever wakes up!

episodes_data.title: Landing at the Maiden Island! The Harsh Reality Falls Upon Luffy!
episodes_data.description: Power-hungry pirates terrorize innocent citizens once protected by Whitebeard, and Luffy`s nightmarish awakening sends him on a reckless rampage that could land him in an early grave!

episodes_data.title: The Strongest Tag-Team! Luffy and Toriko's Hard Struggle!
episodes_data.description: One Piece X Toriko Crossover

episodes_data.title: Luffy and Ace! The Story of How the Brothers Met!
episodes_data.description: A flashback to the younger days of Luffy and Ace reveals their unusual upbringing under the not-so-watchful eye of villainous mountain bandits!

episodes_data.title: Here Comes Sabo! The Boy at the Gray Terminal!
episodes_data.description: The flashback continues as Ace robs a ruthless gang of pirates, and Luffy is left to take the fall! Will Ace and his friend Sabo let Luffy be tortured to death - or will they risk their high seas dreams to save him?!

episodes_data.title: I Won't Run! Ace's Desperate Rescue Operation!
episodes_data.description: Ace and Sabo race to rescue Luffy from the clutches of a murderous gang of pirates! Sabo wants to grab Luffy and make a break for it, but Ace refuses to back down from a fight - even when he`s outnumbered!

episodes_data.title: To the Sea Someday! The Pledge of the Three Brats!
episodes_data.description: When a nobleman recognizes Sabo in the streets, Luffy and Ace learn the painful secret of their friend`s past. As a sign of solidarity, the three boys pledge to become pirates, and hoist a toast to brotherhood!

episodes_data.title: Leaving the Dadan Family for Good?! The Kids' Hideout Has Been Built!
episodes_data.description: After another beating from Garp, Luffy and his friends take to the jungle and build a pirate hideout at the top of an enormous tree. First order of business: booby trap the new place!

episodes_data.title: Luffy Becoming an Apprentice?! A Man Who Fought Against the King of the Pirates!
episodes_data.description: Luffy and his friends vow to defeat the giant tiger that`s been stealing their food, Ace gets angry when his father`s identity is revealed, and Sabo`s parents hire pirates to track down their son!

episodes_data.title: The Battle Against the Big Tiger! Who Is Going to Be Captain?!
episodes_data.description: Luffy, Ace, and Sabo take pirate lessons from a mysterious old scallywag who just might know the secret to defeating the big tiger - and becoming a good captian!

episodes_data.title: Freedom Taken Away! The Nobles' Plot Closing In on the Brothers!
episodes_data.description: The brothers are captured by a gang of pirates, and Sabo is handed over to his noble father, where the boy quickly discovers a sinister plot to destroy Gray Terminal forever!

episodes_data.title: The Fire Has Been Set! The Gray Terminal in Crisis!
episodes_data.description: While flames spread across Gray Terminal, Sabo makes a desperate attempt to escape the trappings of his noble birth and save his brothers. Meanwhile, Luffy and Ace must fight to avoid an untimely end!

episodes_data.title: Where Can Freedom Be Found? A Sad Departure of a Boy!
episodes_data.description: Luffy is spared from a fiery death by an unlikely rescuer, but Ace refuses to leave Gray Terminal until he settles the score with Bluejam. Meanwhile, Sabo makes waves with a last ditch escape attempt!

episodes_data.title: Take Good Care of Him! A Letter from the Brother!
episodes_data.description: Luffy and Ace receive troubling reports of a Celestial attack on Sabo`s ship. Ace is eager to seek out the responsible parties and extract revenge, but a letter from his absent brother tempers his eagerness to fight!

episodes_data.title: To Live Up to the Promise! Departures of Their Own!
episodes_data.description: In the wake of Sabo`s death, Luffy and Ace grow stronger than ever by continuing their daily routine of nonstop fighting. As the years pass, each brother prepares to set sail in search of future adventures!

episodes_data.title: I Want to See Them! Luffy's Mournful Cry!
episodes_data.description: Garp takes a beating from a heartbroken mountain bandit, and a big, blue friend helps Luffy drown his despair in the newfound desire to reunite with his mates!

episodes_data.title: Straw Hats in Shock! The Bad News Has Reached Them!
episodes_data.description: One by one, the Straw Hats are crushed to learn the tragic fate of Fire Fist Ace. Despite their own unique problems, the crew members` thoughts immediately turn to their crestfallen captain.

episodes_data.title: Reunited with Dark King Rayleigh! Decision Time for Luffy!
episodes_data.description: Luffy is determined to reassemble his scattered crew, but a powerful old friend forces him to rethink his plans. Meanwhile, Usopp fights to escape an island that wants to have him for lunch!

episodes_data.title: Back to Our Captain! A Jail Break at the Sky Island and the Incident on the Winter Island!
episodes_data.description: Desperate to reach Luffy, Nami risks her life to escape from an island of weather wizards. Meanwhile, Franky rides a carbonation high through the ice and snow in search of a seaworthy vessel!

episodes_data.title: Encounter! The Great Swordsman Mihawk! Zoro's Self-Willed Deadly Struggle!
episodes_data.description: Zoro`s escape attempt is thwarted by a gang of sword-slinging baboon bullies, and Brook uses music to end a feud between irate islanders with unequal arms!

episodes_data.title: A Disaster for Sanji! The Queen's Return to the Kingdom!
episodes_data.description: Chopper hitches a ride on a giant bird, Luffy makes a shocking return to Marineford, and Sanji finds himself fighting the most beautiful man he`s ever seen!

episodes_data.title: Unexpected Relanding! Luffy, to Marineford!
episodes_data.description: Luffy, along with Jimbei and Dark King Rayleigh, causes quite the commotion upon his return to Marineford. Meanwhile, powerful pirates all across the globe wreak havoc on the innocent!

episodes_data.title: With Hopes It Will Reach My Friends! Big News Spreading Fast!
episodes_data.description: Luffy hopes to send a message to his mates by way of a clue hidden in a newspaper article. Meanwhile, the Flying Fish Riders protect the Straw Hat`s ship from scandalous scavengers!

episodes_data.title: Pirates Get on the Move! Astounding New World!
episodes_data.description: Trafalgar Law waits for the right moment to make his move, Blackbeard is pursued by powerful marines, and Chopper makes a surprising return to the land of gargantuan birds!

episodes_data.title: Living through Hell! Sanji's Fight for His Manhood!
episodes_data.description: Nami uses her feminine charms to learn about the New World weather, Franky moves into Dr. Vegapunk`s laboratory, and Sanji must fight to stay out of a cute dress!

episodes_data.title: I Will Get Much, Much Stronger! Zoro's Pledge to His Captain!
episodes_data.description: The Straw Hats continue preparations for their voyage to the New World as Robin heads for a meeting with the Revolutionary Dragon, Usopp aspires to become King of the Snipers, and Zoro begs his mortal enemy to train him!

episodes_data.title: Luffy's Training Begins! To the Place We Promised in 2 Years!
episodes_data.description: Dark King Rayleigh takes Luffy to a deadly, deserted island for two years of intense battle training! If the Straw Hat captain wants to survive in the New World, he`ll have to hone his hidden powers!

episodes_data.title: The Beginning of The New Chapter! The Straw Hats Reunited!
episodes_data.description: After two years of rigorous training, the new and improved Straw Hats make their way to Sabaody Archipelago, but their long-awaited reunion is spoiled by a villainous gang of imposters!

episodes_data.title: An Explosive Situation! Luffy vs. Fake Luffy!
episodes_data.description: Luffy picks a fight with himself, Chopper falls in with a dubious crowd of imitation pirates, and Zoro causes a commotion when he falls asleep on the wrong ship!

episodes_data.title: The Navy Has Set Out! The Straw Hats in Danger!
episodes_data.description: Chopper struggles to make sense of the changes his "friends" have undergone in the last two years, and the Navy mobilizes in an attempt to stop the pirate posers. Will the real Straw Hats please stand up?

episodes_data.title: Big Guns Assembled! The Danger of the Fake Straw Hats!
episodes_data.description: Chopper and Usopp flip over Franky`s new body, Brook must choose between rock-n-roll stardom and the life of a pirate, and Luffy wanders into a very dangerous crowd!

episodes_data.title: The Battle Is On! Show Them What You Got from Training!
episodes_data.description: While the rest of the Straw Hats prepare to set sail, Luffy gets a chance to show off his new powers in a brutal throw down between notorious pirates, navy soldiers, and deadly Pacifistas!

episodes_data.title: Everyone Together! Luffy, Setting Out for the New World!
episodes_data.description: Luffy and his crew are finally reunited, but before they can set sail, they`ll need help from Dark King Rayleigh, Boa Hancock, and all the friends they`ve made in the last two years!

episodes_data.title: A Suprising Fact! The Man Who Guarded the Sunny!
episodes_data.description: As word of the Straw Hat resurrection spreads through the Navy, Luffy and his crew get acclimated to their underwater environment, and Franky reveals the startling identity of the man who protected their ship!

episodes_data.title: Deadly Combat Under the Sea! The Demon of the Ocean Strikes!
episodes_data.description: The Straw Hats are attacked by a rival gang of pirates, but that may be the least of their worries. Luffy and his crew are on a collision course with a cantankerous Kraken!

episodes_data.title: Lost in the Deep Sea! The Straw Hats Get Separated!
episodes_data.description: After their quarrel with the Kraken, the Straw Hats find themselves in hot water as Luffy, Zoro, and Sanji turn up missing, and the rest of the crew runs short on air!

episodes_data.title: Undersea Volcanic Eruption! Drifting to the Fish-Man Island!
episodes_data.description: Thanks to a little help from a friend, Luffy saves his mates from a ghost ship captained by a deranged Dutchman! Unfortunately, their happy reunion is cut short by a volcanic eruption! Can the Hats take the heat?

episodes_data.title: Landing at the Fish-Man Island! Beautiful Mermaids!
episodes_data.description: The Straw Hats finally make it to Fish-Man Island, but their reputation precedes them, leading to trouble with the New Fish-Man Pirates! Only a daring maneuver can get them out of hot water, but there`s no guarantee they`ll survive!

episodes_data.title: Excitement Blow-Out! Sanji's Life Under Threat!
episodes_data.description: When Sanji gets up close and personal with a mesmerizing mermaid, his extreme fondness for the female form lands him in a life and death situation. Could the Straw Hat chef die from a nosebleed?!

episodes_data.title: The Fish-Man Island Will Be Annihilated?! Sharley's Prophecy!
episodes_data.description: After two generous donors save Sanji from death by nosebleed, Luffy and Usopp take a tour of the island. But their welcome is worn out when a mystic mermaid has a terrifying vision - that Fish-Man Island will be destroyed at the hands of a Straw Hat!

episodes_data.title: The King of the Fish-Man Island! Neptune, the God of the Sea!
episodes_data.description: After reuniting with Nami, Luffy and the gang are invited to the royal palace of Neptune, god of the sea! Meanwhile, the New Fish-Man Pirates exploit the power of a designer steroid in order to terrorize humans!

episodes_data.title: The Ryugu Palace! Taken by the Shark That They Saved!
episodes_data.description: A trio of unsuspecting mermaids find themselves in hot water after releasing a bad guy from his barrel of a prison. Over at the royal palace, Luffy gets up close and personal with the Mermaid Princess!

episodes_data.title: A Coward and a Crybaby! The Princess in the Hard Shell Tower!
episodes_data.description: Luffy`s lightning reflexes spare the Mermaid Princess from a grisly death, Neptune`s army attempts to apprehend the Straw Hats, and Captain Vander Decken forges a sinister undersea alliance!

episodes_data.title: It's an Emergency! The Ryugu Palace Is Occupied!
episodes_data.description: With their backs against the wall, the Straw Hats are forced to take King Neptune and his men hostage. On the other side of the palace, Luffy and the Mermaid Princess make plans to visit the Sea Forrest!

episodes_data.title: The Ryugu Palace in Shock! The Kidnapping of Shirahoshi!
episodes_data.description: Luffy accidentally "kidnaps" the Mermaid Princess, an old friend issues a grave warning to Chopper and Sanji, and the New Fish-Man Pirates prepare for a raid on Ryugu Palace!

episodes_data.title: Hordy's Onslaught! The Retaliatory Plan Set into Motion!
episodes_data.description: Captain Vander Decken and Hordy Jones manage to successfully breach the defenses of Ryugu Palace. Meanwhile, Jimbei waits patiently for Luffy to arrive at the Sea Forest.

episodes_data.title: The Battle in the Ryugu Palace! Zoro vs. Hordy!
episodes_data.description: Robin ventures into the forest in search of ancient secrets, Zoro takes to the water for a slicing, dicing showdown with Hordy Jones, and Luffy is branded a royal kidnapper by an angry mob of fish folk!

episodes_data.title: Keep Shirahoshi Safe! Decken Close Behind!
episodes_data.description: Luffy, Chopper, and Sanji are taken prisoner by a fish mob just as Vander Decken launches an attack the princess! Elsewhere, Zoro continues his battle with Hordy, and Nami hitches a ride on a mermaid to escape the crumbling palace!

episodes_data.title: The Straw Hats Defeated?! Hordy Gains Control of the Ryugu Palace!
episodes_data.description: Zoro and Neptune fight bravely, but they`re no match for Hordy and his pill-popping minions. Back at the ship, Luffy reunites with Jimbei, who reveals something sinister about his past.

episodes_data.title: The Haunting Ties! Nami and the Fish-Man Pirates!
episodes_data.description: The New Fish-Man Pirates continue their bloody and violent uprising, and Jimbei begins the story of how he unleashed the monster known as Arlong on the unsuspecting citizens of the East Blue.

episodes_data.title: A Hero Who Freed the Slaves! An Adventurer Tiger!
episodes_data.description: Jimbei continues his story with tales of fish-men taken as slaves, Queen Otohime`s fierce devotion to her people, the legend of Fisher Tiger, and the sinister rise of Arlong.

episodes_data.title: Kizaru Appears! A Trap to Catch Tiger!
episodes_data.description: Arlong`s violent tendencies are condemned by Fisher Tiger, and the arrival of a young human girl teaches the Fish-Man Pirates a lesson in compassion.

episodes_data.title: A Team Is Formed! Save Chopper
episodes_data.description: One Piece X Toriko Crossover

episodes_data.title: The Death of the Hero! A Shocking Truth of Tiger!
episodes_data.description: The great pirate Fisher Tiger keeps his promise to a young slave girl, but the adults in her village are determined to make him pay for his act of honor.

episodes_data.title: The Sun Pirates Split! Jimbei vs. Arlong!
episodes_data.description: In the wake of Fisher Tiger`s tragic death, the once-mighty Sun Pirates are splintered by an ongoing quarrel between Jimbei and Arlong. Meanwhile, Queen Otohime`s ceasless quest to help her people begins to take its toll.

episodes_data.title: Shaking Fish-Man Island! A Celestial Dragon Drifts In!
episodes_data.description: Tensions run high when a slave-owning Celestial Dragon washes up on Fish-Man Island. His former captives cry for out for blood, but Queen Otohime sees it as a chance to mend fences between the gilled and non-gilled!

episodes_data.title: A Sudden Tragedy! A Gunshot Shuts Down the Future!
episodes_data.description: After an agonizing absence, Queen Otohime returns to her people with exciting news. Unfortunately, a horrific act of violence derails the queen`s mission and changes life on Fish-Man Island forever.

episodes_data.title: Back to the Present! Hordy Makes a Move!
episodes_data.description: Jimbei reaches the heartbreaking conclusion in the story of Queen Otohime, Nami does something completely unexpected, and Hordy Jones makes a foreboding appearance!

episodes_data.title: The Kingdom in Shock! An Order to Execute Neptune Issued!
episodes_data.description: Hordy announces his sinister plans for Fish-Man Island. Luffy and Shirahoshi are ready to fight, but Jimbei wants to wage this war on his own!

episodes_data.title: A Rift Opens Up! Luffy vs. Jimbei!
episodes_data.description: Luffy and Jimbei come to blows over how to handle Hordy`s uprising. Back at the palace, Brook embarks on an out of body experience with hopes of saving his mates!

episodes_data.title: Something Has Happened to Hordy! The True Power of the Evil Drug!
episodes_data.description: Jimbei and Luffy continue their standoff, the New Fish-Man pirates go on a rampage, and Hordy begins to experience startling side effects from his pill-popping habit!

episodes_data.title: The Battle Is On! At Conchchorde Plaza!
episodes_data.description: Hordy`s rampant use of the energy steroid makes him bigger, stronger, and scarier than ever before! The Fish-Man princes join the battle, but even they may not be strong enough to stop Hordy`s onslaught!

episodes_data.title: A Surprising Confession! The Truth Behind the Assassination of Otohime!
episodes_data.description: Jimbei and Shirahoshi are captured by the enemy, and Hordy makes a shocking revelation to the population of Fish-Man Island!

episodes_data.title: Shirahoshi's Tears! Luffy Finally Shows Up!
episodes_data.description: Shirahoshi reveals that she knew the truth about her mother`s murder all along, and Luffy makes a bone-crushing entrance when the princess needs him most!

episodes_data.title: A Big Clash! The Straw Hats vs. a Hundred Thousand Enemies!
episodes_data.description: Hordy announces his plan for turning humans into slaves, the people of Fish-Man Island throw their support behind a new champion, and Luffy amazes even his own friends!

episodes_data.title: Deadly Attacks One After Another! Zoro and Sanji Join the Battle!
episodes_data.description: Luffy and the gang show off how much stronger they`ve become by issuing a brutal beat down to Hordy and his ferocious Fish-Man Pirates! Can anything stop the Hats?

episodes_data.title: Unveiled! The Secret Weapons of the Sunny!
episodes_data.description: Hordy`s men keep attacking, but the Straw Hats have new weapons at their disposal! Franky unleashes the fury of the Black Rhino, and Luffy turns the tables on Hordy with a little help from his Kraken!

episodes_data.title: Iron Pirate! Here Comes General Franky!
episodes_data.description: Franky dazzles Usopp and Chopper by transforming into a gigantic fighting robot, Hordy tries to blackmail the Kraken, and Luffy introduces his fist to the Fish-man`s face!

episodes_data.title: The Noah Closing in! The Fish-Man Island Facing Destruction!
episodes_data.description: Luffy shows off even more new powers as he brutally pummels Hordy, but the main attraction proves to be an ancient and immense pirate ship that`s heading straight for Fish-Man Island!

episodes_data.title: Hurry Up, Luffy! Shirahoshi's Life in Jeopardy!
episodes_data.description: Shirahoshi summons the courage to risk everything to save her world, Luffy puts his own life in peril by venturing into the ocean, and Hordy`s devious nature fully comes to the surface.

episodes_data.title: The Fierce Fight Begins! Luffy vs. Hordy!
episodes_data.description: Luffy sets the stage for a final battle with Hordy, Sanji kicks a giant in defense of Nami`s honor, and Zoro puts his blades to the ultimate test against a steroid-powered fighting fish!

episodes_data.title: A Massive Confused Fight! The Straw Hats vs. the New Fish-Man Pirates!
episodes_data.description: While Luffy and Shirahoshi try to prevent Fish-Man Island from being crushed, the rest of the Straw Hats square off against the meanest Fish-Man Pirates in the deep blue sea!

episodes_data.title: Luffy Loses the Fight?! Hordy's Long-Awaited Revenge!
episodes_data.description: Luffy is the only one who can stop Hordy, but he`ll need air to survive the fight, so Shirahoshi`s big brother risks his own life in heroic attempt to get Luffy a bigger bubble!

episodes_data.title: A Shocking Fact! The True Identity of Hordy!
episodes_data.description: While the rest of the Straw Hats continue to fight bravely, Luffy tries to find a way to save the island, and the horrible truth about Hordy`s hatred for humans is finally revealed!

episodes_data.title: Back to Zero! Earnest Wishes for Luffy!
episodes_data.description: Hordy`s twisted past takes center stage in a Fish-Man flashback. Meanwhile, Shirahoshi`s brother begs Luffy to save his beloved homeland and wipe out the anti-human element!

episodes_data.title: Luffy's All-Out Attack! Red Hawk Blasts!
episodes_data.description: Luffy`s fist of fire puts Hordy down for the count, and the rest of the Straw Hats try to make short work of the remaining Fish-Man Pirates. Meanwhile, a very big boat looms overhead!

episodes_data.title: Coming to an End! The Final Decisive Battle against Hordy!
episodes_data.description: While the rest of the Straw Hats try to make short work of their enemies, Luffy summons the strength for one last brutal attack on Hordy. Now, about that giant boat...

episodes_data.title: Stop, Noah! Desperate Elephant Gantling!
episodes_data.description: After defeating Hordy, Luffy turns his attention to stopping the Noah from crushing Fish-Man Island. Straw Hats and Fish-Men alike watch as Luffy tries to obliterate a boat with a barrage of brutal blows!

episodes_data.title: To the Future! The Path to the Sun!
episodes_data.description: Fish-Man Island was saved by the timely arrival of the Sea Kings, but all is not well. Luffy lost a lot of blood in his battle with Hordy, and fish-to-human transfusions are strictly forbidden!

episodes_data.title: The Secret Revealed! The Truth About the Ancient Weapon!
episodes_data.description: Jimbei must decide whether or not to join the Straw Hats, and the grateful citizens of Fish-Man Island host a fabulous banquet in honor of their human heroes!

episodes_data.title: The Straw Hats Stunned! The New Fleet Admiral of the Navy!
episodes_data.description: Luffy and his crew learn of epic battle between Aokiji and Akainu, a forgotten foe tries to kidnap the mermaid princess, and Hordy`s gang finally gets what`s coming to them!
