episodes_data.description: Now, the assassination plan of Big Mom is all set and everyone starts preparing for the Tea Party. Montd`Or finds one of his crewmates, Bobbin the Disposer, dead, and suspects Sanji and Luffy of the crime. He goes to check if Sanji is in his room, just as Sanji is running to get back so as not to arouse suspicion.

episodes_data.title: The Family Gets Together! The Hellish Tea Party Starts!
episodes_data.description: The day has arrived! Guests from the criminal underground pour in in droves, but some have their own agendas to settle! Big Mom’s sons, however, stand in their way and show them what they’ve got! Meanwhile, Luffy is preparing for his own plan!

episodes_data.title: The Broken Couple! Sanji and Pudding Enter!
episodes_data.description: Final preparations abound on all sides and multiple plots start to come together! But can Sanji keep his nerve and go through with the plan? Or will Pudding`s beauty prove too enchanting?

episodes_data.title: A Deadly Kiss! The Mission to Assassinate the Emperor Kicks Off!
episodes_data.description: All plans go into action as the moment of the wedding arrives - but as the veil is lifted on Pudding`s grotesque face, all hell breaks loose and unexpected circumstances mean chaos breaks out at the altar! Meanwhile, Luffy charges in, adding to the mayhem!

episodes_data.title: Returning the Sake Cup! The Manly Jimbei Pays His Debt!
episodes_data.description: The plan is launched! Big Mom falls to pieces as the wedding - and the wedding cake - are destroyed and a slew of Luffys are wreaking havoc around the site. But just when Luffy gets in trouble, Jimbei confronts Big Mom bravely!

episodes_data.title: The Mission Failed?! The Big Mom Pirates Strike Back!
episodes_data.description: The plan is in full swing however - Big Mom is pushed past the edge of sanity and can`t even bring herself to act. Meanwhile, her children make a move against Germa and Pudding takes up her original aim of killing Sanji!

episodes_data.title: Run, Sanji! SOS! Germa 66!
episodes_data.description: The plot is in full swing as Luffy dashes towards Big Mom to show her the broken portrait again! Sanji makes an effort to free his family and wins the respect of his sister and Big Mom loses her wits!

episodes_data.title: Mom's Secret! The Giant's Island Elbaph and a Little Monster!
episodes_data.description: The tragic and sad history of Big Mom is revealed! From abandonment, rescue, and again to ruin, Big Mom`s voracious hunger has brought her into conflict with others from the very beginning!

episodes_data.title: The Birth of Mom! The Day That Carmel Vanished!
episodes_data.description: Linlin enrages the Giants as she slays their respected warrior - but Mother throws herself on their mercy and begs for clemency for her beloved Linlin, forcing the troupe to leave Elbaph for good. But the kindness Mother shows belies a dark and twisted secret...

episodes_data.title: The Launcher Blasts! The Moment Of Big Mom's Assassination!
episodes_data.description: Linlin, destroyed at the disappearance of Mother, falls in with a new cohort and finds a reason to go on living, proving herself a mighty force to be reckoned with! The Straw Hats’ plan goes awry and all hope looks to be lost!

episodes_data.title: The Evil Army! Transform! Germa 66!
episodes_data.description: Bege and the Straw Hats are on the defensive as the full force of Mom`s troops are brought down on them! As they retreat into a fortress, Germa 66 springs in to action! However, Bege has bad news for his allied forces.

episodes_data.title: Cutting the Father-Son Relationship! Sanji and Judge!
episodes_data.description: The Straw Hats and Germa 66 are cornered in Bege`s stronghold - with the full force of the Big Mom Pirates pinning them down, it`s only a matter of time before their defenses crack. The only way out seems to be to make a break for it.

episodes_data.title: Escape from the Tea Party! Luffy vs. Big Mom!
episodes_data.description: The plan is executed to sneak the Straw Hats out of Big Mom`s castle while hidden inside Bege! But the irascible Luffy can`t resist getting in at least one punch against his foe! Meanwhile the Tamate Box slips into the hands of some surprising agent!

episodes_data.title: The Execution Begins! Luffy's Allied Forces Are Annihilated?!
episodes_data.description: The full might of the Big Mom Pirates proves too much for the Straw Hats and Germa 66. With no other options, they decide to turn and fight, even though it means their total annihilation! But the mysterious Tamate Box comes in to play and shakes up the playing field - literally!

episodes_data.title: The Chateau Collapses! The Straw Hat's Great Escape Begins!
episodes_data.description: The Whole Cake Chateau starts crumbling while everyone is trying to escape for their lives! Luffy and the others get away and move on to the next stage of their escape which involves some parting of ways. Meanwhile, Big Mom’s children notice their mother’s change of behavior at the worst possible moment.

episodes_data.title: The Spear of Elbaph! Onslaught! The Flying Big Mom!
episodes_data.description: The Straw Hats continue their mad dash to the Sunny! As Big Mom rages, her underlings decide to turn her Hunger Pang attacks against the Straw Hats! The Whole Cake Island scrambles to remake the cake to calm down Big Mom!

episodes_data.title: Pudding's Determination! Ablaze! The Seducing Woods!
episodes_data.description: Kingbaum puts his life on the line ferrying the Straw Hats towards the Seducing Woods! But Big Mom`s word trumps him in this terrifying forest, and soon enough she catches up! Meanwhile, Pudding puts her plan to rebuild the cake into action - and reveals her surprising motivations!

episodes_data.title: A Lightning Counterattack! Nami and Zeus the Thundercloud!
episodes_data.description: Zeus pursues the Straw Hats as Nami keeps him occupied. She has a shocking surprise in store for him, however, that might stop Big Mom in her tracks! Meanwhile, Brook and Chopper find the Shark Submerge in a strange situation.

episodes_data.title: A Coincidental Reunion! Sanji and the Lovestruck Evil Pudding!
episodes_data.description: Big Mom is relentless in her pursuit of the Straw Hats! Even being buried alive doesn`t stop her! The plan to recreate the cake to stop her onslaught progresses and Pudding’s changeable heart confuses all those looking on!

episodes_data.title: Save the Sunny! Fighting Bravely! Chopper and Brook!
episodes_data.description: Mama`s onslaught continues as Pudding keeps battling the contradictory urges in her head - to kill or kiss Sanji! Meanwhile, Brook and Chopper are at Perospero`s mercy - and are being reduced to sweetened versions of themselves!

episodes_data.title: Before the Dawn! Pedro, the Captain of the Guardians!
episodes_data.description: Sandwiched between Big Mom and her advancing fleet, the only hope is the Sunny`s Coup-de-Burst! But can the Straw Hats prepare it in time? Meanwhile, Pedro comes face to face with his past, and embraces a dramatic end to be sure that the tides of time continue to flow!

episodes_data.title: I'll Be Back! Luffy, Deadly Departure!
episodes_data.description: The last chance the Straw Hats have is the Coup de Burst! Pedro has made the ultimate sacrifice to give them this one chance to escape, but Big Mom`s naval forces are closing in and poised to knock them out! Luffy has to put himself on the line again to save his crew!

episodes_data.title: The Man with a Bounty of Billion! The Strongest Sweet General, Katakuri!
episodes_data.description: Nami and the others who escaped the Whole Cake Island by Pedro’s sacrifice mourn over his death. Jimbei, however, keeps his calm which makes Brook lose his temper. Meanwhile, Luffy confronts the formidable Sweet General Katakuri in the Mirroworld.

episodes_data.title: A Hard Battle Starts! Luffy vs. Katakuri!
episodes_data.description: Pudding and Sanji arrive at Cacao Island and begin to remake the only cake that will calm Big Mom! But their fake nuptials get in the way as they bicker like a married couple! Meanwhile, Luffy has lost the battle of his life - and the flame goes out of him... until the Sunny becomes the target of a new threat!

episodes_data.title: The Green Room! An Invincible Helmsman, Jimbei!
episodes_data.description: Luffy keeps the forces out to destroy the Straw Hats at bay, however the crew needs to destroy all the mirrors - the final link that secure his safe return - on the ship in order to save themselves! At the same time, the ship is on a course for disaster, with Jimbei at the helm!

episodes_data.title: The Threat of the Mole! Luffy's Silent Fight!
episodes_data.description: Nami and the others start breaking all the mirrors on the Sunny in order to keep their enemies out while she and Luffy discuss where to rendezvous – but little do they know the plan is overheard! Meanwhile, Luffy’s grueling battle against Katakuri intensifies!

episodes_data.title: The End of the Deadly Battle?! Katakuri's Awakening in Anger!
episodes_data.description: Both powerful combatants and strong users of Haki, Luffy and Katakuri are a dead match for each other. Every move is matched by their opponent! Elsewhere, the Big Mom Pirates square off against Germa! With so much at stake, Luffy falls to Katakuri, spelling his doom!

episodes_data.title: The Forbidden Secret! Katakuri's Merienda!
episodes_data.description: Katakuri retires to his sanctuary to enjoy the merienda - a chance for him to savor the sweetness of his crew of chefs and replenish his Haki! But he`s not the only one who`s doing eating, as Straw Hat uses his mouth to get out from under the mochi mountain crushing him!

episodes_data.title: Luffy Fights Back! The Invincible Katakuri's Weak Point!
episodes_data.description: Luffy discovers the secret to Katakuri`s unearthly fighting ability, and just might have a solution for how to stop him! Meanwhile at the Sweets Factory, Pudding receives a call from Brulee who has bad news for the Straw Hats!

episodes_data.title: Another Crisis! Gear Four vs. Unstoppable Donuts!
episodes_data.description: Luffy runs out of his Haki and has to buy some time - in the most peculiar way! Meanwhile the Big Mom Pirates mobilize their entire fleet to squelch the pirate threat, and the replacement cake nears completion!

episodes_data.title: The Rebellious Daughter, Chiffon! Sanji's Big Plan for Transporting the Cake!
episodes_data.description: When Chiffon comes under attack, Sanji must choose between defending her or revealing himself to his enemies! Meanwhile, Luffy uses Brulee as a human shield to avoid the wrath of Big Mom!

episodes_data.title: A Man's Way of Life! Bege and Luffy's Determination as Captains!
episodes_data.description: Bege arrives on the scene, seemingly willing to risk it all to bring down the Big Mom Pirates in a blaze of glory, but of course he has a trick up his sleeve! Meanwhile Luffy keeps on the move to regain his Haki, but begins to ponder just how far his limits can be pushed!

episodes_data.title: The Cake Sank?! Sanji and Bege's Getaway Battle!
episodes_data.description: Sanji and Bege get together and get off of Cacao Island successfully but their plan is in jeopardy as Oven begins to boil the sea itself! As Chiffon and the others who are on the ship are cornered, a surprising savior comes in to fight Oven!

episodes_data.title: Sulong! Carrot's Big Mystic Transformation!
episodes_data.description: A vicious pincer attack bears down on the Straw Hats! Three fleets converge and try to squeeze the life from them! Daifuku himself take the lead! But Carrot draws on a deep power within and springs in to action under the light of the moon!

episodes_data.title: Break Through! The Straw Hat's Mighty Sea Battle!
episodes_data.description: The much anticipated wedding cake is on its way, but there is a debate at the last minute! Shouldn`t this opportunity be used to slip poison into Big Mom`s meal to topple the Emperor of the Sea? Meanwhile, Carrot`s unearthly ability based on the power of the moon saves the day!

episodes_data.title: Finally, They Clash! The Emperor of the Sea vs. the Straw Hats!
episodes_data.description: Luffy, through sheer force of will, can almost use his Haki to battle Katakuri! Meanwhile, the Sunny catches fire while the Straw Hats try to kick out Big Mom but that’s when Jimbei steps up to the plate and takes a swing at her!

episodes_data.title: Dark King's Direct Precepts! The Battle Against Katakuri Turns Around!
episodes_data.description: Luffy tries to enhance his Haki to foresee Katakuri’s next move but Katakuri’s attacks keep pulling him down! However, when he summons every bit of wisdom from his training with Rayleigh, he remembers something important that could turn the tables for him!

episodes_data.title: Finally He Returns! Sanji, the Man Who'll Stop the Emperor of the Sea!
episodes_data.description: The cake is finally prepared and brought before Big Mom! With the end of her vicious rampage in sight, there is a chance for the Straw Hats to flee! Big Mom`s crew is forced to decide who to attack! Meanwhile, Luffy grows ever closer to using his Haki!

episodes_data.title: Lurking in the Darkness! An Assassin Targeting Luffy!
episodes_data.description: Hiding her presence, Flampe shoots her blowgun at Luffy to support her dear brother Katakuri. Meanwhile, Oven launches a dastardly plan to fence Luffy in - by destroying every mirror on the island! And Smoothie is on the tail of the Sunny as it makes its way towards Cacao Island!

episodes_data.title: One Man's Determination! Katakuri's Deadly Big Fight!
episodes_data.description: Katakuri notices his sister Flampe is sneakily providing poison needle back up in the shadows. Becoming enraged, he takes unexpected action that surprises everyone. Meanwhile, Smoothie increases her size and closes in on the Sunny.

episodes_data.title: Wake Up! The Color of Observation Able to Top the Strongest!
episodes_data.description: Luffy leans on his training to bring out the power of his Haki! Meanwhile the children of Big Mom gather as a massive force ready to smash Luffy and the Straw Hats. Their resentment at being embarrassed fuels their desire to get revenge!

episodes_data.title: A Fist of Divine Speed! Another Gear Four Application Activated!
episodes_data.description: Luffy and Katakuri are locked in a duel to end all duels! Their powers ensure that each blow could be the last! Luffy must rely on his training, let all his thoughts out, and keep pushing on! Meanwhile, Sanji is about to land at Cacao Island!

episodes_data.title: Finally, It's Over! The Climax of the Intense Fight Against Katakuri!
episodes_data.description: Luffy`s dramatic battle finally draws to a close! But even if he is able to pull out victory in the last moment, can he remember the key to escaping the Mirrorworld?! Meanwhile, the whole host of the Big Mom Pirates watch the lonely mirror to see who will come through!

episodes_data.title: A Desperate Situation! The Iron-tight Entrapment of Luffy!
episodes_data.description: Luffy emerges safely! And Pekoms` bravery ensures he and the Straw Hats have a fighting chance! But can they withstand the full force of the Big Mom Pirates? At the last moment - a surprise explodes onto the scene!

episodes_data.title: Pulling Back from the Brink! The Formidable Reinforcements: Germa!
episodes_data.description: Sanji tries his best to save himself and his captain, Luffy! But the arrival of Germa has complicated matters. Whose side do these powerful superhumans fight on? In the end, sisterly love will see Sanji saved!

episodes_data.title: The Last Hope! The Sun Pirates Emerge!
episodes_data.description: Luffy and Sanji are safe! But the critical moment approaches - the fate of Totto Land rests on the taste of the wedding cake! Will it be sweet release or bitter defeat? Meanwhile, a cunning pincer attack leaves the Straw Hats hopelessly trapped. Only old, reliable comrades can save the day!

episodes_data.title: A Captivating Flavor! Sanji's Cake of Happiness!
episodes_data.description: With the help of the Sun Pirates, the Straw Hats see their chance to escape! And the Sun Pirates bid farewell to their former captain. Mama finally tastes the Wedding Cake and the results are positively scrumptious!

episodes_data.title: The Man of Humanity and Justice! Jimbei, a Desperate Massive Ocean Current
episodes_data.description: The Big Mom Pirates fooled! The Straw Hats have eluded their would-be tormentors with the help of the Sun Pirates! However, as the fleet of the Big Mom Pirates is still coming after them, Jimbei makes a crucial decision to help the Sunny to get away.

episodes_data.title: The Parting Time! Pudding's Last Wish!
episodes_data.description: At a great cost of energy and life, the Straw Hats make it out of Totto Land. Left behind in their wake are allies and friends, and would-be lovers. As the sea opens before them, what price has been paid for their escape?

episodes_data.title: The World Is Stunned! The Fifth Emperor of the Sea Emerges!
episodes_data.description: Luffy`s recent exploits make their way around the world! The reputation of this mighty pirate begins to grow as all eyes look towards the Straw Hats` next move! Also - German 66 leaves an artifact behind which excites the crew!

episodes_data.title: To the Reverie! The Straw Hats' Sworn Allies Come Together!
episodes_data.description: As the royals make their way to the Reverie, the mighty Navy takes all precautions to make sure they don`t fall prey to kidnappings! At the vanguard is Koby, who glimpses Luffy`s exploits and remembers their shared past. Meanwhile, Luffy is confronted with a staggering change to his bounty!

episodes_data.title: Sabo Goes into Action! All the Captains of the Revolutionary Army Appear!
episodes_data.description: A vicious pirate group led by Pinkbeard who describes himself as one of Blackbeard’s affiliates attacks a town in the Kingdom of Lulucia while their king and able-bodied soldiers have gone to the Reverie. And four bizarre individuals come to help. They’re the captains of the Revolutionary Army.

episodes_data.title: Going into Action! The Implacable New Admiral of the Fleet - Sakazuki!
episodes_data.description: At New Marineford, Sakazuki, the new Admiral of the Fleet, hears the news about Luffy and recalls the tumultuous Paramount War that haunts the Navy! That game-changing war has repercussions that last into the present!

episodes_data.title: The Paramount War! The Inherited Will of the King of the Pirates!
episodes_data.description: Nobles from around the world gather for the Reverie as the echoes of the Paramount War resound! Among them are Shirahoshi and her family from the Ryugu Kingdom under the sea. Meanwhile, Admiral Fujitora has a conversation with his new colleague, Admiral Ryokugyu.

episodes_data.title: One Step Forward for Her Dream! Shirahoshi Goes Out in the Sun!
episodes_data.description: Stelly, Sabo’s adopted brother and now the king of the Goa Kingdom, walks up to Garp who is escorting the royal family of the Fish-Man Island, with an air of importance and something up his sleeve. Meanwhile, Shirahoshi sees the surface world for the first time.

episodes_data.title: I Miss Him! Vivi and Rebecca's Sentiments!
episodes_data.description: Shirahoshi and her family finally reach the Holyland of Mariejois! But all the unexpected attention confuses her. Meanwhile, Vivi from Alabasta meets Leo and Rebecca from Dressrosa, and tells them the story of her journey with the Straw Hats.

episodes_data.title: In the Dark Recesses of the Holyland! A Mysterious Giant Straw Hat!
episodes_data.description: Vivi reunites with Dalton and Dr. Kureha from the Sakura Kingdom and they share their memories of the Straw Hats with Shirahoshi and Rebecca. Meanwhile, a shadowy figure descends a long staircase at the castle in the Holyland and opens a mysterious door.

episodes_data.title: The Holyland in Tumult! The Targeted Princess Shirahoshi!
episodes_data.description: Shirahoshi crosses the fancy of a Celestial Dragon, and those living gods are not open to having their whims disobeyed! As she is dragged away, King Neptune comes to her rescue, risking life and limb by defying the Celestial Dragon, but luckily an old friend of the Ryugu Kingdom is on hand and tries to defuse the situation!

episodes_data.title: An Explosive Situation! Two Emperors of the Sea Going After Luffy!
episodes_data.description: The Emperors of the Sea, Big Mom and Kaido decide to team up against Luffy! Meanwhile, Garp hears about the wild exploits of his grandson, all while a mysterious outsider visits the highest authority in the world!

episodes_data.title: Sabo Enraged! The Tragedy of the Revolutionary Army Officer Kuma!
episodes_data.description: After sneaking into the Land of the Gods, Sabo sees the shocking figure of his friend – Kuma! Abused by the World Government as a pawn in their games, Kuma, who was made an example of what happens when you disobey the gods!

episodes_data.title: Finally, It Starts! The Conspiracy-filled Reverie!
episodes_data.description: The Reverie has begun! The representative kings and queens first discuss what to do with Straw Hat Luffy. Meanwhile the Revolutionary Army confirms its desire to save Kuma! All while they recount how the Straw Hats have grown from upstarts into world players!

episodes_data.title: Marco! The Keeper of Whitebeard's Last Memento!
episodes_data.description: In order to recruit a strong ally towards bringing down Kaido, Cat Viper and his crew stop by Whitebeard’s homeland to see Marco, the 1st division commander of the Whitebeard Pirates.

episodes_data.title: Climbing up a Waterfall! A Great Journey Through the Land of Wano's Sea Zone!
episodes_data.description: Luffy and the others become excited as they see familiar faces in a newspaper article about the Reverie while they close in on the Land of Wano. But this dangerous and foreboding land is as inaccessible as it is mysterious! The sea itself is a barrier!

episodes_data.title: The Land of Wano! To the Samurai Country Where Cherry Blossoms Flutter!
episodes_data.description: A mysterious country, a rampaging slasher, ancient samurai rituals of seppuku - and Zoro in the crosshairs! When a street assault occurs, all signs point to Zoro! Meanwhile, Luffy finally arrives at the Land of Wano but all his friends are nowhere to be found.

episodes_data.title: Otama Appears! Luffy vs. Kaido's Army!
episodes_data.description: Stranded alone on the beach, Luffy tries to gather his bearings only to be confronted by some mysterious, and dangerous, local fauna! And then, he meets a little girl named Otama! Meanwhile, Zoro makes trouble for the others who are trying to blend in!

episodes_data.title: He'll Come! The Legend of Ace in the Land of Wano!
episodes_data.description: Otama`s gratitude towards Luffy knows no bounds! But the feast she cooks him exhausts her food stores completely! As she suffers from poor drinking water, her companion tells the story of the mysterious outsider she waits for - Ace!

episodes_data.title: Side Story! The World's Greatest Bounty Hunter, Cidre!
episodes_data.description: Ambushed and outgunned by a skilled bounty hunter Cidre’s group, the Straw Hats rely on the Sunny`s Coup de Burst to escape! But they end up stranded without cola! A nearby soda island offers a solution - but Luffy is quickly in over his head! Luckily a vivacious old friend is nearby!

episodes_data.title: Side Story! Clash! Luffy vs. the King of Carbonation!
episodes_data.description: Luffy and Boa Hancock square off against the Cidre Guild! These unscrupulous bounty hunters have one thing in mind - profit at any cost! When the battle looks won, Cidre gears up in a menacing power suit!

episodes_data.title: Save Otama! Straw Hat, Bounding Through the Wasteland!
episodes_data.description: Otama recounts her promise to Ace while Luffy rushes her to medical attention. But just as they reach the wasteland, a familiar face comes into view! But Kaido`s underlings show up too!

episodes_data.title: The Headliner! Hawkins the Magician Appears!
episodes_data.description: Otama’s temperature is going up and Luffy has no time to waste! However, Hawkins, one of Kaido’s Headliners, blocks their way by showing his unique powers and skills which can harm his own men.

episodes_data.title: Defeat Is Inevitable! The Strawman's Fierce Attack!
episodes_data.description: Luffy and Zoro have been stalled by Hawkins but their fortune looks bright as they are guided by a woman who Zoro had saved. She leads them to a teahouse and to an herbal remedy for the river poison. All the while, old acquaintances look on from a distance!

episodes_data.title: The Greatest Day of My Life! Otama and Her Sweet Red-bean Soup!
episodes_data.description: Otama`s life is saved by Otsuru at her teahouse. The proud Otama finds it hard to take more kindness. The group learns of the Okobore Town - living on the cast-offs of the officials! Then, suddenly, they were attacked by the Shogun’s men!

episodes_data.title: Charging into the Enemy's Territory! Bakura Town: Where Officials Thrive!
episodes_data.description: Otama has been kidnapped by the Gifters! She is taken to a flourishing town called Bakura Town where a creepy-looking Headliner was expecting her. Luffy and Zoro rush to rescue her along with a samurai, Okiku!

episodes_data.title: The Yokozuna Appears! The Invincible Urashima Goes After Okiku!
episodes_data.description: As Luffy, Zoro, and Okiku bounce through Bakura Town on Komachiyo’s back, looking for the kidnapped Otama, a sumo wrestler comes flying towards them! Interested, they go down to watch sumo but the undefeated yokozuna Urashima has been expecting Okiku there and shows his brutal nature!

episodes_data.title: A Climactic Sumo Battle! Straw Hat vs. the Strongest Ever Yokozuna!
episodes_data.description: Luffy challenges Urashima, the strongest yokozuna in the Land of Wano, to a sumo match! Urashima even uses illegal moves to beat Luffy at any cost! Meanwhile, Holdem tells Otama that he knows she committed a crime and he has to punish her for it.

episodes_data.title: Luffy Rages! Rescue Otama from Danger!
episodes_data.description: After sending the yokozuna Urashima flying, Luffy and his clan continue their search for Bakura Town’s boss to save Otama! They finally find the boss, Holdem, one of the Beast Pirates’ Headliners, and Otama who is hanging in the mouth of a lion in Holdem’s stomach.

episodes_data.title: Taking Back Otama! A Fierce Fight Against Holdem!
episodes_data.description: Facing Holdem who is holding Otama as hostage, Luffy prepares for a fight but Okiku tries to stop him by sharing who is really ruling the region. Meanwhile, Basil Hawkins who is also working for Kaido and chasing after Luffy, is confronted by a mysterious figure.

episodes_data.title: Duel! The Magician and the Surgeon of Death!
episodes_data.description: Taking down Holdem, Luffy rescues Otama and tries to catch up to Zoro and Okiku who stole the food treasure ship and started a mad dash to get out of the town! Meanwhile, Trafalgar Law’s attempt to silence Basil Hawkins fails when he hears bad news about his alliance.

episodes_data.title: Romance Dawn
episodes_data.description: This is a story of Luffy in an alternate reality. While sailing on the sea by himself, a strange bird crashes into his small boat. He looks up to find a giant ship where a girl named Ann has been captured. It seems like the bird belongs to her.

episodes_data.title: The Coming of the Treasure Ship! Luffytaro Returns the Favor!
episodes_data.description: Zoro and the others dash out of BakuraTown on the treasure ship filled with food! Luffy catches up to them bringing ahuge bucket of fresh water! Then, they distribute the food and the water to thepeople of Okobore Town who were thirsty and hungry.

episodes_data.title: Mysterious Grave Markers! A Reunion at the Ruins of Oden Castle!
episodes_data.description: Luffy arrives at the ruins of Oden Castle following Law and finds the graves of his friends, Kin’emon and the others. As Law starts telling the already-stunned Luffy about the creepy story of Kin’emon’s ghost, Luffy sees it coming towards him!

episodes_data.title: A Legendary Samurai! The Man Who Roger Admired!
episodes_data.description: Kin’emon tells Luffy and the others about how Kozuki Oden made Kuri into a peaceful region and became its Daimyo. However, he was set up by Kaido and Kurozumi Orochi and executed. Kin’emon and his fellow vassals ran to Oden Castle in flames to save Oden’s wife Toki and children but Toki told him a shocking truth.

episodes_data.title: Bringing Down the Emperor of the Sea! A Secret Raid Operation Begins!
episodes_data.description: Kin’emon and the others crossed through time by the power of Kozuki Toki, Momonosuke’s mother, and arrived at the Land of Wano 20 years later, a totally different country before their eyes. However, discovering that there were still their allies there, they started preparing to take down Kaido and Orochi who ruined the country.

episodes_data.title: The Strongest Man in the World! Shutenmaru, the Thieves Brigade Chief!
episodes_data.description: Ashura Doji, one of the allies Kin’emon wants to search for, has become the head of a thieves brigade and they now raid Okobore Town taking away the food that Luffy gave to the people. Ashura Doji, under the name Shutenmaru, then faces Kaido’s right-hand man and gets into a fierce fight!

episodes_data.title: Everyone Is Annihilated! Kaido's Furious Blast Breath!
episodes_data.description: The drunken Kaido flies above Okobore Town in his dragon form and threatens Shutenmaru and all the people in the town. Luffy, Law, Kin’emon, and Okiku start running towards the town to rescue them. However, Kaido heads towards the ruins of Oden Castle where they left their crew behind.

episodes_data.title: Finally Clashing! The Ferocious Luffy vs. Kaido!
episodes_data.description: After Luffy sees Kaido shattering the ruins of Oden Castle where he left his friends, he becomes enraged and attacks Kaido! Soon after, he finds out Kaido even assaulted Otama who was riding on Speed’s back to her home. Furious, Luffy reveals himself to Kaido and starts to retaliate!

episodes_data.title: Destructive! One Shot, One Kill: Thunder Bagua!
episodes_data.description: An infuriated Luffy strikes blow after blow on the drunken Kaido. When he activates Gear Four Bounce-Man and launches even more powerful attacks, Kaido fights back and knocks him out with just one blow. Law tries to rescue Luffy but is interrupted by Hawkins and now Kaido approaches Luffy, unconscious on the ground.

episodes_data.title: A Living Hell! Luffy, Humiliated in the Great Mine!
episodes_data.description: Luffy gets beaten by Kaido and is sent to a great mine where prisoners are made to work in forced labor. There, he finds an unexpected reunion. Meanwhile, Okiku is rushing to the ruins of Oden Castle in order to confirm the safety of the Straw Hats and the others.

episodes_data.title: The Holyland in Tumult! Emperor of the Sea Blackbeard Cackles!
episodes_data.description: On Gloom Island in the Grand Line, Perona finds out that her captain, Gecko Moria, is alive and she is about to leave Dracule Mihawk who let her stay there for the last two years. Meanwhile, Moria raids the Pirate Island of Fullalead with his zombie army to take back his friend from Blackbeard.

episodes_data.title: It's On! The Special Operation to Bring Down Kaido!
episodes_data.description: Dogstorm fights against Shutenmaru to ally with him for their operation but Shutenmaru still rejects their call. Meanwhile, Sanji and the others are on their mission to recruit like-minded people who become skeptical as they receive the secret message from the Kozuki Clan.

episodes_data.title: Rampage! The Prisoners: Luffy and Kid!
episodes_data.description: In the Excavation Labor Camp, Luffy competes against Kid by hauling stones for food and they both get tons of it. However, Dobon, a vice warden, becomes furious when he finds out all their provisions are gone, and gives Luffy and Kid a new sentence: death.

episodes_data.title: A Great Sensation! Sanji's Special Soba!
episodes_data.description: Sanji’s Special Soba becomes very popular but some gang members come to disturb his business and knock over a customer’s bowl. Infuriated, Sanji takes them down and gives the customer, a little girl named Toko, another serving. Later, Sanji and his friends find out that Toko is an attendant to an important figure in the Land of Wano.

episodes_data.title: Luxurious and Gorgeous! Wano's Most Beautiful Woman: Komurasaki!
episodes_data.description: Wano’s top courtesan Komurasaki is in procession and slowly makes her way to Orochi Palace. There is a crowd of people on the street as well as Sanji and the others. While everyone is fascinated by her, some seeking vengeance get in the Oiran’s way.

episodes_data.title: A Tale of Chivalry! Zoro and Tonoyasu's Little Trip!
episodes_data.description: Zoro who has been wandering around the Land of Wano since he got separated from his friends meets a sycophant named Tonoyasu. Tonoyasu paid for Zoro’s sushi and to pay him back, Zoro gambles at dice. However, he realizes that the dealer and the others are cheating.

episodes_data.title: A State of Emergency! Big Mom Closes In!
episodes_data.description: Zoro is taken to the sycophant Tonoyasu’s poor hometown, Ebisu Town where people laugh away their misfortune. On the other hand, Wano’s Shogun – Orochi has a lavish banquet while Big Mom is closing in on the country at a furious speed.

episodes_data.title: The Capitol in an Uproar! Another Assassin Targets Sanji!
episodes_data.description: As the Big Mom Pirates approach the Land of Wano, Kaido’s subordinates led by King and Queen try to get rid of them. Meanwhile, in the Flower Capital, another member of the Animal Kingdom Pirates, Page One, attacks every soba restaurant in the city, in search of Sanji.

episodes_data.title: Dashing! The Righteous Soba Mask!
episodes_data.description: Sanji faces Page One, a Headliner of the Animal Kingdom Pirates, who questions the soba cook’s true identity. Sanji uses Germa’s device for the first time and transforms himself into Stealth Black while dubbing himself Soba Mask.

episodes_data.title: A Desperate Situation! Orochi's Menacing Oniwabanshu!
episodes_data.description: While the banquet grows livelier at Orochi’s Castle, Robin is confronted by his ninja force called Oniwabanshu. In the meanwhile in Kuri, Chopper, Tama, and Momonosuke train themselves preparing for the incoming battle but are interrupted when they find someone washed up on the beach.

episodes_data.title: Pandemonium! The Monster Snake, Shogun Orochi!
episodes_data.description: At the banquet, the Shogun Orochi starts to talk about his late old enemy which bores the attendees. Suddenly, the Oiran’s child attendant Toko bursts with laughter and won’t stop. Orochi becomes furious and attacks her, but an unexpected person stands in his way.

episodes_data.title: The Flower Falls! The Final Moment of the Most Beautiful Woman in the Land of Wano!
episodes_data.description: In order to save her child attendant Toko, the top Oiran Komurasaki stands up to the Shogun Orochi, but the yakuza boss Kyoshiro interrupts and does something that no one expected. Meanwhile, Robin is trying to get out of Orochi’s Castle with the help of Nami and Brook.

episodes_data.title: The Bond Between Prisoners! Luffy and Old Man Hyo!
episodes_data.description: Nami, Robin, and the others got away from Oden’s Castle and now discuss what they have found out about the enemy so far. Meanwhile, Chopper’s group sets off to rescue Luffy from the Excavation Labor Camp where, at the same time, Luffy is in big trouble.

episodes_data.title: A Lead Performer! Queen the Plague Emerges!
episodes_data.description: At the Excavation Labor Camp in Udon, Luffy tries to save Old Man Hyo and stands up to Vice Warden Daifuku and Warden Babanuki with his physical strength weakened by the Sea Prism Stone cuffs. Then when a Lead Performer of the Animal Kingdom Pirates, Queen the Plague, comes to the camp, Luffy makes an escape!

episodes_data.title: Climb Up! Luffy's Desperate Escape!
episodes_data.description: Luffy and Old Man Hyo try to climb up the wall and break out of the Excavation Labor Camp, but Queen the Plague stands in their way and gives them a hard time! Meanwhile, Nami and Robin experience a public bathhouse along with Shinobu and come to know about the Land of Wano’s great yakuza boss.

episodes_data.title: Dead or Alive! Queen's Sumo Inferno!
episodes_data.description: Luffy fights quite a few Queen’s men at once in the deadly sumo match while protecting Old Man Hyo! Meanwhile, Nami, Robin, and Shinobu are cornered as Hawkins comes to raid the bathhouse. However, someone who they don’t expect to be there pops up from nowhere to save them.

episodes_data.title: Gyukimaru! Zoro Fights a Duel on Bandit's Bridge!
episodes_data.description: Luffy deals with the endless supply of opponents trying to figure out the way to use Haki that Rayleigh taught him a while ago. Meanwhile, Zoro faces Gyukimaru who is accusing him of stealing Shusui, however, their duel is interrupted by a woman’s scream.

episodes_data.title: A Big Turnover! The Three-Sword Style Overcomes Danger!
episodes_data.description: The duel between Zoro and Gyukimaru is interrupted by Kamazo, Orochi’s assassin who came after a little girl Toko. Without Shusui, Zoro has a hard time fighting the two at the same time, but he finds an unlikely third sword to take down the enemies.

episodes_data.title: Zoro, Stunned! The Shocking Identity of the Mysterious Woman!
episodes_data.description: Luffy’s next enemies in the deadly sumo match in the Excavation Labor Camp are two tough Gifters. Much to Old Man Hyo’s surprise, Luffy keeps practicing using Haki properly at the same time as he fights them. Meanwhile, the wounded Zoro wakes up to find out the stunning identity of the mysterious woman he saved.

episodes_data.title: Get the Hang of It! The Land of Wano's Haki: Ryuo!
episodes_data.description: Hiyori tells Zoro a stunning story of escaping the incident 20 years ago and surviving until the present day. Meanwhile, Luffy stills struggles to master the Haki of the Color of Arms, but a surprising person steps up and gives an example.

episodes_data.title: Tonoyasu! Ebisu Town's Most Loved!
episodes_data.description: Luffy continues training himself to use Haki with Old Man Hyo’s help, but the battle is suddenly suspended and shortly thereafter Raizo appears in front of them. Meanwhile, Nami, Usopp, and the others are wondering who Tonoyasu, Ebisu Town’s hero, really is.

episodes_data.title: Shaking the Nation! The Identity of Ushimitsu Kozo the Chivalrous Thief!
episodes_data.description: Ushimitsu Kozo the great thief who robbed from the rich and gave to the poor gets caught and his true identity stuns Orochi and the others. When Toko hears the news, she gets very upset and so is Zoro when he hears the reason.

episodes_data.title: The Straw Hats Run! Save the Captive Tonoyasu!
episodes_data.description: Tonoyasu has been strung up and is soon-to-be executed. The people of the Land of Wano recognize who he really is and start raising their voice while the Straw Hats rush to save him. Then, Tonoyasu starts addressing the nation and the corrupt Shogun Orochi.

episodes_data.title: Zoro's Fury! The Truth About the Smile!
episodes_data.description: By the time Kin’emon and the others notice that Yasuie is trying to sacrifice his life to save their raid plan, it was all too late. Ebisu Town`s people laughing out loud annoys Zoro, but when Hiyori tells him the reason behind it, he is in for a shock!

episodes_data.title: Toko's Tears! Orochi's Pitiless Bullets!
episodes_data.description: Hiyori and Shinobu tearfully tell the Straw Hats the truth behind Ebisu Town residents` cheerfulness and smiles, which infuriates them. When Yasuie’s daughter, Toko, runs to her father’s body, Orochi recognizes who she is and takes a shot at her!

episodes_data.title: The Straw Hats Step In! An Uproarious Deadly Battle at the Execution Ground!
episodes_data.description: Zoro and Sanji start fighting against Orochi’s clan. Nami and the rest of the Straw Hats join them. Meanwhile, at the Excavation Labor Camp, a new criminal, Hitokiri Kamazo, has arrived. And someone else who is brought to the site reveals the shocking truth about Kamazo.

episodes_data.title: Luffy's Determination! Win Through the Sumo Inferno!
episodes_data.description: Zoro keeps fighting Kyoshiro, but Orochi’s Oniwabanshu comes to back Kyoshiro up. Meanwhile, at the Excavation Labor Camp, Queen announces the restart of the Sumo Inferno with a new cruel rule which is painful not only to Luffy, but also to Drake and Killer.

episodes_data.title: The Storm Has Come! A Raging Big Mom!
episodes_data.description: Kin’emon apologizes Ashura Doji AKA Shutenmaru for goading Holdem to attack Atamayama where Ashura’s hideout was located, and asks him to join the fight against Kaido. Meanwhile, Chopper and his group finally arrived at the Excavation Labor Camp and Big Mom forces her way in to find her favorite soup!

episodes_data.title: A Grudge over Red-bean Soup! Luffy Gets into a Desperate Situation!
episodes_data.description: Craving red-bean soup, Big Mom attacks Queen, the Animal Kingdom Pirates’ Lead Performer who reins over Udon. However, when she finds out that the pot is empty, she turns her wrath against the one who ate it all: Luffy.

episodes_data.title: Stop the Emperor of the Sea! Queen's Secret Plan!
episodes_data.description: After finding out that Luffy ate the whole pot ofthe red-bean soup that she was looking for, Big Mom becomes infuriated and goesafter him. Meanwhile, Queen, the Lead Performer, comes up with a plan to stopthe rampaging Big Mom.

episodes_data.title: Brutal Ammunition! The Plague Rounds Aim at Luffy!
episodes_data.description: Queen hastily ties up the sleeping Big Mom and carries her to Onigashima leaving Udon to Babanuki. Babanuki uses a weapon that Queen made to threaten inmates and make them catch Luffy, but a mysterious figure emerges from the forbidden cell to save Luffy.

episodes_data.title: Start Fighting Back! Luffy and the Akazaya Samurai!
episodes_data.description: Kawamatsu the Kappa is freed and stands up against Babanuki and his underlings! Listening to Old Man Hyo’s suggestion, Raizo and Kiku reveal their true identities which give the desperate prisoners not only a shock but also some hope.

episodes_data.title: We're Here to Win! Luffy's Desperate Scream!
episodes_data.description: Luffy faces those who are infected by the Plague Rounds and the non-infected prisoners who submit to the authority of Udon. To open their eyes, Luffy takes a measure that will risk his life. However, the Chief Warden Babanuki has something up his sleeve.

episodes_data.title: Warriors' Dream! Luffy's Conquer of Udon!
episodes_data.description: The freed prisoners in Udon refuse to fight alongside Luffy because he is a pirate. Raizo and Old Man Hyo try their best to convince them, but an unexpected person stands up to bring the prisoners hope after taking down Kaido!

episodes_data.title: Orochi's Hunting Party! The Ninja Group vs. Zoro!
episodes_data.description: After standing against Orochi, Zoro and Hiyori are chased by Orochi’s ninja group. Meanwhile, Orochi is told that they captured Trafalgar Law as the people of the Flower Capital prepare for the upcoming Fire Festival.

episodes_data.title: Tension Rises in Onigashima! Two Emperors of the Sea Meet?!
episodes_data.description: Nami and Franky join Kanjuro who has taken Yasuie’s dead body to bury him with Oden, and together they hit the road. Robin, Usopp, and Brook are at the dock trying to figure out a way to pass through a check point. Meanwhile, Big Mom and Kaido finally clash at Onigashima.

episodes_data.title: Hiyori's Confession! A Reunion at Bandit's Bridge!
episodes_data.description: As the clash between Kaido and Big Mom continues, Queen looks for a way to get out of Onigashima. Meanwhile in Udon, Old Man Hyo finds his former allies, four bosses from each region. At Bandit’s Bridge, Hiyori and Kawamatsu finally see each other after a long time.

episodes_data.title: Its Name Is Enma! Oden's Great Swords!
episodes_data.description: Zoro runs after the warrior-monk who took his Shusui and Kawamatsu shares with Hiyori his memory of a fox that was guarding the graves in Ringo. As they catch up to Zoro, they find a room filled with swords. And Hiyori tells Zoro to give Shusui back to the Land of Wano.

episodes_data.title: A New Alliance?! Kaido's Army Gathers!
episodes_data.description: As the day of the raid approaches, Law finds someone who might help him escape the prison and Kin’emon gathers up most of his main allies to discuss the raid plan. Meanwhile, at Onigashima, Kaido and Big Mom make a stunning declaration!

episodes_data.title: Ticking Down to the Great Battle! The Straw Hats Go into Combat Mode!
episodes_data.description:
Kin’emon, Momonosuke, and the others can’t fight back tears when they hear that Hiyori is alive.
Zoro is stunned by Enma’s demonic power and its ties to him.
And as the day of the Fire Festival is finally in sight, Kin’emon and the others head out for the rendezvous point.

episodes_data.title: Big News! An Incident That Will Affect the Seven Warlords!
episodes_data.description: The resolution that passed the Reverie and the incidents surrounding the conference stun people all over the world and corner the Seven Warlords of the Sea. Meanwhile, a Navy captain Koby secretly contacts someone who is currently in the Land of Wano.

episodes_data.title: A Legendary Battle! Garp and Roger!
episodes_data.description: Admiral Issho and Fleet Admiral Sakazuki argue over the abolition of the Seven Warlord system and the alliance of the two Emperors of the Sea. Meanwhile, ex-Fleet Admiral Sengoku teaches the young Navy soldiers about the legendary Rocks Pirates that Kaido and Big Mom once belonged to along with all the other big names.

episodes_data.title: The Rendezvous Port! The Land of Wano Act Three Begins!
episodes_data.description: On the day of the Fire Festival, Orochi leaves the mainland of the Land of Wano heading for Onigashima where a big banquet will take place. Meanwhile, at Tokage Port, the rendezvous point for the rebel group, Kin’emon and the others are stunned by the fact that none of their allies are there.

episodes_data.title: The Number-One Samurai in the Land of Wano! Here Comes Kozuki Oden!
episodes_data.description: The night before the great battle, Orochi orders the destruction of the Sunny along with some bridges across the country to block Akazaya samurai’s allies from their rendezvous. Disappointed, the group of samurai still sets out for Onigashima with the memory of their beloved lord, Oden, in their hearts. However, 41 years ago, Oden was not respected by everyone.

episodes_data.title: Tearfully Swearing Allegiance! Oden and Kin'emon!
episodes_data.description: When the angry mountain god, the giant boar, almost kills Kin’emon, Oden steps in. Kin’emon is impressed when he sees Oden’s strength and pledges his life to serve him. Disavowed by his father, Oden decides to go on a journey around the country and gathers more followers along the way.

episodes_data.title: Changing Destiny! The Whitebeard Pirates Cast Ashore!
episodes_data.description: Oden transforms the wild land of Kuri into a habitable region and is made Daimyo over it. Then he meets Kawamatsu the Kappa and the two Minks, Dogstorm and Cat Viper, who become his followers like the others. Kin’emon and the other vassals are scolded by Yasuie when they try to steal money from him, and they begin reforming themselves for their lord Oden.

episodes_data.title: Oden's Determination! Whitebeard's Test!
episodes_data.description: Whitebeard and his crew dock at one of the ports in the Land of Wano with their broken ship and the news excites Oden. He runs to the port and asks Whitebeard to let him get on board the ship but the request is rejected. When the ship`s repairs are complete, Whitebeard tries to sneak out of the country, but he finds Oden tagging along.

episodes_data.title: Whitebeard's Little Brother! Oden's Great Adventure!
episodes_data.description: Oden’s journey finally begins. He is in awe of all the things that he has never seen before. And for the first time in his life, he becomes a wanted person and makes the headlines which catches the eye of a high-profile figure. Meanwhile he becomes romantically involved with Toki and they have a child together.

episodes_data.title: Crossing Swords! Roger and Whitebeard!
episodes_data.description: In the Land of Wano, the Shogun Sukiyaki falls critically ill and names Orochi proxy Shogun until Oden returns in case he dies. Meanwhile, Whitebeard’s ship carrying Oden docks at some island overseas, unaware that Gold Roger and his clan are fighting against the Navy on the other side of the island.

episodes_data.title: Roger's Wish! A New Journey!
episodes_data.description: Roger is amazed when he finds out that Oden can read the script on the Ponegliff since he believes it will guide him to the last, undiscovered island where no man has ever been. Roger begs Whitebeard for permission to take Oden with him on a one-year journey. But Oden gives it some thought and speaks his mind as well!

episodes_data.title: Devoting His Life! Roger's Adventure!
episodes_data.description: Singing out loud, the Roger Pirates continue on with their journey. They soar up to the island above the clouds and go down into the deep sea to get to the island at the sea bottom. Oden deciphers the Ponegliffs on those islands for Roger who believes those inscriptions will tell them the location of the last island on the Grand Line.

episodes_data.title: The King of the Pirates Is Born! Arriving at the Last Island!
episodes_data.description: Oden and the Roger Pirates head for the Land of Wano to obtain a copy of the Road Ponegliff. Oden sees Kin’emon and the others for the first time in years, but he immediately returns to the sea leaving his wife and children behind. Then, after stopping by at the Mokomo Dukedom and getting a copy of the last Road Ponegliff, the Roger Pirates finally make it to the last island.

episodes_data.title: To the Land of Wano! The Roger Pirates Disband!
episodes_data.description: After reaching Laugh Tale, Roger declares the disbanding of his pirate group and disembarks first. Oden gets dropped off at the Land of Wano and reunites with his family and retainers. Later, he hears that Orochi took over the country with the help of a strong pirate named Kaido after the Shogun Sukiyaki’s death and becomes enraged by stories of his tyrannical acts.

episodes_data.title: Sad News! The Opening of the Great Pirate Era!
episodes_data.description: Enraged by Orochi’s tyrannical acts, Oden raids his castle in the Flower Capital and points his sword at Orochi. However, hours later, people who were waiting for Oden to come out after defeating Orochi see the unexpected. Meanwhile, the King of the Pirates Roger’s execution and last words are printed in newspapers and spread across the world.

episodes_data.title: Raid! Oden and the Akazaya Nine!
episodes_data.description: Oden keeps dancing naked in the Flower Capital and losing all the trust of the people. One day, Orochi comes to Kuri and reveals his evil plan for the Land of Wano as well as his brutalities against the country’s mobster and Oden’s friend, Hyogoro and his wife. Despairing and in a rage, Oden finally decides to take down Orochi’s supporter, Kaido.

episodes_data.title: The End of the Battle! Oden vs. Kaido!
episodes_data.description: Kaido comes to the mainland along with his troops to fight against Oden and the Akazaya samurai who were on their way to raid Kaido’s mansion. Even though Oden’s group are unprepared and outnumbered, they fight hard to save the future of the Land of Wano.

episodes_data.title: Boiled to Death! Oden's One-hour Struggle!
episodes_data.description: Oden and the Akazaya members are sentenced to death by boiling in a pot. Oden asks for a chance to survive which is accepted by Kaido. Then, Oden enters the boiling pot holding his retainers over his head. Shinobu watches from among the spectators and reveals what Oden had been doing to save the country, to the surprise of the citizens.

episodes_data.title: Oden Wouldn't Be Oden If It Wasn't Boiled!
episodes_data.description:
As Oden continues trying to survive in the boiling pot holding his retainers over his head, people learn the truth from Shinobu and get shocked.
At the same time, Oden tells his retainers the importance of opening the borders of the Land of Wano. Time ticks down for Oden and his clan’s freedom.

episodes_data.title: The Castle on Fire! The Fate of the Kozuki Clan!
episodes_data.description: As Kin’emon and the others run to Oden Castle to save Oden’s family, the castle is set on fire and Kaido attacks Toki and her children. Leaving Momonosuke to Kin’emon and Hiyori to Kawamatsu, Toki appears in front of the desperate people of the Land of Wano and gives a prophecy.

episodes_data.title: Back to the Present Day! 20 Years Later!
episodes_data.description: After 20 years since Oden Castle burned down, Oden’s surviving retainers are working hard separately at their own missions, believing in Toki’s prophecy. The day of the Fire Festival has finally come and the whole army is now getting ready to head for Onigashima to raid Kaido!

episodes_data.title: The Sea Is for Pirates! Raid! To Onigashima!
episodes_data.description: The Straw Hats and thousands of allies who were supposed to be there are nowhere to be found, but Kin’emon and the others decide to set sail to the stormy sea in a small boat. Kaido’s army that appears out of nowhere and a betrayal drive the Akazaya members into a corner.

episodes_data.title: The Worst Generation Charges In! The Battle of the Stormy Sea!
episodes_data.description: Luffy, Law, and Kid join the Akazaya samurai and begin to fight Kaido’s army. The three rivals from the Worst Generation compete with each other as they attack the enemy fleet with their ultimate skills. When it seems like they gain upper hand in the battle, another strong enemy appears to help Kaido’s army.

episodes_data.title: Good Luck?! Leader Kin'emon's Plot!
episodes_data.description: The Akazaya members are surprised by help from their old mate and Kin’emon notices he made a big mistake which has luckily saved all his allies. As their battle against Kaido’s army heats up, the cornered Kanjuro makes a stunning move.

episodes_data.title: A Tearful Promise! The Kidnapped Momonosuke!
episodes_data.description: Swept away by Kanjuro, Momonosuke remembers his father, tries to rise above his fear, and speak to his allies. Luffy and the others start heading for Onigashima, but Kaido’s army gets in their way again with a formidable weapon. However, a surprising figure comes to help the cornered Straw Hats.

episodes_data.title: A New Member! 'First Son of the Sea' Jimbei!
episodes_data.description: Luffy and the rest of the Straw Hat crew are excited to see Jimbei again and welcome him as a new member. Meanwhile, Law and the Akazaya members strategize on how to enter Onigashima and attack Kaido. As the Straw Hats approach the giant torii gate in front of Onigashima, they are attacked out of the blue.

episodes_data.title: Kaido's Trump Card! The Tobi Roppo Appear!
episodes_data.description: To Law and the others’ surprise, Luffy and the rest of the Straw Hats attack the giant torii gate in front of Onigashima. Meanwhile, Kaido and Orochi are having a big banquet on the island where Kaido’s formidable subordinates are also called in.

episodes_data.title: The Samurai Warriors' Earnestness! The Straw Hats Land at Onigashima!
episodes_data.description: The Straw Hats and the samurai warriors finally reach Onigashima! Before they set out for the castle as they planned, the samurai warriors use surprising but determined tactics to cut off their retreat which leave the Straw Hats in shock.

episodes_data.title: Luffy Goes Out of Control?! Sneaking into Kaido's Banquet!
episodes_data.description: Eustass Kid and his clan start heading for Kaido`s castle head on waving Luffy off. Luffy and Zoro go after them to stop them from causing trouble, but they happen to step into Kaido’s banquet. Meanwhile, Kanjuro loses his way to Kaido in underground passages with Momonosuke who he kidnapped in tow.

episodes_data.title: Thinking of Otama! Luffy's Furious Strike!
episodes_data.description: Luffy and Zoro each witness Kaido’s subordinates waste food at the banquet and make fun of the poor people in the Land of Wano. Thinking of Otama, a small girl who liked red-bean soup so much, both Luffy and Zoro become infuriated and create turmoil.

episodes_data.title: Fighting Music! An Ability That Harms Luffy!
episodes_data.description: After making a scene at the Golden Festival, Luffy and Zoro try to get away, but Queen announces his subordinates that anyone who catches them will be rewarded with a position in the Tobi Roppo. Scratchmen Apoo stands Luffy and Zoro’s way and with his ability to use music as a weapon, he launches unpredictable attacks which corner Luffy and Zoro.

episodes_data.title: His Dream Broken?! The Trap That Lures Sanji!
episodes_data.description: Haccha, a supergiant Number, joins in and the pursuit of Luffy and the others becomes even more intense. Meanwhile, Kin’emon changes his strategy and his group tries to infiltrate the castle from its side, but there is an unexpected change of the floor plan which coincidentally makes Sanji excited.

episodes_data.title: Reinforcements Arrive! The Commander of the Whitebeard Pirates!
episodes_data.description: Luffy, Law, Kin’emon, and all the others are trying to infiltrate Kaido’s castle from all sides. Meanwhile, Big Mom’s children are climbing up the waterfall towards Onigashima again, but this time, Marco the Phoenix appears from nowhere and stands in their way!

episodes_data.title: The Pact Between Men! The Fierce Fighting of Brachio Tank!
episodes_data.description: The furious Big Mom chases Brachio Tank driven by Chopper and Usopp, but they bravely fight back! Meanwhile, Kanjuro takes the battered and bruised Momonosuke to Kaido and Orochi, then breaks the news to them about Oden’s retainers who were thought to be dead.

episodes_data.title: Thunder Bagua! Here Comes Kaido's Son!
episodes_data.description: Luffy runs into Ulti and Page One, members of the Tobi Roppo from the Animal Kingdom Pirates. Hearing that he aims to become the King of the Pirates, the brother and sister duo become infuriated and turn themselves into massive beasts. When Luffy is driven into a corner, someone wearing a demon mask appears and whisks him away.

episodes_data.title: Enemy or Ally? Luffy and Yamato!
episodes_data.description: Evading Ulti and Page One, strong members of the Tobi Roppo, Luffy tries to find out what Kaido’s son Yamato’s motive is. However, the two get in a fight. Taking Luffy’s punishing attacks, Yamato remembers someone he fought against in the past.

episodes_data.title: Desire to Be Oden! Yamato's Dream!
episodes_data.description: The Akazaya members who were on board Law’s Polar Tang finally reach Onigashima and see someone who they didn’t expect. Kaido’s son Yamato starts telling his story to Luffy, shares his passion, and reveals what’s behind his mask!

episodes_data.title: Explosive?! The Handcuffs That Shackle Yamato's Freedom!
episodes_data.description: At the back entrance of Onigashima, the Akazaya members try to get inside the gate, but they’re blocked by their former colleague Kanjuro. Meanwhile, as Kaido’s son Yamato shows Luffy the handcuffs that have restricted his freedom for years, they hear Kaido making a speech on his grand plan.

episodes_data.title: The Akazaya Face-off! Kikunojo vs. Kanjuro!
episodes_data.description: Kaido’s plan to obtain the great treasure infuriates Orochi, but his unexpected violent move silences everyone. Meanwhile at the back entrance of Onigashima, Kikunojo squares off against Kanjuro and gets into an emotional fight with her former colleague.

episodes_data.title: Raid! Inheriting Oden's Will
episodes_data.description: The Akazaya members start charging towards Kaido from the back of Onigashima. Meanwhile, at the Performance Floor, Kaido closes in on Momonosuke shivering in terror and asks him the ultimate question which will determine his fate.

episodes_data.title: Onigashima in Tumult! Luffy's All-Out War Begins!
episodes_data.description: The Akazaya members deliver a crushing blow to Kaido. Luffy and Yamato try to back them up, but Ulti stands in their way and Big Mom spots Luffy. Meanwhile, Nami and Carrot free themselves from their enemies and move on to take back Zeus!

episodes_data.title: The Battle Under the Moon! The Berserker, Sulong the Moon Lion!
episodes_data.description: The Animal Kingdom Pirates gasp with surprise to see thousands of samurai warriors coming into the castle. In his dragon form, Kaido goes outside to fight the Akazaya members under the moon. However, the Akazaya members have secret weapons to use against him.

episodes_data.title: Zeus' Treason?! The Cornered Nami!
episodes_data.description: Shinobu tries to rescue the weakened Momonosuke but is found by King and attacked. On the other hand, Nami takes back Zeus from Big Mom and runs away but loses him again and gets chased by Zeus who is ordered to kill to her by Big Mom.

episodes_data.title: I'll Protect You! Yamato Meets Momonosuke!
episodes_data.description: Franky faces Big Mom with the help of Robin and Jimbei, but the Numbers come interrupting their battle. One of them holds Brachio Tank with Usopp and Chopper inside in his hand. Meanwhile, Yamato, the self-proclaimed Oden, finally meets his son Momonosuke.

episodes_data.title: Overwhelming Strength! The Straw Hats Come Together!
episodes_data.description: As the Minks struggle with a poor hand against the Gifters, Kin’emon tries to assist them, but Dogstorm and Cat Viper stop him and start fighting for the other Minks! Meanwhile, Luffy and Zoro try to get to the rooftop to help Kin’emon and the others, but Queen and King get in their way.

episodes_data.title: A Risky Invitation! A Plot to Eliminate Queen!
episodes_data.description: Who’s-Who invites Drake and Hawkins to a plot to kill Queen. Meanwhile, the Straw Hats are facing two large monsters that remind them of the Giant who they once struggled to take down. As Luffy charges towards them, someone unexpected comes in to help.

episodes_data.title: A New Rivalry! Nami and Ulti!
episodes_data.description: Drake vows to fight alongside Luffy, but Zoro becomes skeptical and challenges him to a fight. Meanwhile, Usopp’s practical joke pushes Nami into confronting Ulti, who is infuriated since her brother got attacked.

episodes_data.title: A Heroic Blade! Akazaya vs. Kaido, Again Once More!
episodes_data.description: Queen uses a new version of the Plague Bullets which will turn the samurai into ogre-like monsters. Meanwhile, the Minks keep pushing the fight against the Gifters and drive Jack into a corner. However, Kaido stands up for his subordinate.

episodes_data.title: An Inherited Technique! Unleashing Oden's Secret Swordplay!
episodes_data.description: While Luffy is hurrying to the rooftop and Yamato is trying to catch up to Momonosuke to protect him, the Akazaya members finally face off against Kaido. Hearing Kaido jeering at them for being weak, the samurai retainers attack him relentlessly, remembering the day Oden told them to master his sword skill.

episodes_data.title: The Power of "Ice Oni"! A New Version of the Plague Rounds!
episodes_data.description: Queen, the Lead Performer, blazes away at samurai on the Performance Floor with the special version of the Plague Rounds, which turns them into hideous ogres that corner Zoro and Drake. Meanwhile, Luffy and Sanji, who are on their way to the rooftop, run into another Headliner with a special ability.

episodes_data.title: I Won't Forgive Him! Chopper's Determination!
episodes_data.description: King orders his subordinates to go after Momonosuke. Shinobu tries to protect him, but they are cornered by one of the strong Lead Performers from the Animal Kingdom Pirates. Meanwhile, seeing people suffering from Queen’s Plague Rounds, Chopper is determined to save everyone.

episodes_data.title: Zoro's Pursuit! Ice Oni Tag!
episodes_data.description: Yamato fights Sasaki and the Animal Kingdom Pirates Armored Division to protect Momonosuke. Meanwhile, Zoro tries to get rid of the Gifters who have turned into Ice Oni, but Queen starts a horrible game which involves the antibody for the virus.

episodes_data.title: Nami Surrenders?! Ulti's Fierce Headbutt!
episodes_data.description: Ulti and Page One of the Tobi Roppo chase Nami and Usopp, after being infuriated by their attack as well as Luffy’s declaration of becoming the King of the Pirates. Cornered, Nami gives in and Ulti pushes her to say the unthinkable.

episodes_data.title: Sasaki's Onslaught! Armored Division vs. Yamato!
episodes_data.description: Carrot and Wanda step in to help Marco, who is cornered by Big Mom and Perospero. In the meantime, Yamato fights a fierce battle against the Animal Kingdom Pirates Armored Division led by Sasaki, while protecting Shinobu and Momonosuke.

episodes_data.title: Eliminate the Ice Oni! Chopper's Fire Trick!
episodes_data.description: Zoro and Drake continue to chase Apoo to get the antibody against Ice Oni, while Chopper is trying to figure out how to fight the virus. In the castle, Luffy, Jimbei, and Sanji are climbing up the stairs to reach the rooftop where the Akazaya members’ tough battle against Kaido rages on.

episodes_data.title: It's Not Okay! The Spider Lures Sanji!
episodes_data.description: Sanji hears a woman’s scream for help and dashes into the room the scream can be heard from. However, it’s a trap set up by Black Maria of the Tobi Roppo. Meanwhile, Luffy and Jimbei who are trying to reach the rooftop get help from the unexpected.

episodes_data.title: A Turnaround Move! The Flames of Marco the Phoenix!
episodes_data.description: While Kaido begins the New Onigashima Project, Marco appears in front of Chopper and the others, who are struggling with Ice Oni. The members of the Tobi Roppo continue to give the Straw Hats a hard time while their former member helps Zoro.

episodes_data.title: Yamato's Past! The Man Who Came for an Emperor of the Sea!
episodes_data.description: Yamato tells Momonosuke and Shinobu that he once confronted a man, who came to Onigashima looking to get Kaido’s head. His name was Ace. The two of them engaged in a fierce battle that eventually turned into an important friendship.

episodes_data.title: Marco's Tears! The Bond of the Whitebeard Pirates!
episodes_data.description: The formidable Lead Performers of the Animal Kingdom Pirates stand in Zoro’s way as he tries to get to the rooftop. Marco sees his late comrade in Zoro’s determination and tries to pave the way for him.

episodes_data.title: Straw Hat Luffy! The Man Who Will Become the King of the Pirates!
episodes_data.description: Yamato tells Momonosuke and Shinobu about how Ace gave him hope for the future. Meanwhile, Luffy and the other allied pirates from the Worst Generation make it to the rooftop to finally face off against Kaido and Big Mom.

episodes_data.title: The Battle of the Monsters! The Three Stubborn Captains!
episodes_data.description: Luffy’s strong attack reminds Kaido of all the strong ones he’s ever met. On the other hand, Luffy, Law, and Kid keep quarreling amongst themselves. Meanwhile, Sanji is caught and interrogated by Black Maria in what he calls “heaven.”

episodes_data.title: A Barrage of Powerful Techniques! The Fierce Attacks of the Worst Generation!
episodes_data.description: Luffy, Law, Kid, Zoro, and Killer keep landing hard blows against Kaido in tandem despite the arguing. However, when Big Mom steps in and unleashes powerful lightning strikes, the tide turns for all except one of the rookies.

episodes_data.title: Kaido Laughs! The Emperors of the Sea vs. the New Generation!
episodes_data.description: Luffy pummels Kaido with his well-trained Kong Gatling and delivers a final blow using all his strength. Big Mom tries to fight back, but Law gets in her way and Kid and Killer also try to finish Kaido off.

episodes_data.title: Otama's Secret Plan! Operation Kibi Dango!
episodes_data.description: After watching the Straw Hats’ departure to Onigashima, Tama wondered if there was anything she could do to help the Straw Hats and the samurai. Now that she’s here on Onigashima, it’s time to execute her powerful plan – Operation Kibi Dango!

episodes_data.title: Sanji's Scream! An SOS Echoes over the Island!
episodes_data.description: Sanji is captured and tortured by the merciless Black Maria. She names the terms of his release: to turn over one of his crewmates. He hesitates but has no other option. After much distress, he makes a move that surprises everyone.

episodes_data.title: Spank Strikes! Sanji's Woman-trouble!
episodes_data.description: Robin bursts in to rescue Sanji along with Brook, and faces Black Maria, who is trying to keep Sanji as her pet. Meanwhile, Yamato, Momonosuke, and Shinobu are spotted hiding by the enemy, and they find themselves on the run again.

episodes_data.title: No Regrets! Luffy and Boss, a Master-Disciple Bond!
episodes_data.description: Chopper works hard to make the cure for Ice Oni, even though he is turning into one himself. Meanwhile, the infected Boss Hyogoro the Flower regains his youth and fights fiercely to protect Chopper and the others.

episodes_data.title: All Set! Chopperphage Nebulizer!
episodes_data.description: Seeing everyone turning into Ice Oni, there is nothing that the samurai warriors can do other than grieve. However, it wasn’t just them who were devastated by Queen’s raging virus. When their desperation and frustration peak, they hear a hopeful voice.

episodes_data.title: Oden Appears! The Confused Hearts of the Akazaya Members!
episodes_data.description: The wounded Akazaya members are surprised to see Kozuki Oden alive. They were disappointed by their failure to take down Kaido, but now with their lord, they are filled with hope to face their sworn enemy again.

episodes_data.title: The Worst Generation Gets Wiped Out?! The Emperors' Deadly Attack!
episodes_data.description: The Akazaya members run to save Momonosuke, but an unexpected contender stands in their way. Queen gets infuriated after Chopper ruined his plot and goes after him. Meanwhile, on the rooftop, Kaido and Big Mom unleashes a combination attack on Luffy and the others.

episodes_data.title: The Supernovas Strike Back! The Mission to Tear Apart the Emperors!
episodes_data.description: The returned Orochi clashes the Akazaya members who are trying to save Momonosuke. Meanwhile, Luffy and the others are all covered in bruises, but they unite their strength and launch an attack.

episodes_data.title: Defend Luffy! Zoro and Law's Sword Technique!
episodes_data.description: Even after Big Mom was pushed off of the island, Zoro and the others keep fighting the exhausting battle against Kaido. When Kaido tries to beat up the unconscious Luffy, Zoro launches an all-out attack at the risk of his life.

episodes_data.title: Surpass the Emperor of the Sea! Luffy Strikes Back with an Iron Fist!
episodes_data.description: Luffy remembers how he was advised by his friends, how he was saved by his comrades, and the frustrations of being defeated. As Kaido mocks him to his face, the Color of the Supreme King Haki gushes out and they clash again.

episodes_data.title: A Faint Memory! Luffy and Red-Haired's Daughter Uta!
episodes_data.description: A young Luffy who has been dreaming about getting out of Windmill Village one day to accomplish something great meets a young girl named Uta who came along with Shanks and the Red-Hair Pirates calling herself the musician of the pirate group.

episodes_data.title: A Pledge for the New Genesis! Luffy and Uta!
episodes_data.description: Luffy and Uta run across Windmill Village, compete with each other, and share their dreams with each other. They also pledge to build a new genesis for everyone to live happily. However, one day, the unexpected happens.

episodes_data.title: Nami Screams - A Deadly Death Race!
episodes_data.description: Luffy and Kaido who have both infused themselves with the Color of the Supreme King clash! Meanwhile, Nami, Usopp, and Tama are running from Page One to get to the Performance Floor, but they bump into another tough enemy, Big Mom.

episodes_data.title: The Dawn of the Land of Wano - The All-Out Battle Heats Up!
episodes_data.description: Kin’emon and the Akazaya members are rushing to help Momonosuke and everyone else while Yamato leaves Momonosuke and Shinobu in a hide-out to lure away their enemies. At the same time, Ulti tries to avenge her brother against Big Mom.

episodes_data.title: The Conclusion! Luffy, Accelerating Fist of the Supreme King
episodes_data.description: Sanji is forced to run with Zoro on his shoulder. Meanwhile, Nami bravely stands up against Ulti and Big Mom. On the rooftop, the intense battle between Luffy and Kaido finally comes to an end.

episodes_data.title: Luffy, Defeated! The Straw Hats in Jeopardy?!
episodes_data.description: Luffy is pushed off the rooftop by Kaido. Meanwhile, Zeus intervenes in a fight between Big Mom and Nami’s group and stands up for the one who he wants to save. On the Performance Floor, Chopper is in a fierce battle against Queen.

episodes_data.title: The Animal Kingdom Pirates Trample Down! The End of the Kozuki Clan!
episodes_data.description: While the Straw Hats and their allies are all having a hard time, they are shocked by the news that Luffy lost to Kaido. At the same time, Kanjuro closes in on Momonosuke to destroy the Kozuki lineage.

episodes_data.title: Fight Against the Dark Night - The Commander-in-Chief of the Land of Wano Sounds Off
episodes_data.description: Like all the other samurai, Chopper is discouraged by the news of Luffy’s loss and Queen doesn’t miss the chance to finish him off! Meanwhile, Kin’emon fights for his life to save Momonosuke and that motivates Momonosuke to rise up!

episodes_data.title: Believe in Luffy! The Alliance's Counterattack Begins!
episodes_data.description: Momonosuke and Shinobu face Kaido while Kid and Law challenge Big Mom. Meanwhile, Nami, heading towards the stage on the Performance Floor along with Usopp and Tama, hears a strange voice.

episodes_data.title: Nami's Lethal Attack! Otama's Desperate Challenge!
episodes_data.description: Nami strikes a thunder blast to clear the way to the stage on the Performance Floor. However, the elite corps of the Gifters shows up to crush their inferior opponents. Upset but unbroken, Otama stands up to give a command!

episodes_data.title: A Dramatic Increase of Allies! Straw Hats Fight Back!
episodes_data.description: Hearing Otama’s command, the Gifters side with the samurai and upset the Tobi Roppo and others! Chopper starts to take care of Zoro while suffering from the side effect of the enhanced Rumble Ball. Meanwhile, Jimbei gets stunned by Who’s-Who’s story.

episodes_data.title: The Pride of a Helmsman - The Enraged Jimbei!
episodes_data.description: Who’s-Who expresses fierce resentment toward Luffy and Jimbei fights back out of his loyalty to Luffy. As Who’s-Who asks Jimbei a question, he tramples on the dignity of the Fish-Men and that sparks Jimbei’s outrage.

episodes_data.title: Showdown Battles of the Monsters! Yamato and Franky
episodes_data.description: To cut ties with Kaido, Yamato unleashes his true power. Meanwhile, Queen repeatedly attacks Sanji with his power as a cyborg, and Sasaki in his Man-Beast Form launches tricky attacks on Franky and drives him into a corner.

episodes_data.title: The Predator's Trap - Black Maria's Temptation
episodes_data.description: Kaido tries to convince Yamato to become the Shogun of the Land of Wano and rule the country with the special power he obtained by accident. Meanwhile, Saul, Professor Clover, and Robin’s mother Olvia suddenly appear in front of her.

episodes_data.title: Slash the Nightmare - Brook Draws His Freezing Sword!
episodes_data.description: In the dense mist, Brook is surprised to see his old friends, the Rumbar Pirates and Laboon. They reminisce about the old days and play music together, however, they suddenly attack Brook.

episodes_data.title: Clutch! A Demon Incarnate, Robin!
episodes_data.description: Black Maria torments Robin both physically and spiritually. As she burns in hellfire, Robin remembers the people who gave her a hard time and the people who supported her, and she as Demon Child shows what she is really capable of.

episodes_data.title: A Spell! Kid and Zoro Facing Threats!
episodes_data.description: Killer is shocked to find out who Hawkins’ straw doll he slashed represents. Meanwhile, Sanji who is in a hard battle against Queen and King sees enemy brutes going after the injured Zoro, and no one else is there to save him.

episodes_data.title: Taking a Chance! The Two Arms Go into Battle!
episodes_data.description: Zoro gets back on his feet and along with Sanji, confronts King and Queen, the Lead Performers of the Animal Kingdom Pirates. Watching Zoro fight, Hyogoro and Kawamatsu remember someone from way back.

episodes_data.title: Ascend to the Dawn! A Pink Dragon Gets Agitated
episodes_data.description: Dogstorm confronts his sworn enemy who destroyed his country. Meanwhile, Cat Viper faces Perospero who is responsible for Pedro’s death. At Tokage Port, Momonosuke roars with his determined eyes.

episodes_data.title: For the Future! Yamato and the Great Swordsmen's Pledge
episodes_data.description: The battle between Kaido and Yamato gets intense. Backed into a corner, Yamato remembers three great swordsmen who he met when he was a child. Their stunning choice for the future of the Land of Wano encourages Yamato.

episodes_data.title: Luffy Soars! Revenge Against the King of the Beasts
episodes_data.description: Luffy amps up the reluctant Momonosuke, who is afraid of heights, in his giant pink dragon form, to fly and take him to Onigashima in the sky. Meanwhile, Yamato, in a hard battle against Kaido, vows to survive until Luffy returns.

episodes_data.title: Two Dragons Face Off! Momonosuke's Determination!
episodes_data.description: Momonosuke faces Kaido once again trembling in fear. However, with Luffy’s encouragement, he bravely steps up and shows his dragon fangs remembering what he had to go through because of Kaido.

episodes_data.title: A Legend All Over Again! Luffy's Fist Roars in the Sky
episodes_data.description: Asked to stop Onigashima by Luffy, Momonosuke once again gets cold feet, but this time, he has a reliable ally who can teach him how to fly. The clash between Luffy and Kaido shakes up the sky and enables Dogstorm and Cat Viper to exert all their strength.

episodes_data.title: The Situation Has Grown Tense! The End of Onigashima!
