episodes_data.description: Realizing Onigashima’s impending threat, imperiling everyone’s life, Yamato and Momonosuke launch a secret operation. Meanwhile, Sanji and Zoro are both in a deadly battle against Queen and King.

episodes_data.title: Sanji's Mutation - The Two Arms in Crisis!
episodes_data.description: Queen’s unforeseen move stuns everyone on the Performance Floor. And then, he goes on to utilize another special technique which can break every bone in Sanji’s body. On the verge of a crisis, Sanji feels something strange again.

episodes_data.title: Death to Your Partner! Killer's Deadly Gamble
episodes_data.description: Killer tries to figure out how to fight against Hawkins whose power enables him to transfer damage against him to Kid. Kid is dying not knowing where his damage is coming from. Killer takes a chance with Kid’s life on the line.

episodes_data.title: A Shadowy Figure Pulls the Strings! Onigashima in Flames
episodes_data.description: Sanji still wonders what is happening to his body as he receives attacks. Meanwhile, the dying Kin’emon hears an unexpected voice calling for the also dying Kanjuro. Through the Smail, the voice of Orochi tries to stir up Kanjuro to make him perform one last time.

episodes_data.title: A Countercharge! Law and Kid's Return-Attack Combination
episodes_data.description: Law and Kid are having a tough battle against a formidable Emperor of the Sea, Big Mom. However, when they decide to work collaboratively and use their awakened Devil Fruit powers, they see the possibility of taking down the old generation.

episodes_data.title: For Luffy - Sanji and Zoro's Oath
episodes_data.description: Sanji is tormented by the idea of becoming a cruel Germa warrior like his siblings and torn between being strong or being humane as he is now. When he makes up his mind, he asks Zoro the ultimate favor.

episodes_data.title: The Onslaught of Kazenbo - Orochi's Evil Clutches Close In
episodes_data.description: Kazenbo, the giant specter of fire symbolizing the burning wrath of the Kurozumi Clan, rampages through the castle creating panic among both the Animal Kingdom Pirates and the samurai. Orochi who is watching in excitement suddenly hears a sound that brings back memories.

episodes_data.title: Zoro Faces Adversity - A Monster! King the Wildfire
episodes_data.description: Zoro is facing a hard fight against King who seems invincible. Even one of Zoro’s deadliest attacks doesn’t leave a scratch on him. On top of that, one of Zoro’s swords goes out of control and gets in his way.

episodes_data.title: The Secret of Enma! The Cursed Sword Entrusted to Zoro
episodes_data.description: Zoro still can’t gain control of Enma which keeps extracting his Haki. Backed into a corner by the formidable King, Zoro remembers the encounter with an old man in his hometown when he was a child.

episodes_data.title: The Strike of an Ifrit! Sanji vs. Queen
episodes_data.description: Queen’s formidable attacks remind Sanji of his family. Annoyed by Queen’s provocations, Sanji remembers a young woman mysteriously getting hurt in front of him and realizes what happened at that time, which lights a fire within him.

episodes_data.title: The Three-Sword Style of the Supreme King! Zoro vs. King
episodes_data.description: Zoro tries to figure out a way to damage King. Meanwhile, King remembers when he first met his captain Kaido and declares that his captain is the one to become the King of the Pirates, which leads Zoro to set his swords alight with hellfire.

episodes_data.title: Luffy Is on the Move! A Turning Point to a New Era!
episodes_data.description: Usopp finds Kin’emon’s upper body and the heavily wounded Kiku. However, they are surrounded by the Gifters and can’t find a way out. Seeing the samurai giving up hope, Usopp remembers his determination.

episodes_data.title: Drunken Dragon Bagua! The Lawless Dragon Closing in on Luffy
episodes_data.description: In the Flower Capital, the Fire Festival is about to end. On Onigashima, the battle between Luffy and Kaido is getting even more intense. However, Kaido who is excited about having a strong opponent starts drinking too much.

episodes_data.title: The Destruction of the Alliance?! Fire Up, the Will of the New Generation!
episodes_data.description: With the ongoing battles in various parts of Onigashima, everyone is reaching their limits. In the face of Big Mom, Law and Kid are exhausted and deeply wounded. Mocking them, Big Mom tries to head for the rooftop.

episodes_data.title: Here Comes the Main Act! Powerful Techniques of Shockwave and Magnetism
episodes_data.description: Big Mom’s strong life force discourages Law and Kid. Law tells Kid that he only has enough energy for one last strike. However, a monster Big Mom summons puts the two in even more of a bind.

episodes_data.title: To the New Era! Settled! The Determination of the Brats
episodes_data.description: Kid’s all-out deadly attack and Law’s tactical action leave Big Mom in the lurch. Then she remembers what Roger said in the past and wonders if the treasure he mentioned is out there after all.

episodes_data.title: Moon Princess Echoes! The Final Phase of the Land of Wano!
episodes_data.description: Kaido mourns Big Mom’s defeat and remembers the day he met her for the first time. Meanwhile, backed into a corner, Orochi sees the true nature of Komurasaki, the woman he loves, and trembles with fear.

episodes_data.title: There Is Only One Winner - Luffy vs. Kaido
episodes_data.description: On orders from the Five Elders, the CP-0 agent Guernica tries to get to Luffy, but Drake stands in his way. Meanwhile, Luffy who only has very little energy left uses his last Gear Four to emancipate the people of the Land of Wano from Kaido.

episodes_data.title: Luffy Is Defeated?! The Determination of Those Left Behind
episodes_data.description: The battle between Luffy and Kaido comes to an unexpected end. Kaido comes down and tells everyone that Luffy has been defeated and the Land of Wano is finished. Momonosuke and Yamato argue over whether they should still continue fighting.

episodes_data.title: Luffy's Peak - Attained! Gear Five
episodes_data.description: As Luffy’s heart pounds in a funny way, the Five Elders reveal the secret behind the Gum-Gum Fruit. Meanwhile, Orochi tries to convince Komurasaki to escape with him, but when he sees Kanjuro, he makes a malicious decision.

episodes_data.title: The Ridiculous Power! Gear Five in Full Play
episodes_data.description: Bouncing on the ground and becoming a giant, Luffy enjoys his new, bizarre power while Kaido is bewildered and can’t make sense of it. Meanwhile, Kid, Law, and Luffy’s other allies continue the fight down below against flames and enemies alike, waiting for Luffy to emerge victorious.

episodes_data.title: No Way Out! A Hellish Scene on Onigashima
episodes_data.description: Now the whole Onigashima is ablaze. Chopper reunites with Nami while Sanji and the others are each trying to escape from the flames. However, Raizo who harbors a great regret from his past stands up to the fire with the help of Jimbei.

episodes_data.title: I Trust Momo - Luffy's Final Powerful Technique!
episodes_data.description: Momonosuke struggles to create Flame Clouds to sustain Onigashima which is in free fall. In the Flower Capital, the Fire Festival is ending with people flying their Sky Boats in the air. To fulfill the promise to free the Land of Wano, Luffy inflates his fist to strike Kaido.

episodes_data.title: 20 Years' Worth of Prayers! Take Back the Land of Wano
episodes_data.description: When Oden died 20 years ago, Orochi took over the Land of Wano. People were separated from their loved ones, forced into labor, and starved. Now they pray that Kaido will vanish as Luffy’s battle against him reaches a climax.

episodes_data.title: The World That Luffy Wants!
episodes_data.description: Kaido remembers how he was treated unfairly in the past and how he believes the world should be. While his friends struggle to survive on Onigashima, Luffy is asked by Kaido to picture his ideal world as he throws a destructive punch.

episodes_data.title: The Curtain Falls! The Winner, Straw Hat Luffy!
episodes_data.description: The samurai and the Straw Hats shout for joy as they hear that Luffy defeated Kaido. Meanwhile, Momonosuke informs Zunesha of a major decision that he made. However, when Yamato calls on the Animal Kingdom Pirates to stop fighting, the earth trembles.

episodes_data.title: He Returns! The Shogun of the Land of Wano, Kozuki Momonosuke
episodes_data.description: The people of the Flower Capital get flustered when Kin’emon and the other Akazaya samurai who were supposed to be dead appear from the smoke. However, the last one who walks out of the smoke, and what he says, confuses the people even more.

episodes_data.title: The Morning Comes! Luffy and the Others Rest!
episodes_data.description: The Land of Wano is in a celebratory mood now that the years of tyranny are over. However, Yamato is holding back his hunger alone until Hiyori arrives with the news he was waiting for. Meanwhile, some unknown figure approaches the Land of Wano.

episodes_data.title: A Celebration Banquet! The New Emperors of the Sea!
episodes_data.description: The news of the defeat of the Emperors of the Sea spreads across the world. Luffy enjoys the banquet but just as he is about to make a toast, an enraged Kid comes in to strike him. The reason behind his action surprises Luffy

episodes_data.title: The World Will Burn! The Onslaught of a Navy Admiral!
episodes_data.description: As the Navy Admiral Ryokugyu comes to strike the Flower Capital, the Akazaya samurai notice and try to stop him, but his Woods-Woods Fruit power overwhelms them. Meanwhile, another formidable, yet friendly, guest approaches the Land of Wano

episodes_data.title: The Coming of the New Era! The Red-Haired's Imperial Rage
episodes_data.description: Navy Admiral Ryokugyu keeps up a savage assault against the Akazaya samurai who are still recovering from the last battle. Momonosuke tries to defend the Land of Wano with all his might, but he gets driven into a corner.

episodes_data.title: The World That Moves On! A New Organization, Cross Guild
episodes_data.description: Momonosuke and Hiyori are happy to see their grandfather who was supposed to be dead and the Straw Hats are surprised when Robin tells them about Pluton the Ancient Weapon. Meanwhile, Momonosuke is kept busy in his role as the new Shogun.

episodes_data.title: Time to Depart - The Land of Wano and the Straw Hats
episodes_data.description: An untold story from before the Straw Hats’ departure. Luffy visits the ruins of Oden Castle where Oden’s grave once was and Zoro visits Yasuie’s grave where he meets Hiyori. Later, Luffy and Tama eat red-bean soup together for the last time and share their feelings with each other.

episodes_data.title: The Last Curtain! Luffy and Momonosuke's Vow
episodes_data.description: Angered by Luffy`s attempt to leave without saying goodbye, Momonosuke rushes with Kin’emon and Yamato to the port from where the Straw Hats are about to leave, thinking back on his days with Luffy.

episodes_data.title: A New Emperor! Buggy the Genius Jester!
episodes_data.description: Luffy and the other Straw Hats’ new bounties are revealed. Meanwhile, at Emptee Bluffs Island,　Crocodile and the greatest swordsman in the world Mihawk, visit Buggy to discuss their newly-established organization, Cross Guild.

episodes_data.title: The War on the Island of Women! A Case Involving Koby the Hero
episodes_data.description: Navy Captain Koby comes to the Island of Women to arrest Pirate Empress Hancock with the new Pacifistas. While the Navy and Kuja fighters clash, Blackbeard comes to raid, also targeting　Hancock.

episodes_data.title: Luffy's Dream
episodes_data.description: The three-way struggle between the Navy, the Blackbeard Pirates, and the Kuja Pirates comes to an end when an unexpected figure shows up. On the Sunny, the Straw Hats talk about the recent incidents around the world and Luffy’s words surprise everyone.

episodes_data.title: Entering a New Chapter! Luffy and Sabo's Paths!
episodes_data.description: Sabo, the Chief of Staff of the Revolutionary Army, contacts Koala and everyone in Kamabakka Queendom. He explains to them about the things that he is accused of, but someone who was eavesdropping on the call takes a stunning action.

episodes_data.title: A New Island! Future Island Egghead
episodes_data.description: Luffy and Chopper fall into the rough cold sea along with the mysterious girl. Jimbei tries to help them but another attack comes from the unknown creature. Meanwhile, the Sunny is hit by torpedoes and the rest of the Straw Hats are thrown into the sea, too.

episodes_data.title: Brimming with the Future! An Adventure on the Island of Science!
episodes_data.description: Luffy and Chopper fall into the rough cold sea along with the mysterious girl. Jimbei tries to help them but another attack comes from the unknown creature. Meanwhile, the Sunny is hit by torpedoes and the rest of the Straw Hats are thrown into the sea, too.

episodes_data.title: Bonney's Lamentation! Darkness Lurking on the Future Island
episodes_data.description: While Luffy and the others are enjoying the futuristic machines of Egghead, someone who resembles Bartholomew Kuma comes after them. When Luffy tries to fight back, Bonney stops him and reveals her shocking relationship with Kuma.

episodes_data.title: The Winner Takes All! Law vs. Blackbeard!
episodes_data.description: The Blackbeard Pirates ambushed the Heart Pirates led by Law. The Blackbeard Pirates’ top officers use a variety of formidable Devil Fruit powers and keep pushing the Heart Pirates in order to obtain the copies of the Road Ponegliffs.

episodes_data.title: The Mystery Deepens! Egghead Labophase
episodes_data.description: The Straw Hats without Luffy, Chopper, and Jimbei are taken to the laboratory on the clouds far above the ground by Lilith. They get excited about the things they`ve never seen before. However, inside the laboratory, a new threat is waiting for them.

episodes_data.title: The Brain of a Genius - Six Vegapunks!
episodes_data.description: Nami and the others are attacked by a Pacifista who resembles Jimbei and while they’re in battle, some of Vegapunk’s Satellites look on with excitement. Meanwhile, Luffy and the others find something extraordinary at the scrap heap.

episodes_data.title: A Forbidden Piece of History! A Theory Concerning a Kingdom
episodes_data.description: Vegapunk Shaka shares with Robin and the others his theory about an ancient kingdom and the 100-Year Void. He even says that he visited Ohara after its destruction. Meanwhile, Luffy and Chopper try to activate the giant robot and something surprising happens.

episodes_data.title: The Will of Ohara! The Inherited Research
episodes_data.description: Shaka reveals the secret behind the foundation of the Revolutionary Army and how the relationship between Vegapunk and Dragon affected it. Meanwhile, Vegapunk explains to Luffy and the others about his special power and how his clones work.

episodes_data.title: The Eccentric Dream of a Genius!
episodes_data.description: Vegapunk reveals the shocking history of the ancient giant robot and asks Luffy to take him off Egghead. Rob Lucci and his fellow Cipher Pol agents arrive at the island and ask for permission to enter the port.

episodes_data.title: Preparations for Interception! Rob Lucci Strikes!
episodes_data.description: CP-0 led by Rob Lucci makes a forced landing at Egghead and people on the Fabriophase are plunged into confusion while Shaka and the others prepare to fight back on the Labophase. The enraged Atlas stands up to defend the peace of the island.

episodes_data.title: Powers on a Different Level! Luffy vs. Lucci!
episodes_data.description: Luffy transforms into the Warrior of Liberation as Rob Lucci also shows his awakened Devil Fruit form. As the two clash, Vegapunk reveals the shocking truth of the Gum-Gum Fruit and his eye-opening theory on Devil Fruits.

episodes_data.title: The Strongest Form of Humanity! The Seraphim's Powers!
episodes_data.description: Vegapunk describes how he managed to grant the Seraphim Devil Fruit powers, which surprises Franky and the others. Meanwhile, Luffy is still facing Lucci in his savage, awakened form, but the rocket to the Labophase is about to leave.

episodes_data.title: Sinister Schemes! The Operation to Escape Egghead
episodes_data.description: Vegapunk asks the Straw Hats to take him on board their ship which makes Franky and Usopp happy but annoys Nami. Lucci orders his troops to block off all Vegapunk’s escape routes and looks to invade the heavily-secured Labophase.

episodes_data.title: Turn Back My Father! Bonney's Futile Wish!
episodes_data.description: CP-0 enters the Labophase and starts attacking the Thousand Sunny as soon as they find it. Luffy reunites with Nami and the others but finds out that Vegapunk is missing. Meanwhile, Bonney is pressing Vegapunk to change back her father Kuma.

episodes_data.title: A Desperate Situation! The Seraphim's All-out Attack!
episodes_data.description: The Seraphim come following CP-0 to the Labophase, pitting Zoro and Brook against the seven of them. Sanji, Franky, Edison, and Lilith leave the lab to fight them, but the Seraphim launch a full-scale attack on the lab.

episodes_data.title: A Beautiful Act of Treason! The Spy, Stussy!
episodes_data.description: Stussy suddenly knocked out Lucci to the Straw Hats’ surprise, and when Shaka reveals her true identity, they’re stunned again. Meanwhile, a major incident occurs on an island called Sphinx where Whitebeard came from.

episodes_data.title: Trouble Occurs! Seek Dr. Vegapunk!
episodes_data.description: CP-0 takes control of the Fabriophase but gets attacked by an unknown force. Meanwhile, in the Labophase, the Straw Hats and Dr. Vegapunk’s Satellites find out that Vegapunk has disappeared and begin searching for him.

episodes_data.title: A Shudder! The Evil Hand Creeping Up on the Laboratory
episodes_data.description: Bonney witnesses her father Bartholomew Kuma’s painful memories. Meanwhile at the lab, Shaka notices that their communications and surveillance cameras are being cut off by somebody.

episodes_data.title: Incomprehensible! The Seraphim's Rebellion!
episodes_data.description: The Seraphim suddenly start attacking the Straw Hats and the Vegapunk Satellites. They are not stopping even when the Satellites order them to. When Luffy and Zoro are cornered, Lucci and Kaku wake up and make them a surprising offer.

episodes_data.title: A Tough Decision! An Unusual United Front!
episodes_data.description: Lucci and Kaku from CP0, who came to Egghead with a mission to eliminate the seven Vegapunks, ask Luffy and Zoro to uncuff them so they can fight alongside them against the Seraphim, but Luffy and Zoro are reluctant to do so.

episodes_data.title: Survive! Deadly Combat with the Strongest Form of Humanity!
episodes_data.description: The Straw Hats and CP0 relentlessly attack the Seraphim, but the Seraphim keep getting back up. Then, Zoro notices that the Seraphim remind him of someone who he fought before. Meanwhile, Shaka goes to check one place where he thinks Vegapunk Stella might be.

episodes_data.title: The Second Ohara! The Mastermind's Ambition!
episodes_data.description: Stussy and Sentomaru discuss how big the threat that closes in on Egghead is as Luffy and the others keep fighting the uncontrollable Seraphim. Meanwhile, in an underground lab, someone approaches Vegapunk, who is being held captive.

episodes_data.title: Clash! Shanks vs. Eustass Kid
episodes_data.description: Kid gives his crew a pep talk before the battle with Shanks. Shanks also prepares for the battle, but learns how his own subordinates do as they like to protect their beloved boss. Finally, Kid has his Damned Punk ready to shoot.

episodes_data.title: Run, Koby! A Desperate Escape Strategy!
episodes_data.description: Held at the Pirate Island of Beehive, Koby gets a chance to be free but decides to become a decoy to liberate slaves on the island. Pirates from all over the island come after him because of the big bounty on his head.

episodes_data.title: For the Beloved Pupil - The Fist of Vice Admiral Garp!
episodes_data.description: A massive warship comes flying towards the Pirate Island of Beehive and Vice Admiral Garp launches a crushing attack on top of it to save his pupil Koby. Koby almost reaches the ship with Navy HQ Commander Hibari running by his side.

episodes_data.title: The Navy Surprised! The Navy Headquarters' Former Admiral, Kuzan
episodes_data.description: Kuzan, a former Navy Admiral, stands in the way of Garp who came to rescue Koby. He was once Garp’s pupil but is now a member of the Blackbeard Pirates. What happened to him after he was defeated by Sakazuki is now revealed.

episodes_data.title: Let's Go Get It! Buggy's Big Declaration
episodes_data.description: Sengoku, the former Admiral of the Fleet, and Great Adviser Tsuru discuss the murder of Vice Admiral T-Bone and concerns about Cross Guild. Meanwhile, Buggy gives a passionate speech to Crocodile, Mihawk, and his crew.

episodes_data.title: Sabo Returns - The Shocking Truth to Be Told!
episodes_data.description: Sabo returns to Kamabakka Queendom and starts recounting what happened at the Holy Land Mary Geoise. A month ago, during the Reverie, he and the captains of the Revolutionary Army raided the Land of Gods and Sabo witnessed Bartholomew Kuma being the Celestial Dragons’ slave.

episodes_data.title: The Holy Land in Tumult! Sai and Leo's Full-Power Blow!
episodes_data.description: In the Holy Land Mary Geoise during the Reverie, Sabo runs into Bartholomew Kuma’s daughter Bonney. Meanwhile, King Cobra of the Kingdom of Alabasta begins asking the Five Elders questions that trouble them.

episodes_data.title: The Entrusted Message! King Cobra's Resolve
episodes_data.description: King Cobra is surprised by seeing someone sitting on the Empty Throne and by learning about the truth of the world. When he is subject to a deadly attack, Sabo cuts in to save him. The injured king entrusts Sabo with a message.

episodes_data.title: The World Is Shaken! The Ruler's Judgment and the Five Elders' Actions!
episodes_data.description: Vivi tries to escape the Holy Land Mary Geoise with Wapol while the injured Sabo also looks for a way to leave to deliver King Cobra’s message to Luffy and Vivi. Meanwhile, Imu orders the Five Elders to test a horrendous weapon.

episodes_data.title: Garp and Kuzan - A Master and a Pupil's Beliefs Clash
episodes_data.description: At the Pirate Island of Beehive, Vice Admiral Garp, who came to rescue the kidnapped Koby, deals with an overwhelming number of pirates alone. As he and his fellow Navy soldiers try to escape the island, Kuzan, the former Navy admiral, stands in their way.

episodes_data.title: The Last Lesson! Impact Inherited
episodes_data.description: Avalo Pizarro, who merged with the Pirate Island, reaches his giant hand to crush the Navy ship with many soldiers and civilians on board. The wounded Garp gives orders to Koby, Helmeppo, and Prince Grus, and delivers a powerful blow to save the ship.

episodes_data.description: Caribou begs Augur and Devon to let him meet Blackbeard. An order is given to the Navy vice admirals to kill Jewelry Bonney at all costs in order to take back control over the Pacifistas. Sanji flees with the injured Vegapunk while Luffy holds St. Saturn back.

episodes_data.title: Vegapunk's Secret Plan - A Tense Worldwide Broadcast
episodes_data.description: Suddenly, Vegapunk’s broadcast begins and the whole world is taken by surprise. As everyone rushes to set up Video Transponder Snails and screens to watch it, the Five Elders grow concerned and discuss countermeasures.

episodes_data.title: The Worst Nightmare - The Five Elders Come Together
episodes_data.description: Just like when St. Saturn emerged on Egghead, black lightning strikes and pentagrams appear again. The Pacifistas are rendered immobile by an unknown shadow. Meanwhile, as the time for the Straw Hats to evacuate the island is drawing near, the fight between Zoro and Lucci intensifies.

episodes_data.title: Friends Fight Together! Luffy and the Warriors of Elbaph
episodes_data.description:
Dorry and Brogy finally reunite with Luffy. However, they are still facing St. Saturn and St.
Warcury in their alternate forms. Dorry blows a horn to alert his people to prepare to escape, but
St. Warcury unleashes a deafening roar.

episodes_data.title: An Imminent Threat - Stussy and Edison's Resolve
episodes_data.description: Franky and Bonney clash with Navy vice admirals in front of the Elbaph ship. St. Mars tries to find the room from Vegapunk’s broadcast. The heavily injured Stussy tells Kaku the reason she chose to stay behind while Edison takes desperate action to help the Straw Hats escape.

episodes_data.title: A Stunning Conclusion - Vegapunk's Great Prediction
episodes_data.description: Vegapunk’s broadcast resumes as people in various locations all over the world listen closely. St. Mars rushes to find the Transponder Snail that is the source of the broadcast while the Straw Hats and their allies clash with the other members of the Five Elders.

episodes_data.title: The Lost History - Joyboy, the First Pirate
The Void Century - A Revelation About a Sinking World
episodes_data.description: The severely injured Edison begs Stussy to escape, but she makes a stunning request in exchange. Meanwhile, Vegapunk presents another astonishing disclosure about a past cataclysm and the Ancient Weapons that will fundamentally challenge the beliefs of people everywhere.

episodes_data.title: Get the Ship Moving! The Iron Giant Activates
episodes_data.description: Vegapunk`s revelation shocks even Koby and his fellow SWORD members, leading them to discuss what to do next.

episodes_data.title: Her and Her Father's Dream! Bonney's Free Future
episodes_data.description: Luffy finally hops on the Elbaph ship along with Dorry and Brogy, but the Five Elders catch up to them and begin their assault. On the burning ship, Bonney hears a familiar sound and then finds a new strength in her memories of her father.

Then, for the future of humanity, he resolved himself to make a bold decision.

specials_data.title: One Piece: Episode of Sabo - The Three Brothers' Bond - The Miraculous Reunion and the Inherited Will
specials_data.description: After two years of training, the Straw Hats reunited at Sabaody Archipelago. Getting past the Fish-Man Island, they finally made it to the final sea – the New World. At Punk Hazard Island, they met Trafalgar Law again by accident who suggested them to form a “pirate alliance” with him in order to take down the Four Emperors, which they accepted, and together with Law, they went for Doflamingo who is connected to the Four Emperors. They entered Dressrosa, the country Doflamingo reigns over, and got into action according to Law’s instruction but Luffy suddenly decided to enter a competition which prize was his late brother Ace’s Flare-Flare Fruit under the name Lucy, and made it to the final. Meanwhile, Law fell for Doflamingo’s trap and got captured. At the same time, the Straw Hats learned the “darkness” of the country from a toy soldier who they met on their way. Becoming furious about Doflamingo’s dirty trick, they joined the Little People to fight to take back freedom. Luffy was competing in the Colosseum but to rescue Law, he was trying to get out of there and that’s when Sabo who he thought was dead, showed up…

One Piece: Adventure of Nebulandia
specials_data.description:
Adventure of Nebulandia is a TV special of the One Piece anime.
The special has the Straw Hat Pirates fight Foxy again in the New World, on Mushroom Island. This soon gives way to a battle against the Marines on an island called Nebulandia that can nullify Devil Fruit powers.

specials_data.title: One Piece: Heart of Gold
specials_data.description: While Exploring the New World, Luffy and the members of the Straw Hats meets a mysterious girl named Olga. She is pretty on the outside but twisted and savage inside and she told them she is chased by the Navy and a powerful treasure hunter named Mad Treasure. The reason she is targeted is because she was from Alchemi, an island of steel which suddenly disappeared two centuries ago. Rumor has it that the metal called the Pure Gold that was created on the island is worth a fortune – that you can even buy the whole world with it. Thus, people have been seeking it from long ago. Olga managed to escape from Alchemi by accident but was caught by the Navy, and the Navy Headquarters and Mad Treasure who is working on orders from Guild Tesoro, the lord of the underground community, came to notice that there was a remaining survivor from Alchemi. Being pushed around by the cranky Olga, Luffy decides to hunt for the treasure that everybody wants. And the mysterious girl Olga is looking to make a lot of money using Luffy and the others. The members of the Straw Hats are excited about hunting the never-seen-before treasure. Will they be able to get the legendary treasure, Pure Gold, while having the formidable treasure hunter as their opponent?

specials_data.title: That Which Our Eyes Gaze Upon
One Piece: Episode of East Blue - Luffy and His Four Friends' Great Adventure
specials_data.description:
The words that Gold Roger, the King of the Pirates, uttered just before his death excited the masses and the world has entered a Great Pirate Era! There is a group of young pirates who are about to set sail on the Grand Line. Monkey D. Luffy, a rubber man. Roronoa Zoro aka “Pirate Hunter.” Usopp, a sniper. Sanji, a seafaring cook. And “Cat Burglar” Nami. They, the Straw Hats, all place a foot upon a barrel and make their vows before their next journey across the great ocean. Luffy shouts “In order to be the King of the Pirates!”
A decade ago in the Windmill Village...
A little boy Luffy was enthralled with a pirate boss Red-Haired Shanks. But a group of mountain bandits shows up and makes fun of the pirates. “Why didn`t you fight them?!” Luffy yells out angrily but Shanks says that it`s nothing worth getting mad over. At that time, Luffy snatches the Gum-Gum Fruit from a treasure box and eats it and as a result, his entire body becomes rubber and he loses the ability to swim for the rest of his life!
A few days later, Luffy is surrounded by the mountain bandits again and Shanks comes to help. “No matter what the reason, anyone who hurts my friends has to pay!!”
Shanks and his pirate crew are incredibly strong and they beat down the mountain bandits. Higuma, the head of the mountain bandits, runs away kidnapping Luffy and heads for the sea. However, they encounter a local Sea Monster there and are attacked. Luffy is in a desperate situation... But again, Shanks saves the day. He outstares the Sea Monster and chases it away but in exchange, he loses his left arm...
When Shanks leaves the village, he leaves his straw hat with Luffy.
“Come bring it back to me someday! Once you`ve become a great pirate!”
10 years later, Luffy has grown up strong and he sets out for an adventure on a small boat. He again encounters the local Sea Monster for that fateful day. However, Luffy takes it down with a single blow of Gum-Gum Pistol. Luffy’s journey to become the King of the Pirates now begins!

specials_data.title: The Captain's Log of the Legend! 'Red-Haired' Shanks!
specials_data.description: As the world anticipates the legendary diva Uta’s show in Elegia, the Red-Hair Pirates are making some disturbing moves. Koby remembers how Shanks ended the Paramount War at Marineford.

specials_data.title: A Comprehensive Anatomy! Fierce Fight! The Five from the New Generation
specials_data.description: Captain Kid and Killer look back on their adventures in the Land of Wano along with the other pirates from the Worst Generation, Luffy, Zoro, and Law. They describe how hard the five of them fought against the Emperors of the Sea, Kaido and Big Mom.

specials_data.title: Recapping Fierce Fights! Straw Hats vs. Tobi Roppo
specials_data.description: Zoro and Sanji look back on their friends’ battles against the Tobi Roppo, the top officers of the Animal Kingdom Pirates. They describe how hard Nami, Robin, and the others fought to defeat the formidable enemies.

specials_data.title: Recapping Fierce Fights! Zoro vs. a Lead Performer!
specials_data.description: Chopper and Sanji look back on Zoro’s battle against King the Wildfire, a Lead Performer of the Animal Kingdom Pirates. They explain how Zoro struggles to find a way to defeat the seemingly invincible King.

specials_data.title: Recapping Fierce Fights! The Countercharge Alliance vs. Big Mom
specials_data.description: Nami and Robin look back on Law and Kid’s battle against Big Mom, one of the Four Emperors of the Sea. They explain how the two captains suffered, were driven to the wall, and fought back against the mighty Big Mom.

specials_data.title: Luffy-senpai Support Project! Barto's Secret Room 3!
specials_data.description: Bartolomeo and Tama look back on Luffy’s battle against Kaido, one of the Four Emperors of the Sea. They explain how Luffy got knocked out, got back on his feet, and became stronger to take down Kaido and free the Land of Wano.

specials_data.title: Luffy-senpai Support Project! Barto's Secret Room 4!
specials_data.description: Bartolomeo and Tama look back on Luffy’s attainment of Gear Five and the battle against the formidable Kaido. They talk about the surprising features of Luffy’s new power and how the fierce battle reached its climax.

specials_data.title: A Very Special Feature! Momonosuke's Road to Becoming a Great Shogun
specials_data.description: Momonosuke, Kin’emon, and Yamato look back on the Land of Wano after Kaido and Orochi were taken down. They talk about the things that happened in the country after the raid on Onigashima and how Momonosuke worked hard to become a great Shogun.

specials_data.title: A Project to Fully Enjoy! 'Surgeon of Death' Trafalgar Law
specials_data.description: Chopper and Bepo look back on Trafalgar Law’s life. They explain how he met Luffy, formed an alliance, and traveled to Punk Hazard, Dressrosa, and the Land of Wano to take down the Emperors of the Sea.

specials_data.title: The Log of the Rivalry! The Straw Hats vs. Cipher Pol
specials_data.description: Robin and Franky look back on the history of Lucci, Kaku, and the rest of the Cipher Pol agents who forced their way into Egghead. They talk about how the rivalry between the Straw Hats and those Cipher Pol agents evolved since they met in Water Seven.

specials_data.title: Making History! The Turbulent Old and New Four Emperors!
specials_data.description: Zoro and Brook introduce the past and present Four Emperors. They talk about what kind of power each Emperor has or had, their shining moments of greatness, how some were brought down, and how others thrive.

specials_data.title: The Log of the Turbulent Revolution! The Revolutionary Army Maneuvers in Secret!
specials_data.description: Bartolomeo and Cavendish introduce the Revolutionary Army. They talk about their key members, their relationship with Luffy and his crew, and how they have been working behind the scenes to overthrow the World Government.

specials_data.title: Unwavering Justice! The Navy's Proud Log!
specials_data.description: Nami, Usopp, and Jinbe review the Navy. They introduce everything about the Navy’s prominent officers and soldiers from their special abilities to their conflicts, friendships, and memorable moments.

specials_data.title: One Piece: Fan Letter
specials_data.description: Two years after the Paramount War, the Straw Hats are about to reunite on the Sabaody Archipelago. At the same time, a girl who is head over heels for Nami is trying to hand a fan letter to her before the group leaves the island.

background:
The anime had a hiatus from October 13, 2024, to April 6, 2025. The anime switched to a seasonal release model starting from April 5, 2026.

The airing time was Wednesdays 19:00 between October 20, 1999 - March 2001. The airing time was changed to Sundays 19:30 between April 2001 - December 2004. The airing time was changed to Sundays 9:30 between October 6, 2006 - October 13, 2024. The airing time was again changed to Sundays 23:15 on April 6, 2025.

Several anime-original arcs have been adapted into light novels, and the series has inspired 50+ video games as of 2023.

In June 2004, One Piece was licensed in North America by 4Kids Entertainment, which partnered with Viz Media for home video distribution. As One Piece proved unsuitable for their target demographic, 4Kids Entertainment censored the show to meet their standards, and, in December 2006, they stopped its production. In April 2007, Funimation took over the series licensing, providing an uncut version that remained faithful to the original release.

In Japan, the anime's first 574 episodes were released exclusively on DVD by Avex Pictures from February 21, 2001, to December 4, 2013. Blu-rays also became available with the DVDs starting on January 8, 2014. In North America, Viz Media released the anime on DVD between February 28, 2006, and June 26, 2007. Funimation has re-released and continued the series since May 27, 2008. From March 23, 2021, the DVDs were accompanied by Blu-rays as well.
